tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (39)༄༅/ /zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum gyi dbang chog rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bklags pas grub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ // /
(39)༄༅/ /zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum gyi dbang chog rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bklags pas grub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (39)༄༅// zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum gyi dbang chog rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bklags pas grub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(40)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// dkyil 'khor lha la gus btud nas// zhi byed bka' babs rnam gsum gyi// dbang chog ngag 'don gsal bder 'god// de la thog mar bka' babs dang po sgron ma rnam pa gsum gyi dbang ni/ dben zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su stegs bu ba byung dang bdud rtsis chag chag btab pa la/ dkyil 'khor lte ba zlum po'i dbus su chos 'byung bsnol ma/ de'i phyi pad 'dab brgyad phyogs tshon rdo ra me ris bskor ba bris pa'i dbus su mañji'i khar thod pa mtshan ldan bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa bzhag /shar du bum pa mgul chings 'bras bu can gyi ljon pas kha brgyan pa'i nang du lnga tshan lnga dang chu gtsang ba dmar ser gyi 'o ma dang bcas pas bkang ba gu gul gyi dud pas bdug pa bsham/ lhor dbu rgyan cod pan dang bcas pa/ nub tu rdo rje/ byang du dril bu rnams bkod/ mchod gtor sogs yo byad rnams tshang bar bsags la/ sgrub mchod ni/ khrus byas stan la 'khod de/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'jam dpal smra seng du gsal ba'i (41)thugs ka'i dhīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar sad par bsams la/ thal mo sbyar te/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// mchod pa bla na yod pa dang*// mchod pa bla na med pas mchod// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// lus dbul dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// smon pa'i sems dang rab ldan zhing*// 'jug pa pha rol phyin drug spyad// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pas// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// btang snyoms mchog la gnas par shog /ces lan gsum gyis bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes pas chos thams cad stong (42)pa nyid du mos pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag dang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dbyer med srung 'khor gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus su pad nyi zla ba seng ge sngon po'i steng du dhīḥyig gnas pa las 'od zer spro bsdus shes rab kyi 'khor lo// de yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge sku mdog dmar ser sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ phyag g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon ut+pal steng du pu sti bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing zla ba'i rgyab yol can gyi skur gyur pa'i thugs kar dhīḥyig dmar ser 'bar ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ ne wi d+ye/ shab+da hūm̐ gis mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ yig rnams kyis rgyas btab pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid du gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs pa'i thugs ka nas yum lnga rin po che'i bum pa thogs pas/ oṃ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas bla ma'i ngo bo rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod gtor rnams/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod du ā las bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can hūm̐ gis thim pas 'dod yon cir yang 'char ba'i sprin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod pa bla na yod pa dang*// mchod pa bla na med pa kun// 'bul lo bzhes nas dngos grub stsol// oṃ mañju shrī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+das mchod/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis gtor ma phul la// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la// rgya chen spyod pa ston mdzad pa// 'gro ba'i mgon po ston pa po// (43)'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ bzlas pa ni/ snying gar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i dhīḥyig gi steng du mūm̐ las ral gri tshon gang ba la sngags phreng gis bskor ba de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs bdag la zhugs pas las nyon sdig sgrib sbyangs nas sems can ma rig pa'i 'ching ba las grol bar bsams la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo mañju nā thā ya/ na mo ya mān+ta kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ wā gi shwa ri muṃ/ mañju gho ṣa/ bo dhi si ho ha ri nī swā hā/ zhes pa ci nus bzla/ de nas/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa rin po che las 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ger gsal bar gyur/ thugs ka'i dhīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs spyan drangs shing bstim/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sngags 'od kyis bum nang gi lha yi thugs rgyud bskul bas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab par mos la gzungs thag nas 'jus te gzungs bzla/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas/ lha bdud rtsir zhu bas bum pa gang bar bsam/ yang*/ mdun gyi bdud rtsi'i thod pa mi dmigs pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed mthing nag dbyug tho dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa dur khrod kyi chas can yum rdo rje phag mo dang rol pa'i skur gyur/ ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥrang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul bas lha yab yum rjes chags kyi sbyor ba'i mkha' gsang las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas thod pa gang bar mos la/ oṃ hrī ṣ+ṭiḥwiḥkṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/

oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī yai/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī yai hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bzlas mthar 'bru gsum gyis/ lha zhu ba ye shes kyi bdud rtsir 'khyil bar gyur/ dkyil 'khor dbang rdzas dang bcas pa'i steng gi nam mkha' la dus gsum gyi bde gshegs mkha' 'gro'i (44)tshogs dang bcas pa mngon sum du sad pa la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shab+da hūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ de nas slob ma rnams 'bru gsum bzlas pa'i dri chu'i khrus dang*/ phyag byas gral du 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed dang chos bshad ci rigs pa sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ rje btsun mi pham mgon pos/ 'gro ba sdug bsngal gdungs pa la// zhi byed bsil ldan dri med bshad// ces gsungs pa ltar/ byed las la ming du btags pa spyi ming sgos su thob pa dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed la bka' babs gsum las/ 'dir bka' babs dang po rje btsun gyis kha che dz+nyī na gu h+ya la stsal ba sgron ma rnam pa gsum gyi dbang bskur ba la slob dpon gyi bya ba grub nas/ da slob ma'i bya ba thog mar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba yin te maṇ+ḍal phyis te/ badz+ra re ṣe hūm̐ gis brkyang nul bya/ de nas me tog tshom bu lnga/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bo dhi sa twā ya/ na mo mañju shrī ye/ na mo swā mi gu ra be/ na mo badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye/ zhes bkod la/ kye dam pa skyes mchog bdag la dgongs su gsol/ dbang zab mo 'di zhu ba'i don du bdag gi maṇ+ḍal dam pa 'di mchod par bzhes shig /oṃ maṇ+ḍal puṣ+pe pū dza swā hā/ zhes dbul/ de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod pa lnga phul nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid kyis// slob ma rnams la phan phyir dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// dbang rnams rab tu bskur bar 'tshal// kun mkhyen rnams kyis gnang bar mdzod// ces gsol bas gnang bar byin par bsams la/ rus/ bde bar 'dod pa su zhig yin// zhes pa'i lan du bus// skal ldan bde chen bdag cag lags/

rus/ dam tshig sdom pa srung nus sam/ bus/ nus lags so// de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir tshogs zhing rnams mkha' khyab tu mos la thal mo sbyar te 'di skad brjod du gzhug /na mo bud+dha ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na mo saṅghā ya// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// mchod pa bla na yod pa dang*// mchod pa bla na med pas mchod// (45)sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// lus 'bul dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// smon pa'i sems dang rab ldan zhing*// 'jug pa pha rol phyin drug spyad// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pas// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum/ da nas dam tshig dang sdom pa bzung snyam pas/ sras bcas rgyal ba ma lus dang*// slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis deng nas byang chub bar// gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig ni// bde gshegs rigs lnga'i sdom pa dang*// bcu bzhir phye ba'i ltung ba dang*// yan lag nyes pa thams cad bsrung*// zhes lan gsum/ de nas slob bu mi dmigs pa las gshin rje gshed yab yum gyi skur gyur// dri chu'i thig les bu'i gnas gsum du 'bru gsum brjod de byin gyis brlabs pas/ spyi mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pas rdo rje gsum du byin gyis brlabs/ slar yang lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po/ snying gar hoṃ yoṃ sngon po/ khar hriṃ maṃ dkar po/ dpral bar hrīṃ hrīṃ ser po/ spyi bor hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu/ yan lag la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par bsam pas go bsgos la/ tshe gcig gis 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs dbang zab mo bskur ba bya yis rnyed pa'i mchog rab tu rnyed par gyur to snyam du spro ba bskyed par mdzod cig

/ces brjod de sta gon gyi dod do// de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bcings/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gtad/ hūm̐ dzaḥs dkyil 'khor du bcug la/ dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor/ he ru ka (46)dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// bdud rtsi oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa blud de/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐/ rdo rje spyi bor/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi// he ru ka dpal nga yin gyis// gang zhig nga la brnyas byed na// tshe 'phos dmyal bar ltung ta re// de nas byin dbab pa ni// slob ma rnams lus bsrung*/ spos kyis bdug cing*/ slob dpon 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge'i bdag nyid rnam pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ka ma la shī lar bsgom la mos gus drag tu byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po 'bar zhing 'khyug pa byung*/ khyed rang gi snying gar thim pas sems kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas bde ba'i ye shes mchog tu 'bar bar sgoms shig /ḍa dril 'khrol zhing*/ oṃ sarba s+t+wa gu ru sarba ḍā ki nī ā be sha ya a a/ zhes dbab la/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bar snang la ltos la kha dog ji ltar mthong zhes dri/ de'i tshe dkar por mthong na zhi ba dang*/ ser pos rgyas pa/ dmar pos dbang*/ ljang gu'am nag pos drag po/ khra bor mthong na las sna tshogs 'grub bo zhes brjod la/ sngar bzung ba'i me tog pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes dkyil 'khor du dor bas/ gang la babs pa'i lha des pra ti gṛh+ṇa sarba ma hā ba la/ zhes me tog de spyi bor bcings/ badz+ra pa sh+ya zhes pas gdong g.yogs bsal bas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum bzhin du mthong ba'i mos pa byed du bcug

/de nas dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ dbang rdzas bum pa dang slob bu mi (47)dmigs pa las mi bskyod pa'i skur gyur/ ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas kyi lha bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum par gyur/ de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang lha rnams kyis thogs te dbang bskur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā dar+sha dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing chu gtigs pa dang 'thung du bcug pas/ bu'i lus ngag yid gsum mi bskyod pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur/ 'o khyod la chu'i dbang bskur bas kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no// dbang rdzas dbu rgyan dang*/ slob bu rin 'byung du gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas kyi lha dbu rgyan du gyur/ de nyid sprul pa'i dbang lha rnams kyis thogs te/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes mgo la bskon pas bu'i sgo gsum rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur/ 'o khyod la dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas nyon yid gnas gyur/ mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no// dbang rdzas rdo rje dang slob bu snang mtha'i skur gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas kyi lha rdo rjer gyur/ de nyid sprul pa'i dbang lha rnams kyis thogs te/ oṃ badz+ra s+t+wa a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes lag g.yas par gtad/ bu'i sgo gsum snang mtha'i rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur/ 'o khyod la rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas yid kyi rnam shes gnas gyur/ sor rtog ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no// dbang rdzas dril bu dang slob bu don yod grub par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas kyi lha dril bur gyur/ de nyid sprul pa'i lha rnams kyis thogs te/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti twam a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa mā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes lag g.yon par gtad la dkrol du bcug pas bu'i sgo gsum don yod grub pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi bdag (48)nyid du gyur/

'o khyod la dril bu'i dbang bskur bas sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas gyur bya grub ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no// slob bu rnam snang gi skur gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sprul pa'i dbang lha rnams kyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dril bu thogs te/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣe ka ta/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// zhes ming gi dbang bskur bas sgo gsum rnam snang gi rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur/ 'o khyod la ming dbang bskur bas ming gzhi'i phung po gnas gyur chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no// de ltar dbang po lnga thob pas ma rig pa lnga las ldog /rig pa ye shes lnga rgyud la skyes pas na rig pa'i dbang lnga'o// de nas khyad par can gyi bum pa'i dbang bzhi ni// bum pa sngon du bskyed bzlas grub pa yin na'ang slob bu'i yul du gsal 'debs pa'i phyir/ dbang rdzas bum pa nyid 'jam dpal smra ba'i seṅge'i skur gyur/ ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs spyan drangs bstim/ oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃ/ zhes cung zad bzlas nas/ slob bu 'jam dpal smra ba'i seṅger gsal ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sku gsung thugs rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs pa la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo mañju nā thā ya/ na mo ya mān+taka ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃ/ mañju gho ṣa/ bo dhi siṃ ho ha ri ni swā hā/ zhes gzungs ring gi sham bur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes btags pa bzlas bzhin du bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing chu gtigs pas/ rang lus lha sku gsal stong 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni lus lha ru dbang bskur ba ste bum pa'i dbang ngo*// yang gzungs ring gi rjes zlos lan gsum byed du bcug nas bum chu blud la/ lha zhu ba bdud rtsi'i chur gyur pa myong bas ngag sngags su dbang bskur ba ste bum pa'i dbang ngo*// (49)gzungs lan gcig brjod cing bum chus khrus byed du bcug pas sgrib pa thams cad dag nas/

lus bde stong gi ye shes su dbang bskur ba ste bum pa'i sher dbang ngo*// khyed rang rnams lus sems khong slod la/ rang lus lha skur snang ba de yang snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu/ de yi gshis cir yang ma grub pas 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba/ de nyid zung du 'jug pa rang byung gi shes pa so ma 'di la bzo bcos med par lhan ne mnyam par gzhog cig /de ni lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po ste bum pa'i dbang bzhi pa'o// de nas spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyi dbang ni/ slob bu hūm̐ las byung ba'i gshin rje gshed yab yum gyi skur gyur/ gri thod/ kha ṭ+wāṃ tshangs skud rnams gtad/ he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru// rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rjer bcas// dril bu sil sil sgra sgrog cing*// tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /gri gug dang ni ka pā la// dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lha'i sku/ ḍā ma ru stong pa nyid kyi sgra/ gri thod shes rab dang bde ba chen po/ tshangs skud rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngo bo nyid do// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni dbang rdzas rdor dril dang*/ slob ma skad cig gis rigs 'dus gshin rje gshed yab yum gyi skur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gshin rje gshed yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas kyi lha yab rdo rje dang yum dril bur gyur pa lag tu gtad de gsor zhing dkrol nas 'khyud rgyas 'dzin du bcug la/ rdo rje che dang dril chen longs// rdo rje la yang rdo rje gnas// de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// rdo rje (50)thugs/ dril bu gsung*/ phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig dang mi 'bral bas sems can gyi don gyis shig /sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas// rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/

ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' dbul lo// de rnams kyis phyi bum pa la brten nas dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu bskur ba song*/ da gnyis pa nang ka pā li la brten pa gsang ba'i dbang bzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bcug /khyed rang lus gnad thal mo sbyor la rtsa bzhi sgrims ngag gnad rlung kha sbyor du bzung*/ sems gnad slob dpon gshin rje gshed du gsal ba la/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes zhog la mos gus drag po gyis/ rang gi spyi bor byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma kun 'dus ka ma la shi la/ snying gar dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam kun 'dus 'jam dpal smra seng*/ lte bar dam tshig gi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro kun 'dus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams bsgoms la ma yengs par zhog /slob dpon gyis ḍā dril 'khrol bzhin du/ ye hu te na gha na ra tsa/ hū na te ra gha na ra tsa/ he na hū na gha na ra tsa/ ma hā su kha ta a haṃ/ ces rdo rje'i glu blang zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra dzo gi nī ā be sha ya a a/ zhes pas byin phab/ de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor dbus kyi rdo rje dang thod pa blangs la/ rdo rje lag g.yas pas lan gsum gsor la/ 'o rdo rje 'di ni 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed do// lag g.yon pas thod pa bzung ba bstan la/ 'o thod pa 'di ni yum rdo rje phag mo'i rang bzhin no// rdo rjes thod pa'i bdud rtsi dkrugs la/ 'o 'di ni yab yum gnyis su med par sbyor ba mdzad pa'i brda'o// thod pa'i bdud rtsi rdo rjes sbreng zhing*/ 'o 'di ni byang chub kyi sems (51)dkar dmar gcig tu 'dres pa'i brda'o// bdud rtsi'i thig pa bu'i lce la bzhag ste/ 'o 'di ni yab yum gnyis kyi sbyor mtshams nas dkar dmar 'dres pa'i byang chub kyi sems te rang gi lce thog tu babs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rdo rje ka pā li dang bcas pa spyi bor bzhag la/

dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad thabs shes gnyis med kyi zhu bde lhan cig skyes par gyur pa de khyed rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas rang lus gshin rje gshed yab yum gyi skur gyur par mos la/ bdud rtsi spyi bor gtig /deng phyin chad lha sku sgyu ma lta bu sgom pa dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig /de ni thod pa'i bum dbang ngo*// gshin rje gshed yab yum mnyam par sbyar ba'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems babs pas lce thog tu myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bdud rtsi 'thung du gzhug /deng phyin chad ngag sngags bzla ba dang bdud rtsi lnga brten pa dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig /de ni thod pa'i gsang dbang ngo*// bdud rtsi 'thor bas khrus byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs pas/ 'od kyi rig ma dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i 'jam dpal khro bo'i skur gyur pa'i mkha' gsang hūm̐ dang a las rdo rje dang pad+ma snyoms par 'jug pa'i rjes chags kyis byang sems gnas bzhir yas babs kyi dga' bzhi myang nas/ slar yang gyen du gshegs te mas brten gyi dga' bzhi'i rim pas lhan skyes kyi ye shes brtan par byas pa ni thod pa'i sher dbang ngo*// de ka'i ngang la bzo bcos med par lhan ne zhog cig /hūm̐ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// sems nyid cir yang grub pa med// grub pa med pa'i sems nyid la// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// zhes brjod de/ thod pa'i dbang bzhi pa'o// des nang ka pā li la brten pa'i dbang (52)bzhi stan thog gcig tu bskur ba song*/ da gsum pa gsang ba bha ga la brten pa'i dbang bzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal dang*/ bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas pas/ bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs slob ma'i spyi bo nas thim pas rang lus lha sku gsal stong du gyur pa ni bha ga'i bum dbang*/ bla ma yab yum gyi byang sems babs pa mgrin par thim pa ni bha ga'i gsang dbang*/

bla ma'i thugs ka nas phyag rgya ma gzugs dang lang tsho rgyas pa zhig byung ba rang la 'khyud nas/ 'du shes gsum ldan gyis snyoms par zhugs pas yas babs dang mas 'jogs kyi dga' bzhi'i ye shes mngon du byas pa ni bha ga'i sher dbang*/ ye shes de ngos bzung ba'i ngang der dmigs med bsam med du rang dgar gzhog /de bha ga'i tshig dbang ngo*// des gsang ba bha ga la brten pa'i dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu bskur ba song*// da bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi brda don la brten pa'i dbang bzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal/ khyed rang rnams lus sems khong slong la mtshan bcas lha sku'i thig le snang stong*/ mtshan med ci la'ang rten mi bca' bar rig pa bcud la bor bas nyams bying rmugs med par gsal sing nge ba de bzhi ba'i bum dbang*/ sdug bsngal med par bde lhan ne ba de bzhi pa'i gsang dbang*/ rtog pa med par stong sang nge ba de bzhi pa'i sher dbang*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum tha mi dad pa'i don de nyid bzhi pa'i tshig dbang de kho na nyid kyi dbang ngo*// de nas ma skyes pa'i 'greng gtam tshig gcig gdab ste/ bla mas phyag mdzub nam mkha' la ke re byas la/ ma yengs shig /brda yong ngo*// zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ ci yang yid la mi byed pa'i shes pa gsal stong gi (53)gi ngang du tsan ne gnas pa'i dus na/ phyag rgya chen po rig pa rtsal gyi dbang sems thog tu bskur ba de ka yin no// de nas blo dang bral ba de spyod lam rnam bzhir lam du khyer ba ni/ nyal ba bum dbang gi brda ste/ de'i gdams ngag gnyid dang bsres la lam du khyer 'dug pa ni gsang dbang gi brda ste/ de'i gdams ngag mnyam bzhag la ngo sprad/ 'gro ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi brda ste/ de'i gdams ngag rjes thob lam du khyer/ 'chag pa ni de kho na nyid bzhi pa'i dbang gi brda ste/ de'i gdams ngag chos can rtog pa dang*/ chos nyid blo bral du ro snyoms lam du khyer/

de ni khyod don chen po dang ldan no dga' bar gyis shig /snyigs ma'i rdo rje 'dzin pa dngos yin no zhes gzengs bstod/ de phyin chad 'khor ba la ma chags pa'i blo 'di ltar sgrubs shig /ces lung bstan/ nyams 'di dang ma bral na tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob nges so// zhes dbugs dbyung ngo*// de nas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtong rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs bya/ des zhi byed bka' babs dang po sgron ma rnam gsum gyi dbang tshar ba lags pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ dge ba bsngo/ slar yang mchod pa kha gsos la/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ ye shes pa rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bsdu/ bsngo smon dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// oṃ swā sti/ bka' babs dang po sgron ma rnam gsum gyi byin rlabs su grags pa lha gsum gyi rjes gnang byed par 'dod na/ stegs bu dri bzang gis chags chags btab pa'i steng g.yas phyogs su dkyil 'khor sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar tāṃ ljang*/ mdun gyi 'dab ma nas rim par/ tā/ re/ tuta/ tā/ re/ tu re/ swā hā zhes bri/ dbus su dkyil 'khor (54)'khor lo ser po rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar dhīḥdamar ser/ rtsibs la oṃ/ wā gi shwa ri mūm̐ zhes bri/ g.yon phyogs su dkyil 'khor pad+ma dkar po 'dab drug gi lte bar hrīḥdakar/ 'dab mar oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐ zhes bri/ dkyil 'khor gsum ka'i mthar rdo ra dang me'i ra bas bskor/ dkar gtor gsum dang mchod pa ci bder bsgrigs/ de nas skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dho3 haṃ/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūm̐ yig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/

de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dza:sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas bla ma'i ngo bo mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig dkar po sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod// hūm̐/ chos sku spros bral mkha' dbyings las// longs sku 'ja' tshon lta bur shar// sprul sku 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// sems dpa' rdo rje khyod la bstod// ces bstod/ de nas mdun bskyed ni/ mchod gtor rnams/ stong pa'i ngang (55)las oṃ las rin po che'i snod du āḥlas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi hūm̐ las mkha' khyab tu 'char ba'i 'dod yon gyi sprin chen por gyur/ oṃ ā hūm̐/ lan gsum/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gsum/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid rdzogs pa re rer gyur pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang po'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du tāṃ las skyes pa'i sgrol ma ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis skyil krung phyed pa can/ g.yas mchog sbyin// g.yon ut+pal sngon po'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa dar gyi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs can gyi thugs kar pad zla la gnas pa'i tām̐ yig ljang gus mtshan pa'o// dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i dbus su 'khor lo ser po rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge dmar ser sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ g.yas ral gri/

g.yon ut+pal steng na pu sti 'dzin pa/ nyi zla pad+ma dang seng ge sngon po'i steng na bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing zla ba'i rgyab yol can gyi thugs kar 'khor lo ser po rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar dhīḥyig dmar ser gyis mtshan pa'o// dkyil 'khor gsum pa'i chos 'byung dbus su pad zla'i steng du hrīḥyongs su gyur pa las 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad dkar gyi yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma drug pa'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥdakar pos mtshan par gyur/ rang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad lha gsum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā (56)dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas sgrol ma/ smra seng 'jam dbyangs la mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med rnams kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ sgrol ma'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar pad 'dab bcu la sngags kyi yig 'bru re re gnas pa las 'od 'phros pa'i 'od kyis gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'jigs pa thams cad bsal bar bsams la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bzla/ 'jam dpal gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar rtsibs drug la sngags yig 'bru re re gnas pa las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis mi shes pa'i dri ma bsal bar bsams la/ oṃ wā gī shwa ri mūm̐/ zhes bzla/ spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs ka'i 'dab ma drug la gnas pa'i 'od kyis sdig sgrib thams cad bsal bar bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/

zhes bzla/ mthar dkyil 'khor gsum la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod// bstod pa ni/ oṃ seng ldeng nags la rab gnas shing*// 'gro la bu bzhin rtag par gzigs// 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob mdzad pa// sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal lo// gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po// ye shes sgron mes rab brgyan zhing*// 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba// 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pas// 'jig rten gsum gyi dpag bsam shing*// pad+ma dkar po g.yon na bsnams// rigs sngags 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ gtor ma so (57)so'i sngags mthar/ a kā ro btags pas phul la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus dang*// phyag byas gral du 'khod pa la// sems bskyed dang chos bshad sngar ltar las/ 'dir bka' babs dang po sgron ma'i skor las lha gsum gyi rjes gnang zab mo sgrub pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba grub nas/ da khyed rang gi bya ba thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyor la gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// nyon mongs dri ma rab spangs shing*// yid 'ong gsung gi sgra sgrogs pa// dam pa chos kyi rin chen mdzod// bla mas bdag la stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum/ de nas slob ma sgrol ma snying ga'i sa bon bcas par bskyed la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang po la phog pas sgrol ma pad 'dab kyi yig 'bru dang bcas pa las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon/ khyed rang gi snying nang gi tāṃ la thim pas sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs dang khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gnyis med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod// stong nyid snying rje sgrol ma'i sku// brjod bral phar phyin sgrol ma'i gsung*// ye shes gsal ba sgrol ma'i thugs// sgrub mchog 'di la gnas gyur cig

/ces me tog 'thor zhing dril bu 'khrol/ yang slob ma 'jam dpal du gnas bsgyur la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis pa la phog pas de las 'jam dpal smra seng 'khor lo'i yig 'bru dang bcas pa (58)gnyis pa zhig byon te khyed rang gi snying nang gi dhīḥl thim pas smra seng gi sku gsung thugs dang khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur// stong nyid snying rje smra seng sku// brjod bral phar phyin smra seng gsung*// ye shes gsal ba smra seng thugs// sgrub mchog 'di la gnas gyur cig /ces me tog 'thor zhing dril bu 'khrol/ yang slob ma spyan ras gzigs su gnas bsgyur la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gsum pa la phog pas/ de las lo ke shwa ra pad 'dab kyi yig 'bru dang bcas pa gnyis pa zhig byon te khyed rang gi snying nang gi hrīḥl thim pas lo ke shwa ra'i sku gsung thugs dang khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gnyis med du gyur// stong nyid snying rje'i 'jig rten dbang phyug sku// brjod bral phar phyin 'jig rten dbang phyug gsung*// ye shes gsal ba 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs// skal ldan sgrub mchog 'di la gnas gyur cig /me tog 'thor zhing dril bu 'khrol/ mdun bskyed kyi lha gsum so so'i zhal nas sngags phreng thon khyed rang lha de dang de'i rnam par gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i sa bon la thim par bsams la lha gsum gyi sngags lan gsum bzlar gzhug /spro na bzlas lung gi mthar me tog 'bul sbyin bya zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag gi sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs ji ltar byas kyang mi 'gal lo// dam tshig bzung ba gtong rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /des sgrol ma'i byin rlabs zab mo grub pa lags pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/

dge ba bsngo/ cho ga'i rjes chog spyi ltar bya'o// 'di ni lha gsum gyi rjes gnang khol du phyung nas so sor byed (59)na'ang cho ga'i bsgyur tshul gyi gnad shes par bya'o// dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi dbang chog bklags pas grub pa las/ bka' babs dang po'i dbang dang rjes gnang bshad pa'i le tshan no// dar rgyas 'phel// ༈ //oṃ swa sti/ bka' babs bar pa gsum las/ dang po rma phyag rgya chen po'i smin byed dbang gi cho ga ni/ stegs gtsang ma'i steng dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab bzhi'am/ yang na maṇ+ḍal la me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus su mañji'i khar dpal gyi gtor ma rgyan can bsham/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā was chos thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'od gsal mi shigs pa'i rang gdangs srung ba'i 'khor los yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su bdag dang mdun gyi gtor ma gnyis ka pad nyi zla ba seng ge sngon po la gnas pa'i dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge sku mdog dmar ser sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ phyag g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon ut+pal steng du pu sti bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan zhing zla ba'i rgyab yol can gyi skur gyur pa'i thugs kar dhīḥyig dmar ser 'bar ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs gnyis su med pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ yig rnams kyis mtshan par mos/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur bas bla ma'i ngo bo rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ snying (60)ga'i 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i dhīḥyig sngags phreng gis bskor ba las bdag mdun 'od zer spro bsdus thugs dam bskul zhing mi shes pa'i dri ma sbyangs par bsams la/

oṃ wā gi shwa ri mūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzla/ mchod pa byin rlabs la/ oṃ gu ru mañju shrī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye/ shab+da rnams kyis mchod/ rtsa sngags la/ a kā ro btags pas gtor ma phul/ gzhon nu'i cha lugs 'chang ba po// ye shes sgron mes rab tu brgyan// 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba// 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das rje btsun smra ba'i seng ges bdag dang sems can thams can thams cad la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// de nas slob ma rnams dri'i chu'i khrus dang*/ phyag byas gral du 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed dang chos bshad pa ci rigs sngon du 'gro bas/ dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed bka' babs gsum gyi 'dir bka' bab bar pa/ de la'ang rma lugs phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa/ so lugs sngags bla med kyi gdams pa/ kaṃ lugs pha rol tu phyin pa'i gdams pa// slob bu gzhan la gsungs pa'i gdams pa kha 'thor ba rnams su yod pa las/ 'dir rma lugs/ de la'ang smin byed kyi dbang dang*/ grol byed khrid kyi phyag len/ sgro 'dogs gcod byed rgyab skyor snyan brgyud dang gsum las/ 'dir smin byed dbang bskur ba slob dpon gyi bya ba sgrub mchod grub nas/ da khyed rang gi bya ba thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs smra ba'i (61)seng ge la brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum pa lta bur mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo/ bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs rnams la// dad pa'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal lo// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul// bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa// de dag thams cad so sor bshags// sems can don mdzad rgyal sras gang*// de dag kun la rjes yi rang*// ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar// mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// mgon po thugs rje che ldan rnams// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// 'gro kun bsags pa'i dge ba gang*// byang chub tu ni bdag gis bsngo// zhes lan gsum/

de nas byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni/ 'di ltar thugs la bzhag 'tshal/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can dpag tu med pa 'di thams cad kyis rang cag gi pha ma lan grangs dpag tu med pa zhig byas/ de byas res bzhin phan tshad med pa btags/ gnod pa tshad med pa las skyob pa'i drin can sha thag yin pa la/ 'di thams cad thabs la rmongs pas 'dod pa bde ba 'dod nas sgrub pa sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'bras kho na la spyod pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ de rnams sdug bsngal las bton nas bde ba la 'god nus pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bdag gi bsgrub par bya/ de'i ched du theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi snying po don gyi man ngag phyag rgya chen po'i lam zab mo la 'jug par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed gsal 'debs zhu/ de dag sbyor ba'i cho ga'o// dngos gzhi la gnyis kyi/ dang po mdo la (62)brten te thun mong gi sems bskyed pa la gsum las/ dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyang phyir// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen 'di// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol// zhes lan gsum/ gnyis pa skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa blang ba ni/ thal mo sbyar nas tsog pu'am pus btsugs kyis 'dug la/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas skyabs zhu na ci mdzad bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung nas snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog /zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog

/'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du byang chub sems dpar slob dpon gyis bzung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ des skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i sems bskyed kyi sdom pa thob pa yin pas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya rnams la ci nus kyis slob par gyis shig /gsum pa byang sdom blang ba ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i (63)byang chub la 'god par bya'o snyam pas me tog thogs nas thal mo sbyor la 'di'i rjes zlos/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ skye ba 'di dang*/ skye ba gzhan dang gzhan dag tu sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por sems bskyed par bgyi'o// sems can ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma phyungs pa rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum/ des byang sdom thob pa yin pas/ deng phyin chad byang chub kyi sems dran pa dang*/

gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang*/ sems can blos mi spong ba dang*/ tshogs gsog pa la 'bad pa dang*/ nag po'i chos bzhi spong zhing dkar po'i chos bzhi brten pa la slob par byos shig /de ni mdo ltar thun mong pa'i sems bskyed pa'o// da ni rgyud la brten pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i sems bskyed pa la bzhi las/ (64)dang po sdom pa bzung ba ni/ sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis deng nas bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa yang*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// pad+ma'i rigs mchog chen po la// sangs rgyas zhal nas gsungs pa yi// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// mchod pa'i las rnams bya ba dang*// sdom pa rgya mtsho ma lus kun// shin tu dam par bzung bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum/ des gsang sngags kyi sems bskyed thob pas/

deng phyin chad rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig thams cad la bslab bar byos shig /de nas dbang bskur (65)pa dngos ni bla ma la ci 'byor pa'i yon phul bar mos la maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ byin rlabs zhu ba'i phyir gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// bde gshegs khyod kyi bka' bzhin du// sems can don kun sgrub lags kyis// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas bla ma 'jam dpal smra seng du gsal ba'i zhal nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung ba khyed rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs pas dri ma thams cad sbyangs shing bkrus/ yang thugs ka nas 'od zer me'i rnam pa 'phros pas sems can gyi sdig sgrib dang de las byung ba'i lus ngag kyang bsregs shing sbyangs de nyid shangs bug nas rlung byung bas gtor te snang med stong pa nyid kyi ngang la dar cig bzhag /de nas skad cig gis khyed rang 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge'i skur lam gyis gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas gtor ma 'di nyid kyang ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa 'jam dpal smra ba'i seṅge'i skur gyur pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon pa'i sku las 'od zer sna tshogs byung ba lus la sib sib thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs lus ngag yid gsum la zhugs par bsam du bcug la spos btul zhing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ na mo rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs spyi dang*/ khyad par bla ma 'jam dpal smra ba'i seṅges rdo rje slob ma 'di la da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig /oṃ wā gi shwa ri muṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dbang bskur bas lus kyi sdig sgrib dag nas rang lus dang snang ba (66)thams cad lha sku snang stong dbyer med me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gyur pa ni bum pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas gtor ma'i lha bde ba chen po'i ngo bor zhu bar bsam la gtor zan myang bas ngag gi sdig sgrib dag nas sems gsal stong du shar ba ni gsang dbang ngo*// de ltar myang ba'i bdud rtsis lus gang sems yid kyi sdig sgrib dag nas bde stong gi ye shes 'bar ba ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// de ka'i ngang la lus sems hril gyis bsgrims la/

phaṭa ces brjod pas/ rig pa gzhi thog nas yer gyis bslang*/ mig ma 'gul bar cher gyis ltos/ rig pa 'dir gtad kyi yul med par spob kyis gzhog /gsal brdo ba la shigs kyis bshig la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de ltar bsgom blo bsam gtan gyi gnyen po bshig pas 'das pa'i shes pa 'gags/ ma 'ongs pa'i shes pa ma skyes/ da ltar gyi rig pa gcer bu/ sang nge ba/ rjen ne ba/ lhod de ba/ rang dwangs su lhag ge ba 'di rang blo bral phyag rgya chen po yin pas/ rig pa rjen pa rten med de ka ngos bzung la sgom med du shigs se bor la skyongs shig /des sgo gsum phra ba'i sgrib pa dag nas sems nyid gshis thog ngo 'phrod par 'gyur te dbang bzhi pa'o// des rma lugs phyag rgya chen po snying po don gyi dbang bskur ba grub pa yin pas gtong rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de lta bu'i dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu smon lam gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed par bgyi// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /slar yang mchod bstod byas la/ oṃ/ lhag (67)pa dang ni chad pa dang*// bdag gis brjed ngas gang bgyis pa// gang phyir lus can mgon gyur pa// mgon po khyed kyis bzod par gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis nongs pa bshags/ dkyil 'khor gshegs bsdu dang*/ bsngo shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// ༈ //oṃ swa sti/ bka' babs bar pa'i nang tshan so lugs bla ma'i byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su mañji'i khar gtor zlum 'khor bzhis bskor ba dang*/ bdud rtsi'i thod pa bshams/ mtha' mchod pa ci 'byor bas bskor/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung ba'i 'khor lo mi phyed par bcings pa'i dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang nyid jo bo thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/

phyag dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ 'og ma gnyis shel phreng dang pad dkar gyi sdong bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar pad 'dab bzhi'i lte bar hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba/ hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros ri bo po ta la nas mgon po spyan ras gzigs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+das mchod/ hrīḥ 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa// 'jig rten gsum gyi dpag bsam shing*// pad+ma (68)dkar po g.yon na bsnams// rig sngags 'chad la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa la ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ snang grags 'gyu gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par shar bar bsam la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzla/ de nas mdun gyi gtor ma mi dmigs pa las rang gi spyi bo'i thad ka'i nam mkhar pad+ma 'dab bzhi pa yongs su rgyas pa'i dbus su rin po che'i khri pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i rje btsun dam pa rgya gar ba sku mdog smug la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ gcer bu mchog tu 'bar ba'i gzi byin can/ ras kyi aṃ rag gsol zhing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing*/ snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i lta stangs mdzad pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma bzhi la g.yas su thub dbang*/ g.yon du 'jam dpal dbyangs/ mdun du spyan ras gzigs/ rgyab tu rdo rje phag mo dmar mo rnams bzhugs pa'i mtha' bskor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems/

dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad sprin phung gtib pa ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstims la/ mchod pa raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod du āḥlas mchod rdzas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rol pa hūm̐ gis mkha' khyab tu 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i// mchod pa ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba'i (69)dngos po kun// rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swa hā/ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ gang gis 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni// dran pa tsam gyis rab bsal nas// bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa// bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs ka nas thugs rje chen po'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad la thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i bdag nyid kyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhrī gu ru dharma kā ya sid+dhi hūm̐ oṃ āḥhrī gu ru sam+bho kā ya sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru ni rma kā ya sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi rig pa dri med kyi don rtogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus dang phyag byas/ gral du 'khod pa las/ sngon gtor btang zhing mtshams bcad nas/

sems bskyed dang chos bshad ci rigs sngon du 'gro bas/ dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed la bka' babs gsum las/ 'dir bka' babs bar pa zhes rje btsun dam pa rgya gar ba'i thugs kyi sras gtso bor snang ba rma so kam gsum las/ 'dir so dge 'dun 'bar la gsungs pa so lugs su grags pa de lags/ de'ang smin grol gyi gdams pa gnyis las/ 'dir smin byed dbang gi tshul du bla ma'i byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba la slob dpon gyi bya ba grub nas/ (70)da khyed rang gi bya ba thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas te thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong dang*// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol// zhes gsum/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun dam pa rgya gar ba la brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum du sad pa'i spyan sngar ci mdzad bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag gis deng nas byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum/ gzhan don rlabs po che sgrub pa'i lhag bsam brtan pos/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// lan gsum/ tshogs zhing khyad par can rnams kyi drung du tshogs bsags pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dmigs bcas dmigs med gnyis su med pa yi// rang rig bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod bya mchod byed dbyer med zung 'jug dngos// rnam dag chos kyi sku la mchod par 'bul// nyon mongs ye shes blang dor med pa yi// rig pa dri med ngang du sdig kun bshags// ye nas sangs rgyas blo yis ma bcos pa// bcing grol med par skyong la yi rang ngo// sems nyid gdod nas dag pa chos sku'i klong*// rtsol med (71)yang dag dran pa'i chos 'khor bskor// bde sdug la sogs rkyen dang 'phrad pa'i tshe// sgom pa mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// dge ba 'khor gsum dmigs med dag pa yis// mtshan 'dzin med par byang chub chen por bsngo// bya byed med par bya ba kun rdzogs pa'i// chos nyid spros bral rgyun du skyong bar shog

/ces gsum/ ba spu ldang zhing mchi ma 'khrugs pa'i mos gus kyis gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ mnyam rjes kun tu 'od gsal 'ba' zhig dang*// gang yang ma skyes ci yang ma 'gag par// mkhyen gnyis ldan pa'i 'gro mgon rin po che// drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs// rig pa dri med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// zhes brjod// de dag ni dbang gi sngon 'gro'o// dngos gzhi la mdun gyi gtor ma 'di nyid pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su gdan bzhi rdzogs la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas gzi brjid mchog tu 'bar ba'i g.yas su thub dbang*/ g.yon du 'jam dbyangs/ mdun du spyan ras gzigs/ rgyab tu phag mo rnams la brgyud pa'i bum sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba bzhugs par mos la 'di'i rjes/ kyai dam pa rje btsun rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ khyed rang skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i rnam pa can du gyur pa'i spyi bor gtor ma rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi rnam pa can du (72)byon pa de nyid la mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab pas/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i sku'i cha thams cad las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la thim pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub char ltar babs nas rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos 'thul zhing rol ma'i sgra dang bcas pas gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams// thugs rje brtse bas 'dir dgongs shig

/skal ldan rigs kyi bu 'di la// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mchog thun dngos grub char ltar phob// rig pa dri med rtogs par mdzod// oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥhrīḥgu ru sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas lus kyi sdig sgrib dag nas/ lus lha sku 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur pas bum pa'i dbang rdzogs/ phrin las bzhi la dbang thob par gyur pa'o// de nas khyed rang spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su mkha' 'gro ma gsum gyi rang bzhin rtsa gsum gsal ba'i steng du pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rje btsun dam pa'i sku gzi mdangs dang ldan pa/ lte 'og rtsa gsum 'dus mdor rdo rje dmar po mtshon gang pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsgom la rlung kha sbyor du bcings pas rdo rje de 'dar khril li li gnas pa'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ yig dpag med spros pa dbu ma'i lam brgyud tshangs bug nas 'thon mkha' 'gro dpag tu med par gyur snyam du bsam par bya zhing*/ de'i tshe gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa mdas pa'i mos pa'ang mdzod/ bdud (73)rtsi byin te/ oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi myang bas ngag sgrib dag nas gsang dbang rdzogs/ rtsa rlung sgom pa la dbang thob par gyur pa'o// de nas tshangs bug nas 'thon pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis me tog la sogs pa phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin spyi bo'i bla ma la phul bas/ bla ma dgyes pa chen pos bzhad cing sku'i gnas gsum las bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum 'od zer gyi tshul du byung ba khyed rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas lus sems bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bor bde khril gyis gang zhing khyab par bsam du bcug la/ spos rol bya zhing nyams spar/ des yid sgrib dag nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang rdzogs/

bde stong lhan skyes kyi ye shes sgom pa la dbang thob pa'o// de ltar nyams 'bar na de ka ra zhig bskyang du bcug /rjes su de'i ngang la lhod kyis klod pas mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin shugs kyis 'char/ de la ngo sprod de/ 'o khyod kyi shes pa la da lta ci dran par 'dug /sngar byin rlabs byas dus kyang ji 'dra zhig dran byung*/ de ngos bzung la ltos dang bltas pa bde dang de'i cho rnam par rtog pa gang yang yid la mi 'gyu zhing gsal rig rjen pa ye re ba zhig snang na de ka sems nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal lam rang rig dri med chos sku phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba de yin pas de ltar yid la mi byed pa'i shes pa dwangs sang nge ba la gnas pa de ni khyed cag bla ma'i dwangs ma thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du bcug pa lags kyis/ e ma'o yid la mi byed pa'i shes pa de ka rig pa dri ma med pa'i 'od gsal du 'dug snyam du nges shes skyes pa de ni nang gi dkyil 'khor du tshud nas chos nyid don gyi dbang thob pa ste/ sku gdung 'bar ba'i rgyud las/ gang la stong (74)nyid 'di rung bas// de la thams cad rung ba yin// stong nyid rtogs par gyur na ni// dbang rnams bskur bar gyur pa yin/ zhes dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ 'od gsal ba yi go 'phang thob// he ru ka dpal yang dag gnas// zhes gsungs/ des bag chags kyi sgrib pa dag nas tshig dbang rin po che rdzogs/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i don rjen par rtogs pa la dbang thob pa'o// de rnams kyis ni bla ma'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du don gyi dbang bzhi thob pas sgrib bzhi dag zung 'jug gi lam sgom pa dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang la sbyor ba'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag pa yin no// slar yang brtan par bya ba'i phyir gtor ma'i lha la mos gus byas pas lha tshogs 'od du zhu nas so so rang rang la thim/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs rang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med pa'i rang la mnyam par bzhag go

/de yang nga las ak+ṣa lnga bcu brjod pas/ snang grags dran pa'i chos thams cad bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol par shes pa dang rtag tu mi 'bral bar gyis shig /ces brjod/ de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyis dam tshig bzung*/ gtong rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /bsngo ba bya zhing*/ cho ga'i rjes chog rnams kyang sngar gyi 'gros kyis shes par bya'o// dar rgyas 'phel/// /oṃ swa sti/ bka' babs bar pa'i nang tshan gsum pa skam lugs ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i gdams pa yin pas dbang gi chos sgo 'byed pa la mi ltos mod/ 'on kyang bla ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes su bka' babs dang po'i lha lnga'i ya gyal yum sher phyin ma'i rjes gnang 'dir mdzad pa ltar spro na/ stegs bu dris chag chag btab pa la dkyil 'khor sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar zla ba'i dkyil (75)'khor nya gang pa la dhīḥyig ser pos mtshan pa bri/ dkar gtor dang mchod pa ci bder bshams la/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ rang gi snying ga'i dhīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas yum chen mo la sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar sad par bsam la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs kyis rgyun bshags bya/ de nas bdag mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gnyis ka swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag mdun gnyis ka paṃ las pad+ma dang āḥlas zla ba'i steng du dhīḥyig ser po de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ pu sti dang bcas pa'i ut+pal sngon po'i sdong bu g.yon logs na 'dzin pa/ dar bzang po'i stod g.yogs dang na bzas brgyan pa/ ral pa'i cod pan la brten pa'i mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i dhīḥser po/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs pa la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang dang mdun bskyed kyi dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ yig rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ bdag mdun gyi thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i dhīḥyig sngags phreng gis bskor ba rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i 'od kyis 'khor 'das kyi shes rab phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus te rang la (76)thim pas mi shes pa'i dri ma sangs par mos la/ dhīḥshru ti smri ti bi dza ye swā hā/ zhes bzlas/ mthar mchod gtor rnams bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ smra bsam brjod med sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma rang sngags la a kā ro btags pas phul la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus dang phyag byas gral du 'khod la/ sems bskyed chos bshad ji ltar rigs pa bshad la/ 'dir bka' babs bar pa rma so skam gsum las/ 'dir skam lugs pha rol du phyin pa'i gdams pa 'debs pa'i sngon du bla ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes ltar sher phyin ma'i rjes gnang zab mo sgrub par byed pa yin/ de la'ang gnyis las/ slob dpon gyi sgrub mchod grub nas/ da khyed rang gi bya ba thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ nyon mongs dri ma rab spangs shing*// yid 'ong gsung gi sgra sgrog pa// dam pa chos kyi rin chen mdzod// bla mas bdag la stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams mi dmigs pa las/

pad zlar dhīḥlas yum chen mo gser mdog chos 'chad dang pu stis mtshan pa'i ut+pal bsnams pa'i snying gar zla ba la dhīḥyig ser pos mtshan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la phog pas yum chen mo'i thugs ka'i zla ba sngags kyi yig 'bru dang bcas pa mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon/ khyed rang gi snying ga'i dhīḥyig la thim (77)pas yum chen mo'i sku gsung thugs dang*/ khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ stong nyid snying rje yum chen sku// brjod bral phar phyin yum gyi gsung*// ye shes gsal ba yum gyi thugs// sgrub mchog 'di la gnas gyur cig /ces me tog 'thor zhing dril bu 'khrol/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi zhal nas sngags phreng thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs// snying ga'i dhīḥyig la thim pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ dhīḥshru ti smṛ ti bi dza ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos// bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad bu gsol// zhes me tog 'di nyid byin gyis brlabs nas spyi bor phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// de nas gtso bos sogs kyis dam tshig bzung*// gtong rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /bsngo ba bya/ cho ga'i rjes chog sngar ltar bya'o// dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi dbang chog bklags pas grub pa las/ bka' babs bar pa rma so skam gsum gyi gtor dbang dang rjes gnang le tshan no// dar rgyas 'phel// oṃ swa sti/ na mo gu ru shrī badz+ra ḍā ki ni bh+yaḥ'adir dam pa'i chos sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi rtsa ba bka' babs phyi ma las/ dri med thigs pa phyag bzhes kyi skor zhes byang chub sems dpa' kun dga'i lugs kyi rten ma smin pa smin par byed pa lam lnga'i glegs bam gyi dbang bskur ba ni/

dbang thob cing grangs dus rtags kyi bsnyen pa gang rung thems pa'i slob dpon gyis snod ldan gyi slob bu rjes su 'dzin par 'dod pas/ thog mar ā li kā li'i sta gon du gnas par (78)bya ste/ rgyu gser zangs sogs la phul du byas pa'am/ gzhi ji ltar rigs la gser dngul lta bus bris pas kyang rung ste/ ā li bcu drug tshan bzhi/ sde pa lnga/ mthar gnas/ dro ba'i sha ṣa sa dang*/ ha k+ṣaḥste tshan pa bcu gnyis su byas pa bris la/ skar ma rgyal gyi nyin gza' tshes legs pa la rab gnas brgya rtsa brgyad bya/ de nas dben pa'i gnas su mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas te/ stan bde ba la 'dug pa'i mdun du maṇ+ḍal gyi steng yi ge lnga bcu po nas dang bsres nas thod pa mtshan ldan du blugs la bkod/ 'phang lo thi gu dang bcas pa phyogs bzhir bzhag la oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥgu ru sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes 'bum phrag bzhi bzla ste/ bsnyen pa'o// de nas mi skad mi thos pa'i dben par song la/ thod pa de thod pa gcig gi nang du bcug /steng nas thod pa gzhan zhig bkab ste dar dmar gyis dril la mdun du me long gi khar bzhag cing*/ 'phang los mtha' bskor te/ oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru sid+dhi pha la/ shān+tiṃ/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ pā shaṃ /karma ku ru hūm̐/ zhes 'bum phrag gnyis bzlas te/ sgrub pa'o// de nas thod pa de nyid shes rab ma ste rang gi phyag rgya ma'am grong pas ma gos pa'i bu mo/ de dag med na rang gi lag g.yon pas blangs te/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal la mngal khrag dang sin+dhū ras chos 'byung bris pa'i steng du bzhag la/ gnas de dur khrod du byin gyis rlobs shing bsgom nas/ oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru pra ma ṇa ye dzi na mai tri bhu hu ku ru hūm̐/ zhes 'bum phrag gcig bzlas te/ las sbyor ro// de nas rang gi spyi bor bzung ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥzhes stong phrag bzhi/ de bzhin du/ mdzod spu/ ol mdud/

snying ga /lte ba/ gsang gnas rnams su bzhag nas sngags de stong phrag re re bzla ste/ dngos grub len pa'o// de nas (79)mdun du bzhugs su bcug la mchod bstod gtor ma dbul/ bkra shis brjod do// de ltar byas pas bdag nyid rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po zhes bya ba'i ming thob cing*/ gzhan nus ldan du byad pa bla ma'i ldang tshad de bsnyen pa kha gso ba dang mthun pa yin gsung ngo*// de ltar rang gi bya ba rnams legs par tshar nas/ slob ma las 'phro can che ba bzhi ldan te bla ma la gus pa/ dkon mchog la dad pa/ shes rab dang snying rje chen po'i slob ma la rim pa gsum las/ 'dir dang po dbang brtul gyi gang zag smin par byed pa las/ dbang lnga'i dang po blo sbyong gi dbang ni/ dus gza' skar tshes grangs bzang po'i nyi ma la/ nyams dga' zhing bar chad med pa'i gnas dben par/ gnas khang phyags dar byas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi rten rnams khri bkod legs pa la bzhugs su gsol/ bla ma'i mdun du bram ze'am dge slong gtsang ma'i lag nas byung ba'am/ dur khrod nas byung ba'i ras dmar po bting ba'i steng du sher phyin gyi glegs bam bzhag la 'bras dkar ram nas bzang

bre brgyad las mi nyung ba pos gcer ba glegs bam gyi dbyibs su bzhengs/ de'i steng logs la 'bras sogs kyi phye dkar pos / glang chenu / sna ber ka ris lta bu dang*/ bcod kyi ru ru gshibs // shad gnyis pa lta bu dang*/ zla tshesaṃ / tshig gu gnyis lta bu dang*/ skar mda' ?ཾ kha thig gnyis rgyug pa lta bu dang*/ nyi zla shar baṃ ltaṃ bu mig kor gnyis dang*/ ā li kā li cha lnga dpe chung ltar bri/ de'i thig khongs su chud par rin po che las grub pa'i ak+ṣaḥlnga bcu'i byang bu rab gnas can gyis bskor la dgram/ de'i dbus su thod pa mtshan ldan du chang bzang po la bdud rtsi ril bu btab cing phrad du (80)ram bzang po dang sbyar ba bkod la dar dmar gyis kha bcad/ steng du rgyal ba yum gyi bla re lha'am a rang la zhal bstan pa dbub pa'ang phyag len la gnang*/ glegs bam gyi mtha'i phyogs mtshams su 'bras sam nas kyi phye ma dkar pos pad+ma 'dab brgyad dris pa dur khrod brgyad du mos la/ de rnams kyi steng du phyogs skyong la gtor ma/ mkha' 'gro la sha chen/ zhing skyong la srung skud/ grub thob la phreng ba rnams bkod de dur khrod kyi rdzas su mos/ mtha' ci 'byor ba'i mchod pas bskor/ las bzhi'i 'brang rgyas/ shar du dkar zlum/ lhor gru bzhi ser/ nub tu zla gam dmar/ byang du gru gsum nag po rnams bshams/ gzhan yang dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i gtor ma bzhi rgyan bcas pa dang*/ bza' bca' btung ba la sogs pa'i tshogs kyi yo byad rnams ci bder bshams mo// de nas rang nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ sngon gtor ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod du āḥlas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi hūm̐ gis mkha' khyab tu 'phel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis gtor ma bsngos la/ phyogs skyong pa bcu dang gzhi bdag dkar phyogs pa rnams la 'bul lo// phan pa dang bde ba'i sems kyis stong grogs mdzod cig

/gang dag sdang ba dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa log par blta ba'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad kyang gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig /ces gtor ma phyir dor ro// oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba drwa ba gur dang bla bres gtams pa las ye shes kyi me 'bar bas cis kyang mi shigs par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis tshogs zhing rnams (81)mdun gyi nam mkhar sad par bsam la/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro// shes rab snying rje dang bcas pas// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bgyis nas// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral gyur cig /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// btang snyoms mchog la gnas par shog /ces gsum dang*/ na mo// bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs bcas la// dang ba'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal lo// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul// bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa// de dag thams cad so sor bshags// sems can don mdzad rgyal sras gang*// de dag kun la rjes yi rang*// ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar// mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// mgon po thugs rje che ldan rnams// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// 'gro kun bsags pa'i dge ba gang*// byang chub tu ni bdag gis bsngo// zhes lan gsum gyis bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag go /swa bhā was chos thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs te ye shes kyi tshogs so// 'di rtsa bar/ rang lha gang yin gyi bskyed bzlas bya bar bshad kyang*/

phyag len du bdag med ma bsgoms par mdzad pas de'i dbang du byas te/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje srung ba'i gur khang ye shes kyi me 'bar (82)bas yongs su bskor ba'i nang pad nyi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su pad nyi ro'i gdan la oṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa'i gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs shing khro 'dzum bzhad pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'khyil ba gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa gar dgu'i nyams kyis sgeg pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐ yig rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ye shes pa dam tshig pa la ro gcig tu gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga yab yum gyi thugs ka nas byung ba'i yum lngas byang chub sems kyi chus gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i oṃ yig sngags phreng gis bskor ba las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i 'khor lor sbyangs par bsam la/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ swā hā/ zhes bzlas shing*/ des skyon rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par (83)bsam la/

mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i mchod snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su āḥyig zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams 'dod yon gyi rol mor 'char ba'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can hūm̐ yig gis yul dus tshad med par 'phel ba'i mchod sprin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bdun nam gsum gyis brlabs la/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod rdzas ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di// rje btsun bcom ldan 'das mar 'bul// oṃ nai rat+sā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lā+o ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da/ zhes bcug pa dang*/ nang mchod 'bru gsum gyis phul la/ bstod pa ni// rnam dag dri med dbyings las sku sprul zhing*// sgyu ma'i sku mchog mdzes pa'i cha lugs 'chang*// rab brjid gar gyis rnam par brgyan pa mo// 'gro ba'i yid 'phrog rnam dag sku la bstod// brjod med ngang las sprul pa'i gsung mchog ni// grags stong ngo bo gnyis med brag cha'i sgra// 'gro kun thar lam bde la 'god mdzad pa'i// rnam dag dri bral gsung la gus pas 'dud// mi rtog dbyings nas thugs rje'i 'od zer 'phro// mthar phyin thabs kyi mdzad pas gdul bya sgrol// dpag med yon tan du ma'i mchog mnga' ba// thugs mchog yon tan phrin las bcas la 'dud// ces bstod/ de nas tshogs rdzas rnams raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ las tshogs rdzas bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin/ hūm̐ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te thim pas 'dod yon gyi rnam pa cir yang 'char bar bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum brjod pas (84)byin gyis brlabs/ de nas glegs bam byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho zhes pas 'og min gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi glegs bam spyan drangs te thim par bsam la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥzhes bzhi brgya bzlas/ yang sngags rgyas ye shes kyi yig 'bru ā li kā li lnga bcu'i rnam par spyan drangs par bsam la/ a k+ṣa lnga bcu po lan bzhi bzlas nas bla ma chos kyi sku'i ngo bor byin gyis brlab bo// yang thod pa'i bdud rtsi brlab pa ni/ bdud rtsi'i steng du zla ba'i gdan la yi dam gyi sa bon aṃ yig 'bar ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang yab yum spyan drangs/ bdag gi slob ma 'di dag smin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang sems dkar dmar babs pas thod pa khengs par bsam la/ a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes pa bzhi brgya bzlas rjes/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mang du bzlas pas dkrugs shing rgyas btab la bzhag go /yang sngags rgyas phrin las bzhi grub pa'i rdzas de spyan drangs 'brang rgyas la thim par bsam la/ shān+ting ku ru swā hā/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ba shaṃ ku ru swā hā/ rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas phrin las thogs med du 'grub pa'i rdzas su gyur par bsam zhing*/ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ zhes kyang bzlas so// de nas slob ma rnams khrus dang phyag byas nas gral du 'khod pa la/ 'o rgyu sems can la 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis dam pa'i chos rin po che nyams su len dgos la/ de yang gang zag blo'i rim pa mi gcig pa la dgongs nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis theg pa sna tshogs gsungs pa las/ 'dir theg pa chen po/ de la'ang sngags mtshan nyid gnyis las 'dir sngags gtso bor ston pa/ de la'ang rgyud sde rin po che bzhi las (85)'dir bla med de la gsum las 'di snying po don gyi rgyud/ 'di nyams su blangs pas grub pa thob pa'i gang zag dpag med byon pa las 'dir ni dam pa rin po che'i lugs dam pa'i chos spyi'i ming bye brag la btags nas// spyi ming sgos su thob pa'i chos sdug bsngal zhi byed/

de la yang snga phyi bar gsum las 'di ni zhi byed brgyud pa phyi ma bya ba/ sgo ba'i rnal 'byor pa bzhi la gsungs pa las/ 'di bla ma byang chub sems dpa' kun dga'i lugs te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gdams ngag /gsang sngags dang rjes su mthun pa/ rtsa ba dang brgyud la bskur ba/ snying po'i don thabs rten 'brel gyi che ba du mas brgyan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa thams cad stan gcig gi steng du dus gcig la nyams su len pa dri med thig pa phyag bzhes kyi skor bya ba de lags/ 'di 'chad pa la yan lag lnga ste/ yid ches bskyed pa gtam rgyud kyi yan lag /rten smin par byed pa dbang gi yan lag /nyams skye bar byed pa khrid kyi yan lag /rtogs pa 'char bar byed pa bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi yan lag /spros pa gcod byed tshig tshogs kyi yan lag dang lnga las/ 'dir rten ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang gi yan lag gi skabs yin pas/ thog mar dbang zhu ba'i yon tu maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ ces maṇ+ḍal phul du gzhug /de nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas te thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po che/ bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas bla mas/ khyed rnams sems can gyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du ā li kā li'i byin rlabs yi ge phyi mo'i dbang bskur lhan cig skyes pa bzhi rdzogs zhus la nyams su (86)blang snyams pas ma yengs par gsan 'tshal/ de'ang dbang 'khor rtsa ba las/ gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su/ bla mas lhag pa'i lha mchod cing tshogs mchod glegs bam byin gyis brlab par bya'o// de nas sems bskyed par ldan pas theg pa'i rim pa ngos bzung la/ snying po don gyi che ba brjod par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa las lag tu blang bde ba'i phyir de rnams gsol 'debs kyi gong du grub pas/

da khyad 'phags lnga'i sgo nas las can spro ba bskyed par bya ste/ dri med thig pa phyag bzhes kyi skor 'di nyams su len pa la/ dbyings rnal 'byor gsum du gnas te/ dang po bya ba gzhi'i rnal 'byor rten sdom pa gsum ldan du byas nas rnal 'byor gyi rang sa drug mnyams par bsrung*/ de'i steng nas byed pa lam gyi rnal 'byor 'phags pa'i lam rim pa lnga dka' thub rnam pa gsum gyi srang nas bton pas/ mthar bya bral 'bras bu'i rnal 'byor sangs rgyas sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur ba la tshegs med pa lags/ 'di la'ang lam rim pa lnga las/ da res kyi dbang 'di tshogs lam bgrod par byed pa blo sbyong gi dbang dang byin rlabs bya ba de yin/ 'di ni dbang bskur ba gzhan las khyad par lngas 'phags pa yin te/ dang po dkyil 'khor mi bshams glegs bam bshams pas khyad par 'phags te/ dkyil 'khor ni lha dbang lus la bskur ba'i rten tsam yin la/ glegs bam ni chos dbang sems la bskur ba yin pas khyad par 'phags/ 'di la gsum las/ ri mo gzugs kyi glegs bam sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi zhing khams/ mtha' bskor rtogs pa don gyi glegs bam sku gsum gyi dgongs pa/ rgyab na mtshon byed sgra'i glegs bam gsung rab rin po che sku gsum gyi phrin las/ de ltar glegs bam 'di mthong ba (87)tsam gyis skyon thams cad 'dags shing yon tan thams cad 'byung ba yin no// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sa tshon mi 'grem bar glegs bam gyi steng du yig 'bru bkram pas 'phags te/ sa tshon gyis ye shes lnga'i mdangs las mi mtshon la/ yig 'bru ni ye shes dngos su rgyud la skye bar byed pa'i sa bon yin pas yang dag pa'i lam rim/ bde bar gshegs pa'i zhal ngo// 'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa ba/ mthong bas chog pa'i lam yin no// gsum pa dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bum pa mi 'cha' bar glegs bam gyi steng du bhan+dha

'cha' bas 'phags te/ bum pa ni bzo bos gsar du bsgrubs shing rdzas chus byas pas bde bar gshegs pa'i rten rdzas tsam yin la/ bhan+dha ni rang byung lhun grub bsam 'phel gyi nor bu rin po che/ 'di'i nang du blugs pa'i bdud rtsi byang sems ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par byed pa'i dam rdzas te/ thin pas chog pa'i rtsi/ rdzas gcig gis thugs dam skong bar byed pa yin no// bzhi pa dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo lhas ma byas par glegs bam gyi gtso bo bla mas byas nas dbang bskur bas 'phags te/ lhas sems kyi sgro 'dogs dngos su mi chod la/ bla mas dngos su gcod de rab rtogs ldan gyi bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byed pa po/ 'bring nyams myong dang ldan pa'i bla ma ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam 'phrul/ tha ma gdams ngag dang ldan pa'i bla mas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las tsam sgrub nus pa yin no// lnga pa dbang bzhi gyer thabs su mi bskur bar ngo sprod du bskur bas 'phags te/ gyer thabs ni don spyi la brten pa lam mos sgom tsam yin la/ ngo sprod kyi lam dngos su rdzogs par byed pa yin te/ slob ma rab dbang bskur ba'i dus de nyid rtogs thob (88)dus mnyam du 'grol nus/ 'bring gis rtsa bral gyi don rnyed/ tha mas kyang byang sems kyi ngo bo mthong nges pa yin no// de ltar khyad du 'phags pa'i dbang 'di rgya bod kyi mkhas pa gzhan la ma grags shing*/ sngon chad bod du'ang ma 'gyur ba'i khyad chos dam pa rin po ches bod kyi gdul bya rnams la thugs rjes dgongs nas/ phyi sde snod gsum gyi snying phyung*/ nang rgyud sde bzhi'i srog bcad/ gsang ba snying po don gyi mig phye/ de kho na nyid mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi bka' rgya bkrol nas/ phyi rabs kyi don du bla ma byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' la chig brgyud du gnang ba yin/ de lta bu'i byin rlabs 'di la dbang gi chu bo chen po bzhi ru yod pa las/

thog mar bum dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku rdo rje 'chang gis longs sku lha mo bdag med 'di ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ sems nyid kyi gshis skye ba med pa'i glegs bam la rtsal ma 'gags rtogs pa'i ri mo shar ba de la/ thabs ma yengs par dran pa'i dbang bskur mdzad par gda'/ bdag med mas sprul sku dam pa rin po che la 'di ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ shing tā la bdun srid tsam gyi bar snang la bzhugs te/ phyag mdzub kyis bar snang la nam mkha' don gyi glegs bam bris nas/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod tshogs dngos su sprul nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/ sprul pa'i sku dam pa rin po ches bla ma byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' la 'bras dkar brdal ba'i glegs bam la dung gi yig 'bru bkod nas mchod tshogs phun sum tshogs pa bcas nas dbang bzhi bskur/ tshul de kho na bzhin du rim par bla ma byang chub sems dpa' mkhas btsun spa tshab sgom pa la/ des rgyal ba te ne la/ des zhig po nyi ma seṅge sku mched la/ des thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams dpal la/ des rgyal sras kun dga' sku mched la/ des mtshan ldan ri khrod (89)dbang phyug la/ des mkhan chen tshul khrims phan pa la/ des drin can sangs rgyas dbon po la/ de dang rgyal sras kun dga' sku mched kyi slob ma rgya ston smon lam shes rab gnyis kyis/ chos rje kun mkhyen sku mched la/ des rgya sgom rdo rje gdan pa la/ des byang sems rgya mtsho sbyin pa la/ des sku gsum bde chen lhun grub la/ des mkhas grub nam mkha' bzang po la/ des 'jam dbyangs dpal 'byor lhun grub la/ des khyab bdag dpal 'byor phun tshogs la/ des mtshungs med bkra shis bzang po la/ des ding ri ba chen po rje btsun blo gros brtan pa la/ des bdag la gnang ba lags te byin rlabs snod gcig nas gcig tu blugs pa lta bu'i lugs yin pas/ khyed kyis kyang 'di'i nang bzhin nyams su blangs na/

nyams rtogs/ lam rtags/ yon tan rnams mar me gcig nas gcig tu spar ba ltar 'char ba'i bka' srol 'gran zla dang bral ba lags pas/ bka' brgyud dri ma med pa// sgrub brgyud thams cad kyi lan tshwa/ mthong bas chog pa'i lam/ zin pas chog pa'i rtsi/ shes pas chog pa'i gnad/ 'phrad pas chog pa'i brgyud pa 'di la na so la rgan gzhon nam/ dbang po la rno brtul lam/ gang zag la nye ring med par phan thogs te/ dbul phongs/ nad pa zhwa long rgan byis gang yin yang rung*/ dbang 'di dang 'phrad pa thams cad skal ldan yin par gsungs pas/ 'di re 'tshengs snyam du thugs la spro ba bskyed par mdzad 'tshal/ cho ga dngos la gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba rten sdom pa gsum ldan du byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mchod pa bsngo ba smon lam dang bcas pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs par (90)'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du yang bla ma dam pa rnams la mos pa dang gus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yi dam gyi lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du yang yi dam gyi lha tshogs rnams la mos pa dang gus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du yang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams la mos pa dang gus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gcig tu bsdus te bla ma la dbul bar bgyi'o// bla ma la phul bas bla ma rin po che rnams kyi thugs dgongs khyad par can yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig
