/de las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi spyan lam du mchod pa'i bye brag nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 'byung bar gyur cig /de las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de sems can thams cad la thun mong du bsngo bar bgyi'o// de ltar bsngos pas sems can thams cad 'khor ba srid pa sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig /de ma thob kyi bar du yang bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas 'gro ba ma lus pa mtha' dag gi bla ma byed par gyur cig /de kho na bzhin du grub par gyur cig /ces lan gsum/ (91)de ltar mchog tu gyur pa'i skyabs 'gro// bla na med pa'i sems bskyed/ ngo mtshar can gyi mchod pa/ gzhan don du 'gyur nges kyi bsngo ba/ sems can dang mi phyed pa'i smon lam dang lnga po 'di rang la thugs dam mdzad na yang lam lnga'i nyams rtogs thams cad skye ba yin gsung ngo*// dngos gzhi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur ba la bzhi las/ dang po lus kyi sgrib pa dag nas/ sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob par bya ba dang*/ de ma thob kyi bar du'ang phung khams skye mched la sogs pa snang grags dran pa'i chos thams cad bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas par byin gyis brlabs nas/ dag pa'i snang ba yul drug la sbyang ba'i phyir glegs bam gyi yig 'bru la brten nas bum pa'i dbang bzhi bskur ba las/ dang po thur mas brda sprad pa'i yig 'bru la mig ma yengs par ltos la gzugs su snang ba thams cad ngo bo bla ma'i sku la rnam pa yi ger shes par byos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ a k+ṣa lnga bcu la rin po che'i thur ma rim par btsugs la/ a ā/ i ī/ u u/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/

pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa/ ha k+ṣaḥ zhes rjes zlos kyis bak+ṣag /de ni snang ba gzugs kyi ā li kā li'i byin rlabs bya ba yin pas/ dbang gang gis thob na/ yig 'bru la mig lta zhing bla ma'i rjes zlos byas pas thob/ ngo ji ltar 'phrod na mig gi yul du mthong ba'i gzugs thams cad yi ge bla ma'i sku ru ngo 'phrod/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku ru ngo 'phrod do// 'bras bu gang 'byung na/ phyi yul gyi snang ba thams cad ngo sprod du 'char ba yin no// gnyis pa sgra thams cad ngo bo bla ma'i (92)gsung la rnam pa yi ger shes pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ thur ma btsugs nas/ ak+ṣa brjod/ de ni grags pa sgra'i ā li kā li'i byin rlabs bya ba yin pas/ dbang gang gis thob na yi ge klog pa'i gsung rna bar lhang lhang thos pas thob/ ngo ji ltar 'phrod na/ rna ba'i yul du thos pa'i sgra thams cad yi ge/ yi ge bla ma chos kyi sku'i gsung ngo 'phrod/ 'bras bu gang 'byung na/ phyi yul du grags pa'i sgra thams cad gnad kyi gdams pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba yin no// gsum pa dran rtog ci 'gyus thams cad ngo bo bla ma'i thugs la rnam pa yi ger shes pas 'di'i rjes= thur ma bcugs la ak+ṣa brjod/ de ni dran pa sems kyi ā li kā li'i byin rlabs bya ba yin pas/ dbang gang gis thob na bla ma'i gsung la yid gtad de dran pa ma yengs pas thob/ ngo ji ltar 'phrod na/ dran pa'i rnam rtog ci 'gyus thams cad yi ge/ yi ge bla ma chos sku'i thugs su ngo 'phrod/ 'bras bu gang 'byung na/ dran rtog thams cad rtags dang yon tan/ ting nge 'dzin dang sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje ru 'char ba yin no// bzhi pa snang grag 'gyu ba thams cad kyang rang gi sems nyid stong pa'i rang rtsal tsam du shes pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ thur ma btsugs la/ ak+ṣa brjod/ de ni yang dag don gyi ā li kā li'i byin rlabs bya ba yin pas/

dbang gang gis thob na dran pa ma yengs pa'i steng du bla ma la mos gus dung re byas pas thob/ ngo ji ltar 'phrod na/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems/ sems nyid gdod nas stong pa nyid/ stong nyid chos kyi skur ngo 'phrod/ 'bras bu gang 'byung na gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa rang sar zhig nas 'khor 'das ming tsam du grol nas 'gro ba yin no// da bum pa'i dbang (93)de nyid brtan par bya ba'i cho ga gsum bya ste/ thod pa so so'i dbu thog tu lan gsum bzhag la ak+ṣa tshar gcig brjod pa'i tshe/ bdud rtsi byang sems yig 'bru'i tshul du byin gyis brlabs pa rnams thod pa'i tshangs bug nas 'dzags te/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshangs bug nas mar thig pa/ lus thams cad rtsa'i rang bzhin/ rtsa yi ge'i rang bzhin/ yi ge rang snang dag ma dag gi sa bon du gnas pa la thim pas rtsa khams kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba yin no// des glegs bam gyi yi ge la brten nas bum pa'i dbang bzhi pa skur ba song*/ da gnyis pa bdud rtsi gsang ba'i dbang bzhi bskur bar bya ste/ dbang gi chu bo 'di ni sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ yum kun tu bzang mo gnyis kyis/ rig 'dzin mkha' spyod kyi bla ma dpal ldan sum cu rtsa drug la bskur/ de rnams kyis dam pa rin po che la bskur ba yin/ de yang dbang 'dis ngag gi sgrib pa dag nas/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku thob par bya ba dang*/ de ma thob kyi bar du yang bza' ba dang bza' ba ma yin pa'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad bcom nas nang gi rtsa rlung las su rung bar bya ba dang*/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las grags pa ste dbang phyug chen po drug bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs la bsten nas sgrub pa'i phyir gsang ba'i dbang bzhi bskur ba ni/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi nas bla ma'i srin lag gis blangs la slob ma'i gnas bzhir thig le byed pa ste thog mar/

dpral bar thig le bya zhing a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes brjod pas lus tha mal du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag nas/ rang lus bla ma dang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur blta zhing*/ ji ltar snang ba thams cad snang stong zhen (94)bral du 'char bar byin gyis brlabs/ bdud rtsi'i thig le de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ spyi bor bde chen gyi 'khor lo'i ste bar bla ma'i sku'i sa bon oṃ yig dkar po/ de rang sems dang gnyis su med par lhang nge/ lhan ne/ lham mer bzhugs pa lags kyis/ de la ma yengs par dran pas zin par byas na bla ma'i sku'i byin rlabs rgyun chad med par 'byung ba yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ yang mgrin par thig le bya zhing*/ a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes brjod pas ngag tha mal du 'dzin pa'i bag chags kyi sgrib pa dag nas/ rang gi ngag bla ma dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung grag stong du 'char bar byin gyis brlabs/ thig le yongs su gyur ba las mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar bla ma'i gsung gi sa bon āḥyig dmar po/ de rang sems dang gnyis su med par lhang nge/ lhan ne/ lham mer bzhugs pa lags kyis/ de ma brjod par dran pas zin tsam byas na bla ma'i gsung gi byin rlabs rgyun chad med par 'byung ba yin no// yang snying gar thig le bya zhing*/ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas yid tha mal du 'dzin pa'i bag chags kyi sgrib pa dag nas/ rang gi yid bla ma dang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs dran stong du byin gyis brlabs/ thig le de yongs su gyur pa las snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar bla ma'i thugs kyi sa bon hūm̐ yig sngon po/ de rang sems dang gnyis su med par lhang nge*/ lhan ne/ lham mer bzhugs pa lags kyis/ de ma brjed pa dran pas zin par byas na bla ma'i thugs kyi byin rlabs rgyun chad med par 'byung ba yin no// yang lte bar thig le bya zhing*/

a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ zhes brjod pas sems tha mal du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag nas rang sems bla ma dang de bzhin (95)gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs rig stong du byin gyis brlabs/ thig le yongs su gyur pa las lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su bla ma'i yon tan gyi sa bon hrīḥser po/ de rang sems dang gnyis su med par lhang nge*/ lhan ne/ lham mer bzhugs pa lags kyis/ de ma brjed par dran pas zin par byas na/ bla ma'i yon tan thams cad bslab mi dgos par rang la nang nas 'char ba yin no// da gsang ba'i dbang bzhi po de brtan byed kyi chog gsun bya ste/ khyed kyi dbang gong ma de dag thob pa des/ lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad dpa' bo dang dpa' mor sangs rgyas nas gnyis med byang chub kyi sems lus la rgyas pas rgyud sde'i lha tshogs thams cad rang lus la tshang bar bzhugs pa lags kyis/ de rnams la mchod pa'i phyir hub gsum gsol cig /ces brjod cing oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bdud rtsi blud/ rdzas gcig pu de rang lus la zhugs pas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad mnyes te thugs dam bskong*/ yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pas rtsa khams thams cad bros te nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la skye ba yin no// des bdud rtsi gsang ba'i dbang bzhi bskur ba song*// da gsum pa snying po don gyi ngo sprod la brten nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bar bya ste/ 'di la don gsum las/ dang po rtsa ba don gyi 'byung khungs ni/ sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku shākya thub pas rten 'brel dag pa gsum gyis mnyam par bzhag pas ngo bo stong pa nyid thugs su chud de/ rang rig pa'i ye shes khong nas shar ba 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams la dag pa'i rten 'brel brdar bstan pas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis rtogs/ shā ri'i bus dris/ rab 'byor gyis zhus/ kun dga' bos (96)bsdus/ byams pa la don brgyud gtad/

des thogs med la/ des dbyig gnyen la/ des ār+ya de ba la/ des dam pa rin po che la gnang ba'o// gnyis pa rtsa ba de slob ma'i rgyud la ji ltar bskur na/ 'khrul 'khor gsum la brten nas bskur te/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni/ rkang pa skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag /rgal tshigs gser gyi dong rtse ltar brtsegs/ dpung pa rgod gshog ltar brgyangs/ mgrin pa rma bya ltar mnan/ so dang mchu tha mal du 'jog pa ste/ chos drug rdo rje'i gnas thabs so// ngag gi 'khrul 'khor ni/ mig rtse/ sna rtse/ sems rtse gsum gcig tu dril nas shes pa la bsor bcug pas rlung lnga dbu mar tshud de yon tan thams cad skye ba yin no// yid kyi 'khrul 'khor ni/ sgom 'dod kyi rtog pa phyir phud nas/ mi sgom pa'i shes pa rten med la blo bzhag sa med par thag bcad nas car phog tu ngo sprad par bya ste/ khyed cag sems rnam par rtog pa'i dbang du ma song bar/ rang lugs su rtsen gyis zhog cig /ces lan gsum du bla mas ngag bsrings la brjod do// de'i nyams len la'ang gsum/ tha mal gyi shes pa ngos bzung bar bya ba'i phyir rtsen gyis 'jog /des gnas su ma gtub na slod kyis glod la bzhag /de ngos bzung zhing gnas na/ nyams bshig cing sgom du bcug pas/ rjes nyams rtogs je bzang la 'gro ba yin no// gsum pa rtsa ba zin mi zin drod tshad bzung ba ni/ slob ma mos gus rab la dus de nyid du rtogs pa 'char te/ skyes bu gnyid sad pa ltar grol ba'ang 'byung*/ 'bring la rtogs pa rtsa bral du go nas dge sbyor sha ma zin/ tha ma'ang sems kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong pa de ngos zin nas ting nge 'dzin bzang po skye zhing*/ rtog pas ma 'phrogs par sems shin tu gsal dngas su (97)'char/ de ma yin pa rnams la'ang*/ bags kyis ting nge 'dzin 'char zhing de la rtsa bral gyi dge sbyor skyes nas/ gdod rtogs pa 'thad po 'char ro// mdor na tshe 'di'am/

'chi ka'am bar do gsum gang rung la don mi 'grub mi srid gsung ngo*// da dbang gsum pa'i don de nyid brtan byed kyi brda gsum ste/ dang po me long bstan la/ kye rigs kyi bu kun mig yul du mthong ba'i gzugs thams cad/ de ring nas 'di'i nang du shar ba'i gzugs brnyan ltar shes par gyis shig /ces lan gsum/ des gzugs thams cad yang dag par na bden par ma grub pa'i snang stong zhen bral du ngo sprad pa yin no// gnyis pa se gol lan gsum tog cing*/ kye rigs kyi bu kun rna ba'i yul du thos pa'i sgra thams cad/ de ring nas se gol gyi sgra 'di ltar shes par gyis shig /lan gsum/ des sgra thams cad brag stong gnyis su med par ngo sprad pa yin no// gsum pa sngar rmi ba'i rmi lam gyi snang ba dran par gyis shig /kye rigs kyi bu kun yid la dran pa'i rnam rtog thams cad/ de ring nas mdangs sum gyi rmi lam ltar shes par gyis shig /ces lan gsum/ des bde sdug btang snyoms kyi rtog pa thams cad bden zhen med par rig stong du ngo sprad pa yin no// des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba song*/ da bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che'i lde mig gis ye shes kyi sgo 'byed pa'i dbang bskur bar bya ste/ dbang gi chu bo 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ ngo bo nyid sku gsang bdag phyag na rdo rjes gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams la bskur/ gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis dam pa rin po che la bskur ba lags pas 'di ni sngags gcig gis 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i gdams pa dbang bzhi lam khyer gyi gnad/ lam phyag rgya bzhi'i sgrub thabs/ (98)lam zab mo bla ma'i gsang sgrub lta sgom bsnyen sgrub tu bskyal bas/ nyams rtogs chan bzang phabs kyis glum du langs pa ltar khong nas rang shar du 'ong ba/ yang dag don gyi sgrib sbyong*/ tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs par byed pa'i snying po blo sbyong gi lung 'di long zhig

/ces brda sprad la/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying gar 'khor bar mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rang gi phreng ba la 'jur bcug la oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru sid+dhi hūm̐ zhes lan gsum gyis bzlas lung byin nas/ 'di la lam gyi yon tan thams cad skye ba'i gnad rnam pa bzhi yod de/ oṃ ye shes lnga ldan bum dbang gi snying po yin pas yi dam gyi lha phyogs med la dag snang sna tshogs 'tshar bar byed/ lam phyag rgya bzhi pas gzhi dam tshig gi phyag rgya 'grub pa yin no// āḥ gsal ba gsum ldan gsang dbang gi snying po yin pas/ rtsa rlung gi rtags dang yon tan sna tshogs 'char/ don chos kyi phyag rgya 'grub pa yin no// hrīḥdaga' ba bzhi ldan shes rab ye shes kyi snying po yin pas/ thig le las su rung zhing khams lnga dwangs par byed/ dpe las kyi phyag rgya 'grub pa yin no// hūm̐/ rnam shes drug ldan tshig dbang gi snying po yin pas rtogs pa'i ye shes phyogs med du 'char/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po 'grub pa yin no// de ltar tshig gi dbang bzhi po de dag brtan par byed pa ni/ glegs bam gyi dbus nas me tog blangs te/ blo sbyong gi snying po 'di'i rjes zlos/ slob ma'i lus la gtor zhing grub par gyur cig /ces lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams bla ma la mos gus drag po byas pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs gdan khri'i steng du ma lus par slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum (99*)chu la chu bzhag pa ltar sib kyis thim nas khrug gis 'dres pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des byin rlabs rgyun du 'byung bas lam rtags myur du 'char/ tshogs gnyis rgyun chad med pas sgrib gnyis myur du 'dag /thugs rje'i nus mthu phog pas lam gyi bar chad sel ba'i gnad gsum po mod gsung ngo*// de ltar dbang bzhi la/ dbang nyams bcu drug dang*/

brtan byed bcu gnyis te/ dbang gi ngo sprod nyi shu rtsa brgyad po des dbang gi dngos gzhi rnams tshar ba yin/ da mjug bslab par bya ba'i chos gsum la slob par gdams te/ dang po rten sdom pa gsum la slob pa ni/ rje btsun dam pa rin po che'i lugs kyis ma 'brel khams len gyi sdom pa tsam la ma lus par// yang dag don gyi sdom pa gsum bsrung dgos pas/ las rgyu 'bras la snying thag pa nas 'dzems pa nyan thos kyi 'dul khrims dam pa/ dge ba ci byed gzhan don du 'jug pa byang sems kyi bslab khrims yangs pa/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos su blta ba gsang sngags kyi dam tshig gtsang ba gsum gal che ba yin no// gnyis pa rnal 'byor gyi rang sa drug bsrung bar gdams pa ni/ gsol ba lha la mi 'debs te/ bla ma las lhag pa'i skyabs gzhan med/ dngos grub 'dre la mi zhu ste/ 'du long bar chad kyi g.yab mo yin/ sna thag mi la mi gtad de/ sha tsha rang la byed dgos/ pho rgod tshe 'dir mi 'byin te/ chos min gyi bya ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin no// gos ngan rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la mi 'phyar te mis mthong khyis tshor gyi sgrub pa bar chad mang ba yin/ gsang bam chu sgor mi 'don te/ nyams rtogs gzhan la ngom na nyams kyi 'phel ba chad pa'i rgyu yin no// gsum pa bo zags ltems log gi dri ma bzhi bsrung bar gdams pa ni/ blo sbyong gi dus su bla ma (100)la ma gus pa'i blo shor na po ba'i dri ma yin pas ci mdzad yon tan du blta/ sems can la byams pa'i blo spangs na zags pa'i dri ma yin pas sems can gyi 'khrul pa la don du mi bzung*/ don med pa'i spyod pa bzhi dang bcas pa ma spangs na ltems pa'i dri ma yin pas tshe 'di'i bya ba don du mi gnyer/ cho ma myong bar stan las 'phags na log pa'i dri ma yin pas lam rtags dang rdo rus 'phrod par bya'o// de ltar sbyor ba la skyabs sems mchod bsngo smon lam ste chos lnga/

dngos gzhi la dbang bzhi/ mjug bslab par bya ba'i chos gsum gyis ā li kā li'i byin rlabs/ yi ge phyi mo'i dbang bskur/ don lhan cig skyes pa bzhi rdzogs zhes bya ba/ shin tu zab pa de tshur ba lags pas bka' drin re che snyam pas bla ma la phyag gsum 'tshol/ de nas bka' drin che lags zhes brjod/ rjes chog la bdun las/ gtor ma btang ba ni/ lhag pa'i lha'i 'das gtor dang mgon po a bho ra/ mkha' 'gro sde bzhi/ zhing skyong kun tu ri ka /a pa rā dzi ta/ klu chen btang bzung sogs chos srung rnams dang*/ gzhi bdag spyi gtor sogs so so'i gzhung bzhin bya/ bkra shis brjod la sngar byin rlabs byas pa'i 'brang rgyas bzhi dngos grub kyi rdzas su rol/ tshogs rdzas rnams byin rlabs gong du grub pas/ tshogs zhing bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs sad par bsam zhing*/ tshogs phud gtor mar bran la/ oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra la a kā ro btags pas phyi gtor dang*/ ba liṃ i daṃ/ khā hi khā hi/ badz+ra yo gi nī/ ka ma ru bi ni/ dza la mu ki hrīḥkha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes btags pas nang gtor bsngos la bla med mchog gi mthar oṃ gu ru sogs la ga na tsakra pū dza swā hā/ zhes btags pas tshogs phul/ de nas las rdor gyis bla ma la phyag byas la thabs shes kyi (101)rdzas bsnol mar thogs nas/ oṃ pu dzaḥswā hā/ zhes mchod pa lngas mchod par bsam la/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom byar mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams// rang bzhin gcig pas dgongs su gsol// zhes rtog pa bsal bas drangs/ bla mas pad kor sngon 'gros rtse gsum gyi rgya ston bzhin du/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi mchog /'dod chags dri ma bral ba 'di// bzung 'dzin dri ma rnam par med// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes pas blangs la/

rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes tshogs rdzas bdud rtsir gyur par lag sor 'dod yon gyi lha mor bsam pas/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐/ zhes lus kyi lha rnams mchod par mos nas tshogs la rol/ lhag ma bsdus la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis snod rin po che'i nang du bcud bdud rtsir gyur pa thim par mos la/ gtor ma kha phru btab cing*/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa paṇ+ḍi bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes bzlas nas gtsang gtor dang bsres nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa ye swā hā/ 'byung po lhag ma la dbang ba rnams tshims par gyur cig /kyai mkha' 'gro zhing skyong tshogs// las 'di bdag gis bslab par bgyi// bdag la bde legs bsdu ba dang*// phan dang yid 'ongs bde ba dang*// grong dang yul 'khor shis par mdzod// ces brjod la gtsang sar 'bul lo// de nas bdag bskyed 'od gsal du bsdu zhing thun mtshams kyi lhar langs la glegs bam bsdu/ de nas lam gyi bar chad zhi phyir smon lam gdab/ bsags pa'i dge ba don yod par bya phyir dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo bar bya zhing*/ de nas nangs par bla mas slob ma rnams la blo sbyong gi lung dbog cing (102)bslab bya rgyas par bya'o// dka' thub sogs dbang tshun gcig tu byed na/ 'brang rgyas kyi dngos grub la rol pa dang*/ gtor ma btang zhing glegs bam bsdu ba rnams nub tha ma mi byed do// lam lnga las tshogs lam bgrod par byed pa blo sbyong gi dbang chog tshar ro// i ti// oṃ swa sti/ gnyis pa sbyor lam bsgrod par byed pa dka' thub kyi dbang la/ glegs bam bsham lugs sogs gong dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i phrad ka ra la bya zhing*/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas tshogs dang dbang rdzas byin rlabs sngar ltar las/ khyad par yig 'bru rnams longs sku rigs lnga'i lha tshogs su byin gyis brlab bo// de nas slob ma rnams zlas bya ba sngon 'gros gral du 'khod pa la/

'o sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du sbyor lam drod kyi ye shes skyed par byed pa lam dka' thub kyi byin rlabs zhus la nyams su blang snyam du ma yengs par gsan 'tshal/ ji ltar nyams su len lugs la/ dbyings rnal 'byor gsum las/ byed pa lam gyi rnal 'byor la lam lngar yod pa'i/ 'di ni sbyor lam drod kyi ye shes thob par byed pa dka' thub kyi dbang bya ba yin/ 'di yang dbang gzhan las khyad par lngas 'phags te/ glegs bam bshams pas lha dbang ma yin pa chos dbang yin pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'grems pa mdangs la brten pa'i rjes dpag ma yin ye shes dngos skyed byed yin pa dang*/ bhañja ni rten rdzas tsam ma yin dam rdzas yin pa dang*/ bla ma ni sprul pa tsam ma yin sangs rgyas dngos yin pa dang*/ dbang rnam bzhag tsam du bskur ba ma yin ngo sprod pa'i thabs kyi lam yongs rdzogs la skyed byed yin pas khyad par du 'phags so// de lta bu'i dbang ka 'di/ (103)bum dbang rdo rje 'chang nas bdag med ma/ gsang dbang rnam snang nas mkha' bskyod kyi bla ma/ sher dbang thub pa nas byams mgon la/ tshig dbang gsang bdag nas gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams la brgyud de/ dam pa rin po ches byang sems kun dga' la cig brgyud du gnang ba byin rlabs snod gcig tu blugs pa lta bu'i bka' srol 'gan zla dang bral ba lags pas thugs spro ba bskyed par mdzod/ dbang dngos la gsum gyi/ thog ma sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi rjes zlos/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du'ang bla ma dam pa rnams la mos pa dang gus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yi dam lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du'ang yi dam lha tshogs rnams la mos pa dang gus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du'ang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams la mos pa dang gus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis 'das ma 'ongs da ltar byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gcig tu bsdus te bla ma la dbul bar bgyi'o// bla ma la phul bas bla ma rin po che rnams kyi thugs dgongs khyad par can yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /de las byung ba'i dge (104)ba'i rtsa ba des bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi spyan lam du mchod pa'i bye brag nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 'byung bar gyur cig /de las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de sems can thams cad dang thun mong du bsngo bar bgyi'o// de ltar bsngos pas sems can thams cad 'khor ba srid pa sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig /de ma thob kyi bar du'ang bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas nas 'gro ba ma lus pa mtha' dag gi bla mar gyur cig /de kho na bzhin du grub par gyur cig /ces lan gsum/ dngos gzhi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur ba las/ dang po bum pa'i dbang bzhi bskur ba ni yig 'bru la ltos la/ gzugs snang thams cad rgyal ba rigs lnga'i skur byin gyis brlabs par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ thur ma btsugs la ak+ṣaḥtshar gcig /sgra thams cad rigs lnga'i gsung du byin gyis brlabs par mos la 'di'i/ ak+ṣa brjod/ dran rtog thams cad rigs lnga'i thugs su byin gyis brlabs par mos la 'di'i/

ak+ṣa brjod/ sems kyi ngo bo gdod nas skye ba med pa las snang grags dran pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin ma 'gags pa'i rtsal snang tsam du byin gyis brlabs par mos la 'di'i/ ak+ṣa brjod/ da bum dbang de nyid brtan par bya ba'i phyir ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i dam tshig pa'i rtsa yig rnams la phog pas/ rang lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad rigs lnga'i ngo bo dpa' bo dpa' mo'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag par gyur snyam du mos pa mdzod/ ces thod pa mgo thog tu bzhag la ak+ṣa brjod do// des bum pa'i dbang bzhi song*/ da gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba ni// bdud rtsi srin lag gis blangs te slob ma'i gnas bzhir thig le byed pa ste/ a bhi ṣiñca oṃ (105)zhes dpral bar bzhag pas oṃ de nyid spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa tshon gang pa gcig gsal bar gyur/ a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes mgrin par bzhag pas āḥde nyid longs spyod kyi 'khor lo 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa gsal bar gyur/ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes snying ga'i thig le hūm̐ de nyid chos kyi 'khor lo mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa gsal bar gyur/ a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ zhes lte ba'i thig le hrīḥde nyid sprul pa'i 'khor lo rin 'byung ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa gsal bar gyur/ de ltar lha bzhi po de yang skru zhi ba'am khro bo dpa' bo gcig gam yab yum gang mos su gsal thob la yang yang dran par byos shig /de nyid brtan byed du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bdud rtsi lan gsum blud pas/ 'khor lo bzhi'i lha rnams kyis gtso mdzad rtsa khams kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad mnyes nas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams bzang po nang nas 'char ba yin no// des bdud rtsi gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba song*// da shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/

sngon byung yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas byang phyogs kam+bhi ra'i mchod rten gyi rtsar rtsa gsum gcig tu dril nas rig pa dwangs su bcug pas/ dang po sems kyi ngo bo stong par ngos zin nas rang rig gi ye shes khong nas sad kyang da dung bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes rtsal du ma shar bas/ gnyis pa chu bo nai rāñja na'i 'gram du lo drug dka' thub kyi khog par zhugs te spyan lngas dug lnga'i phra rags la gzigs pas/ rtsa bral gyi rtogs pa rang sar grol nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes rtsal du shar/ de nas phyis chos 'khor bar pa bskor dus 'dus pa'i 'khor la spyan lnga'i rten 'brel brdar bstan pas (106)spyan ras gzigs kyis rtogs/ shā ri'i bus dris/ der 'dus pa'i 'khor phal che bas brda'i don khong du chud nas glengs/ kun dga' bos bsdus/ byams pa la don brgyud gtad/ de la thogs med kyis zhus nas/ dbyig gnyen/ ār+ya de ba/ dam pa rin po ches chig brgyud gsum la rim par babs pa'o// rtsa ba de slob ma'i rgyud la ji ltar bskur na/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun/ ngag gnad steng 'og gi rlung 'gyu ba bcad nas rlung dbu mar gzhug /yid sgom 'dod spangs nas spyan lnga'i lta stangs kyis rtog pa'i rtsa ba bcad par bya ste/ de'ang dang por lung ma bstan gti mug gi rtog pa la/ rus sbal ltar mig btsum nas blta/ gnyis pa bral ba 'dod chags kyi rtog pa la mgron bu'i rgyab ltar thim me blta/ gsum pa de bas rags pa zhe sdang gi rtog pa la zla ba tshes pa ltar gzhu gang tsam du blta/ bzhi pa de bas kyang rags pa phrag dog gi rtog pa la mkhal ma ltar rang thad du blta/ lnga pa shin tu rags pa nga rgyal gyi rtog pa la zla ba nya gang ba ltar bar snang la mig blta'o// de dag gang byed kyang rlung kha sbyar la lus sems sgrims nas/ rlung sems 'od gsal gyi mdangs la bcings te/

gsal bdo ba la bshig cing nyams su blangs pas/ rjes la 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad mtshan nyid med par nyams su myong nas 'ong ba yin no// gsum pa de'i drod tshad bzung ba la dus bzhi ste/ dang por rgyal ba yum gyi zhal blta dus zhes bya ste/ bla ma'i spyan la blta/ gnyis pa zhal mthong dus bya ste/ bla ma'i lad mo bzla/ gsum pa de goms par byed dus zhes bya ste/ goms pa klong du ma gyur gyi bar du 'bad pas sgom/ bzhi pa mngon du gyur pa'i dus zhes bya ste/ rtog pa thams cad rtsa bral du shes tsa na ched du spyan lngas blta mi dgos so// (107)de ltar goms pa'i tshe/ gsum pa'i dbang de nyid brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ gzugs sgra dran rtog thams cad sgyu ma brag cha lbu ba lta bur shes par bya ste/ phra ba'i brda zhes bya'o// de shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba song*// da bzhi pa tshig dbang bskur ba ni/ rgyu rtsal bzhi dang bcas pas nye ba'i bzlas lung dbog pa yin pas/ drod kyi ye shes btsan thabs su skye bar byed pa'i snying po sbyor lam dka' thub kyi lung 'di longs shig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis bzlas lung sbyin nas 'di la rgyu rtsal bzhi ste/ dang po nus pa sngags kyi rtsal rin po che'i lha sku la rang 'od 'don pa dang 'dra bas snying po gsal la dag par bzla/ gnyis pa rig pa sems kyi rgyu rtsal zad par gyi skye mched sgom pa dang 'dra ste/ ting nge 'dzin gsal la brtan par bsgom/ gsum pa rten 'brel rgyu rtsal mañji ka'i me tog rdzas kyis kha bsgyur ba dang 'dra ste/ gang la dmigs pa'i rten rdzas rnams mdun du dgram/ bzhi pa mtshams sbyor dus kyi rgyu rtsal gnam lcags dang khregs rdo 'phrad pa'i me dang 'dra ste bla mas thugs la 'dogs dus sgrub pa la phyi bshol mi bya bar 'bad dgos pa yin no// de ltar tshig dbang gi nus pa de nyid brtan par bya ba'i phyir/

glegs bam gyi me tog blangs pa la dka' thub kyi snying po bzlas pa bu la 'thor zhing*/ grub par gyur cig ces lan gsum/ des bla ma'i sku gsung thugs lha'i rang bzhin du gnas pa de slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang nas/ lam rtags dang yon tan 'char ba la tshegs med pa yin no// 'jug gi chos gsum ste rten sdom pa gsum dang ldan zhing rnal 'byor gyi rang sa drug ma nyams pa'i sgrub pa po des dri ma bzhi (108)bsrung bar bya ste/ gzhan don sngas na bo ba'i dri ma yin pas dam bca' ma grol bar du slob dpon mi bya/ bsnyen bskur zos na zags pa'i dri ma yin pas rang rdzas mi ster zhing gzhan rdzas mi spyod/ bsrung sdom lhod na ltems pa'i dri ma yin pas/ bsnyen pa byed dus khrus mi bya/ gos stan mi sprug /skra sen mi 'breg /ngag gi smra ba gcod/ mchil snabs mi 'dor/ gtor ma sba ba sogs bslab bya rnams dam du bsrung ngo*// chos brgyad dran na ldog pa'i dri ma yin pas tshe 'di'i snyan grags rgyab tu dor bar bya'o// de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi phyag len la brten nas sbyor lam skyed byed zab mo dka' thub kyi byin rlabs tshar ba lags pas bla ma la gtong rag gi phyag gsum 'tshol la/ bka' drin che lags zhes brjod/ rjes chog rnams blo sbyong ltar bya'o// lam lnga las sbyor lam bgrod par byed pa dka' thub kyi dbang chog tshar ro// i thi/// /oṃ swa sti/ gsum pa mthong lam mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'char byed rjes blo bral gyi byin rlabs la/ glegs bam sogs sngar ltar bsham/ khyad par bdud rtsi'i 'phrang sbrang rtsis bya/ bdag bskyed sngon 'gros tshogs dang dbang rdzas sngar ltar las/ khyad par yig 'bru las byung ba'i rigs lnga'i lha tshogs rnams snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon ltar byin gyis brlabs so// de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas/

phyag sngon 'gros gral du 'khod pa la// 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa rgyud la skyed byed rjes kyi byin rlabs zhus la nyams su blang snyam du ma yengs par gsan 'tshal/ de ji ltar nyams su len lugs la/ dbyings (109)rnal 'byor gsum las/ byed pa lam gyi rnal 'byor la lnga yod pa'i nang nas/ 'di ni mthong lam nyams su len pa rjes kyi dbang bya ba de yin/ de yang dbang gzhan las khyad par 'phags te/ glegs bam 'di dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin pas dang*/ yig 'bru 'di chos thams cad kyi sa bon yin pa dang*/ bhañja 'di dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i rdzas yin pa dang*/ bla ma ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byed pa po yin pas dang*/ ngo sprod zab mo 'di yang dag pa'i lam dngos yin pas khyad par du 'phags par gda' ste/ de lta bu'i dbang ka 'di dam pa rgya gar gyi khyad chos/ byang sems kun dga'i thugs dam/ rang cag rnams chos 'di 'dra dang 'phrad pa khar rje yin pas 'tshengs pa lags snyam du spro ba bskyed par mdzod/ dbang dngos la gsum gyi/ thog mar sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi rjes zlos/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa nas/ de kho na bzhin du grub par gyur cig /ces pa'i bar lan gsum/ dngos gzhi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur ba la/ dang po bum pa'i dbang bzhi bskur ba ni yig 'bru la ltos la ji ltar snang ba thams cad ngo bo bla ma/ rnam pa yi dam rigs lnga'i sku mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du byin gyis brlabs par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos yi ge re re bzhin thur ma btsugs la ak+ṣaḥtshar gcig /de thams cad dang por skye ba med/ bar du gnas pa med/ tha mar 'gags pa med/ bden pa'i dngos por grub pa med de gzugs snang stong ngo*// zhes brjod du bcug

/ji ltar grags pa'i sgra thams cad ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa rigs lnga'i gsung mtshan nyid bzhi ldan (110)du mos la 'di'i/ ak+ṣa dang*/ skye med/ gnas med/ 'gags med/ dngos med de sgrar grags thams cad grag stong ngo*// zhes brjod/ ji ltar dran pa'i chos thams cad ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa rigs lnga'i sku gsung thugs mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du mos la 'di'i/ āk+ṣa dang*/ skye med/ gnas med/ 'gag med/ dngos med de yid dran stong ngo*// ji ltar snang grag 'gyu gsum rang gi sems ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa rigs lnga'i sku gsung thugs mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du mos la 'di'i/ ak+ṣa dang*/ skye med/ gnas med/ 'gag med/ dngos med de sems su bde stong gnyis su med pa'o// zhes brjod/ dbu ma dbang de nyid brtan byed du lus kyi rtsa khams lha dang lha mor gsal ba de rnams kyang skye med sogs mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du byin gyis brlabs pas dag pa'i snang ba sna tshogs su 'char bar mos pa mdzod/ thod pa spyi bor bzhag la ak+ṣa tshar gcig /mjug tu rtsa khams kyi lha thams cad dang por skye med/ bar du gnas med/ tha mar 'gag med/ bden pa'i dngos por grub pa med do// zhes brjod do// des bum pa'i dbang bzhi song*/ da gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba ni/ bdud rtsi las srin lag gis blangs te bu'i gnas bzhir thig le byed pa ste/ dpral bar a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ skye med/ gnas med/ 'gag med/ dngos med do// zhes brjod pas/ bde chen 'khor lo oṃ las rnam snang gi sku mtshan nyid bzhi ldan gyis rgyas gdab/ mgrin par thig le/ a bhi ṣiñca āḥ skye med/ gnas med/ 'gag med/ dngos med do// zhes brjod pas mgrin pa'i 'khor lo aḥlas 'od dpag med kyi sku mtshan nyid bzhi ldan gyis rgyas gdab/ snying gar a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ skye med sogs brjod pas/ snying ga'i 'khor lo hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa'i sku mtshan nyid bzhi ldan gyi rgyas gdab/

(111)lte bar a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ skye med sogs brjod pas lte ba'i 'khor lo rin 'byung gi sku mtshan nyid bzhi ldan gyi rgyas gdab bo// da de nyid brtan byed du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bdud rtsi lan gsum blud/ skye med sogs brjod pas rtsa khams kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad mnyes pa las shar ba'i nyams rtogs kun kyang mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du 'char ba yin no// des gsang ba'i dbang song*// da shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ sngon byung ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos chu bo nai rañja na'i 'gram du spyan lnga'i gzigs pas ma gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes rtsal du shar yang*/ da dung sangs rgyas kyi ye shes khyad par can de rje sa la ma mthong nas rdo rje gdan du byon te bdud btul/ spyan lnga'i lta stangs sgyur bas der sangs rgyas kyi ye shes thob nas chos 'khor bar pa'i dus/ 'dus pa'i 'khor la lta stangs sgyur bas/ zab mo'i brda de spyan ras gzigs kyis rtogs/ shā ri'i bus dri sa/ 'dus pa'i 'khor gyis don khong du chud nas glengs/ kun dga' bos bsdus/ byams pa la don brgyud gtad nas// thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ ār+ya de ba/ dam pa rin po ches chig brgyud kyi bla ma gsum la rim par babs te/ da lta yan ma chad pa yin no// rtsa ba de slob ma'i rgyud la ji ltar bskur na/ lus gnad chos bdun bca'/ ngag gnad steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyar la 'gyu ba bcad de dbu mar gzhug /yid sgom 'dod kyi rtog pa spangs la/ ngo bo stong pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ mtshan nyid gnyis med du grol bar bya ba'i phyir/ lta stangs lnga bsgyur te/ ngan song du ltung ba'i dogs pa chod phyir nyan thos zhi ba'i lta stangs mthur du sgyur/ mtho ris thob 'dod kyi re ba gcod phyir mu stegs tshangs pa'i lta stangs gyen du/ zhe sdang gi rtog pa gcod phyir sems dpa'i lta stangs g.yas su/ (112)'dod chags kyi kun rtog gcod phyir sems ma'i lta stangs g.yon du/

sgom blo bsam gtan gyi 'ching ba gcod phyir bde bar gshegs pa'i lta stangs thad kar bsgyur bar bya'o// de ltar lta stangs gang bsgyur yang*/ steng rlung mnan/ 'og rlung 'then/ 'gyu ba bcad/ sgrim sha bton/ rlung sems 'od gsal gyi mdangs la bcings te/ gsal rdo ba la bshig cing sgom pas rjes la blo bral thugs su chud de 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad mtshan nyid med par nyams su myong bar byed do// da de'i drod tshad bzung ba la bzhi ste/ dang por rgyal ba yum gyi zhal blta dus/ bla ma'i spyan la blta/ gnyis pa mthong dus bla ma'i lad mo bya/ gsum pa de goms par byed dus dam ji ltar bcas kyi bar du nyams su blangs/ bzhi pa mngon du gyur dus chos thams cad la bden 'dzin zhig nas kun rdzob dag snang du 'char tsa na lta stangs lnga po ched du bsgyur mi dgos so// de ltar gsum pa'i dbang de brtan par bya ba'i phyir rjes spyod thams cad mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du ngo sprad par bya ste/ gzugs snang tsam nas ma grub ste rang bzhin gyis stong pa'o// rten 'brel gyi snang ba ma 'gags pas stong nyid kyi rtsal gzugs su snang la/ snang tsam nyid na ngo bo stong nyid las ma g.yos pas gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin zhing*/ ngo bo stong pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang rtsal snang gzugs su ma 'gags pas stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin te/ de lta bu'i mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos thams cad la shes par bya zhing*/ de ltar shes tsa na rnam grangs kyi stong pa dang*/ log pa'i kun rdzob zhes bya ba yul du mi gnas pa yin no// des sher dbang song*/ da tshig dbang bskur ba ni/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐ bzhi dbang bzhi'i snying po dzī na mi tra sgrub pa'i snying po ste/ rnam (113)par mi rtog pa'i ye shes gcig car du 'char byed rtog pa rjes kyi snying po'i lung 'di long zhig

/oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru dzī na mi tra hūm̐ zhes lan gsum gyis bzlas lung byin nas/ sa lam thams cad snying pos gcod pa yin pas bzlas pa la rem par bya zhing lam rtags rig pa dwangs pa las 'char bas dben par ma yengs tsam du sgom/ yon tan tshogs rdzogs pa las 'byung bas tshogs bsags pa la 'bad par bya'o// de nyid brtan phyir glegs bam gyi steng nas me tog blangs pa la rjes kyi snying po la bzlas nas bu la 'thor zhing*/ grub bar gyur cig ces lan gsum/ des bla ma dang rang sems 'dres par bsam pas mthong lam gyi ye shes rgyud la skye ba la tshegs med par gsungs so// da mjug gi chos gsum ste/ rten sdom pa gsum dang ldan zhing*/ rnal 'byor gyi rang sa drug ma nyams pa'i sgrub pa po des dri ma bzhi bsrung bar bya ste/ gzhi la g.ya' chags na gshis thog tu bogs chos go thog tu ma lus par nyams su blangs/ gnyen po'i bya ra ma 'gyel na nyams thog tu zags pas nyams myong gshis thog tu gzhig /rang lta la mchog tu bzung na go thog tu ltems pas chos la phyogs ris mi bya/ grub mtha'i 'dod pa ma zhig na tshig thog tu log pas rtog pa gzugs brnyan du mi gtong bar bslab par bya'o// de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis mthong lam bgrod par byed pa rjes kyi byin rlabs tshar ba lags pas bla ma la gtong rag gi phyag gsum 'tshol la/ bka' drin che lags/ zhes brjod/ rjes chog rnams blo sbyong ltar bya'o// lam lnga las mthong lam bgrod byed kyi dbang chog tshar ro// i thi/ gom+bhi ra// oṃ swa sti/ bzhi pa sgom lam sa bcu dus gcig la non par byed pa ro snyoms kyi byin rlabs la/ glegs (114)bam sogs sngar ltar bsham/ khyad par bdud rtsi'i 'phrad ka ra bu ram sbrang gsum bya/ bdag bskyed sngon 'gros tshogs dang dbang rdzas byin rlabs gzhan rnams sngar ltar las/ khyad par yig 'bru'i lha rnams go rim dang bzang ngan che chung med par mnyam nyid du byin gyis brlab bo// de nas slob ma rnams khrus phyag sngon 'gros gral du 'khod pa las// 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob bar bya/

de'i ched du sgom lam sa bcu dus gcig la non bar byed pa ro snyoms kyi dbang zab mo zhus nas nyams su blangs snyam du ma yengs par gsan 'tshal/ de la byin rlabs dbang gi chu bo 'di dbang gzhan las khyad par lngas 'phags te/ glegs bam ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga mtshon pa'i ri mo yin pas dang*/ yig 'bru ni 'bras chos lnga po de yi sa bon grungs po yin pas dang*/ bhañja ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sgrub pa'i dam rdzas yin pas dang*/ bla ma ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo yin pas dang*/ ngo sprod zab mo 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi lam dngos yin pas khyad par du 'phags pa lags/ de lta bu'i dbang ka 'di sprul pa'i sku dam pa rgya gar gyis yum bdag med ma/ rig 'dzin mkha' spyod kyi bla ma/ mgon po byams pa/ gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams las dbang bzhi po 'di gsan nas/ chu bo chen po bzhi dril gyis byang sems kun dga' la bstsal ba las rim par brgyud de don brgyud ma chad pas 'di dang 'phrad pa skal ba re bzang snyam du spro ba bskyed par mdzad 'tshal/ dbang dngos la gsum gyi/ thog mar sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi rjes zlos/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su (115)mchi'o// zhes pa nas de kho na nyid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /ces pa'i bar lan gsum/ dngos gzhi dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i ro sprod bya ba las/ dang po bum pa'i dbang bzhi bskur ba ni/ 'di ltar snang ba'i chos thams cad/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi sku gsung thugs dang*/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi snang ba la bzang ngan med par snang stong gnyis med du 'dzin pa tsam yang mi bya bar thag bcad de 'di'i rjes/ yi ge la thur ma btsugs te k+ṣa nas a'i bar mas bzlog gis tshar gcig /a nas k+ṣa'i bar lugs 'byung du tshar gcig

/yang aḥ.aṃ nas a'i bar dbyangs ldog pa dang*/ gsal byed ka nas k+ṣa'i bar lugs 'byung du tshar gcig /yang gsal byed sde ba lnga/ mtha' gnas bro ba k+ṣaḥste brgyad po so sor bcad pa'i bar du dbyangs bcu drug pho gnyis re bcug nas klog pa tshar gcig ste bzhi'o// 'di ni glang 'khor ba chen po'i phyag bzhes te dbang dpe rnying pa rnams su thams cad lugs ldog tu klog par bshad do// de ltar snang grag dran pa'i chos thams cad go rim nges med du byin gyis brlabs pas sgom lam shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad dag nas sa lam chig rdzogs su grol ba yin no// da bum dbang de nyid brtan byed du rang lus rtsa khams kyi lha rnams go rim dang bzang ngan med par byin gyis brlabs pas dag snang phyogs med du 'char ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces thod pa spyi bor bzhag la dbyangs gsal mas ldog tshar gcig brjod do// des bum pa'i dbang bzhi song*/ da gsang dbang bskur ba ni/ bdud rtsi'i thig le snying gar/ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ lte bar a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ mgrin par a bhi ṣiñca āḥ dpral bar a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes bzhag pas/ 'khor lo bzhi'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams rim pa ma nges par gsal (116)btab pas byin rlabs thug phrad du 'char ba yin no/

/de nyid brtan byed du hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes bdud rtsi lan gsum blud pas/ rtsa khams kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad mnyes pa las shar ba'i nyams snang thams cad gsal bde mi rtog par go rim nges med du 'char ba yin no/ /des gsang ba'i dbang song*// da shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ sngon byung ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos rdo rje gdan du lta stangs lngas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rjes la thob kyang*/ bzhi pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes yul la ma khel nas zhag bdun phrag bdun du 'jig rten gyi khams kun bcags nas spyod lam bzhi la bslab pas mkhyen pa'i ye shes yul la 'khel te/ 'khor lo bskor ba las bar pa'i dus 'khor 'dus pa'i dbus su spyod lam bsgyur bas brda'i don de spyan ras gzigs kyis khong du chud/ shā ri'i bus dris/ 'dus pa'i 'khor gyis sgro zhing gleng ba rnams/ kun dga' bos bsdus/ don gyi brgyud pa byams mgon la gtad/ thogs med nas rim par dam pa rin po che la brgyud de da lta'i bar du ma chad pa yin no// rtsa ba'i don de slob bu'i rgyud la ji ltar bskur na/ sngar sbyor lam du bstan pa'i spyan lnga dang*/ mthong lam du bstan pa'i lta stangs lnga po 'dir spyod lam bzhi dang bsres nas nyams su len pa ste/ de yang rtsa ba'i spyod lam 'gro 'chags nyal bdug bzhi las/ yan lag gi spyod lam nyi shur phye la nyams su blangs te/ de'ang 'dug pa'i spyod lam lnga ni/ rten 'brel dag pa rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ phyed skyil/ tsog pu/ bsnyes pa/ rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs so// nyal ba lnga ni/ g.yas nyal/ g.yon nyal/ gan rkyal/ kha sbubs/ mgo gtums/ brla sgril lo// langs pa lnga ni/ (117)langs ka /phyed langs/ langs pa/ gos gyon pa/ las ka byed pa'o// 'gro ba lnga ni/ 'gro ba/ 'gro 'chams pa/ rgyug pa/ rgyug 'phro la 'chams pa/ ngal bso ba'o// de rnams lta stangs lnga dang lta stangs re re yang spyan snga dang sbyar bas mnyam bzhag gi dus su bltas nas/

rjes kyi dus su slod pa ni/ zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ting nge 'dzin no// gang ltar sgom yang*/ steng rlung mnan/ 'og rlung 'then/ rlung 'gyu ba bcad sgrim sha bton la/ chun bdo ba la bshig /bshig rjes so mar lhod de/ khres se/ rtog med rang dwangs su rjen ne bzhag la/ bde sdug gi rkyen gang la'ang thogs rdug med par lam du khyer bas/ sgom blo'i 'ching byed bral/ tha mal gyi rtog pa gsar pas ma slebs kyi bar der/ chos nyid gzhi'i don la nges shes sad nas thams cad mtshan nyid med par nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro// dbang de brtan par bya ba'i phyir rjes spyod thams cad rnam par dag par ngo sprod par bya ste/ rten dag pa nyan thos/ sgrub pa dag pa rang rgyal/ lam dag pa byang chub sems dpa'/ 'bras bu'i dag pa sangs rgyas kyi rnam par dag pa dang bzhi yin no// des sher dbang ngo// da tshig dbang bskur ba ni/ pra ma ṇa ye zhes sngags 'bru bzhis ro snyoms kyi rtogs pa 'char byed sgrub pa chen po'i sngags yin pas/ de yang dmigs pa bla ma la gtad de mthong stangs sbyangs 'god pa gnas bzhi'i lha rnams gsal btab la gus pa bskyed/ dgram pa rten 'brel gyi rdzas rnams steng 'og phyogs bzhir dgram/ brjod pa ro snyoms kyi snying po 'di gsal la dag par bzla dgos pas 'di'i lung long zhig /oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru pra ma ṇa ye hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum/ de brtan phyir snying po bzlas pa'i me tog 'thor zhing*/ (118)grub par gyur cig /ces lan gsum/ des ro snyoms kyi rtogs pa myur du 'char ba yin no// da mjug gi chos gsum ste/ rten sdom pa gsum dang ldan zhing rang sa drug ma nyams pa'i sgrub pa po des dri ma bzhi bsrung bar bya ste/ bdag 'dzin gyi kham thengs na rang thog tu bo bas pas/ pho ngas byas kyi ngo so mi bya/ 'khon 'dzin brten na gzhan thog tu zags pas gzhan gyis brnyas pa la ko long mi bya/

gnyis snang gi mtha' ma khrol na go thog tu ltems pas bdag gzhan gnyis su ma bzung*/ zag pa'i 'phan langs na 'phrul thog tu log pas chags sdang gi rjes mi bcad pa la bslab par bya'o// de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis sgom lam ro snyoms kyi dbang byin rlabs tshar ba yin pas bla ma la gtong rag gi phyag gsum 'tshol la/ bka' drin che lags/ zhes brjod/ rjes chog rnams blo sbyang ltar ro// lam lnga las sgom lam ro snyoms kyi dbang chog tshar ro// i ti/// /oṃ swa sti// lnga pa thar lam bya bral gyi ye shes thob par byed pa sgom pa bdag gtod kyi byin rlabs la/ glegs bam sogs bsham lugs gzhan 'dra ba las/ khyad par bdud rtsi'i phrad rtsi mar la bya/ bdag bskyed sngon 'gros tshogs dang dbang rdzas byin rlabs sngar bzhin las/ khyad par yig 'bru las byung ba'i rigs lnga'i lha rnams rdo tshan la mar bzhag pa ltar zhu la khad dam nam langs kyi skar ma ltar yal la khad du byin gyis brlab bo// de nas slob ma khrus phyag sngon 'gros gral du 'khod pa la/ 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du myur du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du thar lam bgrod par byed pa sgom pa bdag gtod kyi dbang bskur mkhyen pa'i ye shes gzhan 'jug gi byin rlabs 'di zhus nas nyams su blangs snyams pas ma (119)yengs par gsan 'tshal/ de la 'dir ni theg pa thams cad kyi rtse bsdus mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bu'i dbang bskur zhes bya ba 'di gzhan las khyad par lngas 'phags te/ glegs bam 'di ni dran pas chog pa'i dbang yin pa dang*/ ā li kā li'i yig 'bru 'di ni mthong bas chog pa'i lam yin pa dang*/ bhañja'i rdzas 'di ni zin pas chog pa'i rtsi yin pas dang*/ dbang ngo sprod kyis bskur ba 'di ni shes pas chog pa'i gnad yin pas dang*/ lha'i dod bla mas mdzad pa 'di ni 'phrad pas chog pa'i brgyud pa yin pa'i phyir khyad par 'phags pa lags/

de lta bu'i dbang bka' 'di ni/ bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang*/ yum bdag med ma/ rje btsun dam pa rin po che/ byang sems kun dga'/ sba tshab/ rgyal ba te ne/ zhig po rin po che sku mched nas da lta yan chod du dbang gi chu bo 'bab 'phro ma chad/ nyams rtogs kyi na bun 'thul 'phro ma chad/ lam rtags kyi 'ja' tshon 'char 'phro ma chad/ byin rlabs kyi char rgyun 'bab 'phro ma chad/ yon tan gyi lo thog skye 'phro ma chad/ grub thob kyi phreng thag ma chad pa yin pas 'di dang 'phrad pa skal ba re bzang snyam du spro ba bskyed par mdzad 'tshal/ dbang dngos la gsum gyi thog mar sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi rjes zlos/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa nas/ de kho na bzhin du grub par gyur cig /ces pa'i bar lan gsum/ dngos gzhi dbang bzhi'i ngo sprod bya ba las/ dang po bum pa'i dbang bzhi bskur ba ni/ 'di ltar snang grag dran pa'i chos rnams rang la snang ba med par nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar gyur/ gzhan snang las sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku gsung thugs sna tshogs su snang bas phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'i rten 'brel sgrigs par bsam la 'di'i rjes/ (120)yig 'bru rnams la mas nas yar thur ma lugs ldog gis btsugs te/ yi ge rnams a 'ba' zhig tu lan bzhir bklag pas/ dang pos gzugs snang lha sku/ gnyis pas grags pa sgra/ gsum pas 'gyu byed dran rtog rnams mi dmigs par gyur bzhi pas chos nyid la yang dag tu 'dzin pa'i rtog pa yang blo bral gyi dbyings su yal zhing*/ de ltar yal ba'i rang bzhin ma 'gags tsam 'di sangs rgyas sprul pas sangs rgyas kyi phrin las thams cad mdzad pa yin no// da bum dbang de nyid brtan byed du ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rang lus rtsa khams kyi lha rnams la phog pa rigs lnga'i lha tshogs rnams bar snang gi na bun ltar rang bzhin med par yal ba'i mos pa mdzod/

ces bhañja'i bdud rtsi spyi bor bzhag la a 'ba' zhig lnga bcu brjod/ de ltar rang snang gi 'dzin pa mi dmigs par yal bas dag pa'i snang ba gdul bya gzhan ngor 'char ba'i yon tan 'gags pa med par snang bar 'gyur ba yin no// des bum pa'i dbang bzhi song*// da gsang dbang bskur ba ni/ gnas bzhir bdud rtsi'i thig le gnyis btud du bzhag cing sngags lan gnyis brjod par bya ba ste/ dpral bar bo dhi tsit+ta a zhes dang pos don dam byang sems kyi rtogs pa brtan par gyur bas bde chen 'khor lo lha rnam snang 'od du zhu ste dmigs par gyur/ gnyis pa kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la thugs rje'i nus pa rgyas te rang lus 'gro ba gang gis mthong ba de'i lus kyi sdig sgrib 'dag nus par gyur/ yang mgrin par bo dhi tsit+ta āḥ zhes dang pos longs spyod 'khor lo'i 'od dpag med mi dmigs par yal/ gnyis pa kun rdzob byang sems kyi nus pa rgyas te rang gi gsung sus thos kyi dag gi sdig sgrib 'dag nus par gyur/ yang snying gar bo dhi tsit+ta hūm̐/ zhes dang pos chos kyi 'khor lo'i mi bskyod pa mi dmigs par yal/ gnyis pas kun rdzob (121)kyi nus pa rgyas te rang gi nyams rtogs mngon shes kyis gzhan bde ba la 'god cing sus dran gyi yid sgrib 'dags nus par gyur/ yang lte bar bo dhi tsit+ta hrīḥzhes dang pos sprul pa'i 'khor lo rin 'byung mi dmigs par yal/ gnyis pas kun rdzob la nus pa thob ste rjes su 'jug pa'i slob ma la yon tan skyes nas dran rtog thams cad sangs rgyas kyi phrin las su 'char nus par 'gyur/ de nyid brtan byed du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bdud rtsi lan gsum blud pas rtsa khams kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams dgyes pa las skal ldan la dag snang du shar ba'i dngos rtags rang la nga rgyal med par mtshan dpe sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gzhan ngo la snang bar 'gyur te/

'gro don rtsol med lhun grub tu 'byung ba yin no// des gsang dbang song*// da shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ sngon byung ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos snying po don gyi bsam gtan zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas/ ye shes bzhi po thugs su chud de/ gzhan don mdzad par dgongs pa la/ lha tshangs pas gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes te/ mchod rten rnam dag la lta sgom gyi zhen pa phul nas sgom pa bdag po la gtad/ gzhan don phrin las kyi lung blangs te wā ra ṇa sir bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor/ de nas bya rgod phung po'i ri dang rgyal po'i khab tu snying po don gyi 'khor lo bskor ba rnams/ kun dga' bos bsdus/ don brgyud 'phags pa byams pas zin te/ rim par thogs med sogs 'phags pa'i brgyud pa gsum/ sprul pa'i sku gcig /grub thob kyi brgyud pa gsum ste bdun gyi bar chig brgyud du babs pa las/ zhig po sku mched dang thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras sogs mkhas grub kyi skyes bu (122)dam pa rnams kyis legs par spel bas da lta'i bar du snying po'i don brgyud ma chad pa yin no// rtsa ba'i don de slob ma'i rgyud la ji ltar bskur na/ glegs bam gyi dbus su mañji'i steng du zhi ba'i 'brang rgyas bzhag pa la gzungs thag btags te de la dpon slob thams cad kyis 'jus nas/ 'o bzlas lung dbog cing sgom pa bdag po la gtod pa yin pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ oṃ shān+ting ku ru swā hā/ zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig dang*/ da ni bdag mnyam rjes dbyer med du 'dres phyin chad nas/ sems can gyi don las rang don du blta rgyu med do// mi lta/ lta re shi/ lta na'ang nga la sdig /mi sgom/ sgom re shi*/ sgom na'ang ngal sdig /mi spyod/ spyod re shi /spyod na'ang nga la sdig /mi sgrub/ sgrub re shi /sgrub na'ang nga la sdig /ces bro bor/ slob dpon gyis/

'o rang 'dod kyi lta spyod sgom sgrub rnams spongs la/ rjes spyod zhi ba'i phrin las kyis sems can gyi don mdzod cig /ces brjod// de bzhin du zhi ba'i 'brang rgyas shul du rgyas pa sogs kyi 'brang rgyas rim par spo ba la gzungs thag nas 'jus te/ rgyas pa la/ oṃ puṣ+ṭi da ku ru swā hā/ dbang la/ oṃ wa shaṃ ku ru swā hā/ drag po la/ oṃ rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig re'i rjes su/ lta spyod sgom sgrub bzhi rang don la 'khris pa'i gnyen po bshig byed kyi mna'ang skyal du gzhug cing*/ rjes spyod phrin las gang byed kyis sems can gyi don mdzod cig /ces gdams so// de nas lung ston pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ a k+ṣaḥlnga bcu po nas dang bsres pa thod pa'i nang du blugs la bla mas rten 'brel snying po mang du bzlas rjes/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas (123)dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i rtsal snang rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pas lud gsal por ston cig /ces dmod dor nas/ slob mar yi ge len du bcug la/ de bla ma la phul nas/ bla mas lung ston te/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ ī ṛ ya sha rnams gang rigs 'dug na/ 'di ni shar phyogs rlung gi yi ge yin pas/ khyod zhing khams mngon par dga' bar sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa'i rigs su 'tshang rgya/ mtshan rdo rje'am yi ge gang yin las gras pa'i mtshan thob/ brgyud pa zin pa'i slob ma shar nas 'ong*/ yi dam rdo rje'i rigs sgrub thag nye/ nad rlung nad ldang*/ gdon rgyal 'gong gnod/ mi rigs rlung shas che/ lha min gyi skye sgo dgag pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya/ rang gi ming yig thog ma dang ngos bzung ba'i yi ge gcig tu babs na rab/ ma bu grogs su gyur pa 'bring*/ dgra gshed du gyur na tha ma'o// yang*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya e au ṝ ra ṣa/

'di ni lho phyogs me'i yi ge yin pas/ khyod zhing khams dpal dang ldan par rin chen 'byung gnas gyi rigs su 'tshang rgya/ mtshan rin chen nam rang yig las gras pa/ brgyud 'dzin lho/ lho rin chen rigs/ nad tshad pa/ gdon pho gdon/ mi rigs me/ dmyal ba'i skye sgo bgag /rang gi ming thog babs pa rab/ ma bu grogs gsum 'bring*/ dgra gyur tha ma'o// yang*/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa a ā aṃ aḥk+ṣa/ 'di ni nub phyogs nam mkha' lcags kyi yi ge yin pas/ khyod bde ba can du snang mtha'i rigs su 'tshang rgya/ ming pad+ma'am rang yig la gras pa/ brgyud 'dzin nub/ lha pad+ma'i rigs/ nad lha nad/ gdon lha gdon/ mi rigs nam mkha'/ lha'i skye sgo dgag /ming yig thog ma la babs pa rab/ (124)ma bu grogs gsum 'bring*/ dgra gyur tha ma'o// yang*/ pa pha ba bha ma u ū l̥ ha wa/ 'di ni byang phyogs chu yi ga yin pas/ zhing khams las rab tu don yod grub pa'i rigs su 'tshang rgya/ ming karma'am rang yig las drangs pa brgyud 'dzin byang*/ lha las rigs/ nad grang ba/ gdon mo gdon/ mi rigs chu/ yi dwags kyi skye sgo dgag /rang gi ming yig thog ma byung na rab/ ma bu grogs gsum 'bring*/ dgrar gyur tha ma'o// yang*/ ta tha da dha na o au l̥ la sa/ 'di ni dbus dang mtshams kyi yi ge yin pas/ zhing stug po bkod par rnam snang gi rigs su 'tshang rgya/ mtshan de bzhin gshegs pa'am yi ge gang yin las gras pa/ brgyud 'dzin dbus sam mtshams nas 'od lha bud+dha'i rigs/ nad sa nad/ gdon sa gdon/ mi rigs sa/ 'dod lha'i skye sgo dgag pa la 'bad/ rang gi ming yig thog ma byung na rab/ ma bu grogs gsum 'bring*/ dgra gyur tha ma'o// de yang yi ge'i rigs dang ma bu dgra grogs la brten nas/ rab tu gyur na bla ma brten dus nas rang gzhan gyi don grub/ 'bring gis dka' thub thems dus nas rang gzhan gyi don grub/ tha mas dpa' chen las la sbyar dus nas rang gzhan gyi don sgrub nus pa yin no// des sher dbang song*/

da tshig dbang bskur ba ni/ las la sbyar ba'i sngags sgom pa bdag gtod kyi snying po ci byas gzhan don 'ba' zhig tu 'gro ba'i sngags yin pas 'di'i lung long zhig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥgu ru bhuhu ku ru hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum/ de brtan byed kyi snying po bzlas pa'i me tog 'thor zhing*/ grub par gyur cig /ces lan gsum/ des sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las pa bla ma sprul pa'i sku'i sku gsung thugs slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnyis med du thim pas shes sgrib phra mo rnams kyang dag (125)tshogs chen rdzogs nas dbang phyug chen po drug ga dus gcig la thob par 'gyur ba yin no// dam thug gi chos gsum ste/ rten sdom pa gsum dang ldan zhing*/ rnal 'byor gyi rangs drug ma nyams pa'i sgrub pa po des dri ma bzhi bsrung bar bya ste/ 'khor ba spang byar mthong na rang thog tu bo bas rigs drug rang sems su shes par bya/ 'bras bu'i sgrub blo ma dag na gzhan thog tu zags pas sku bzhi rang chas su shes par bya/ re dogs kyi mtha' ma sel na go thog tu ltems pas yul sems thams cad bsam pa'i rang gzugs su shes par bya/ spyod lam tha mal du shor na tshe 'dir log pas mi tshe sgrub pa la skyal bar bya'o// de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi mthar sgrub pa sgom pa bdag gtad kyi dbang bskur ba tshang ba yin pas nged la gtong rag gi phyag gsum 'tshol la/ bka' drin che lags zhes brjod/ lam phyi ma bzhi la'ang 'jug yon dang lam lnga ka'i rjes su gtong rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dbang chog las mi 'byung yang spyi 'gro ltar phyag len du gnang ba mi 'gal lo// rjes chog bdun po blo sbyong ltar bya'o// lam lnga las thar lam sgom pa bdag gtod kyi dbang ste lam lnga'i dbang chog tshar ro// i thi/// /oṃ swa sti/ gnyis pa dbang po 'bring gi gang zag smin par byed pa lam gsum gzhung ma'i dbang la gsum las/

dang po blo sbyong gi snga ma dang 'dra ba las lam lnga thob pa des go chod mod/ ma thob na 'dir blangs nas bskur ro// gnyis pa dka' thub la/ bshams bkod dang bdud rtsi'i phrad ka ras bya ba rnams 'dra ba las/ khyad par yig 'bru rnams bla ma longs sku bde mchog gi lha tshogs su byin gyis brlabs/ de nas slob ma rnams 'dus pa dang*/ 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dbang 'bring smin byed lam (126)gsum gzhung ma la legs pa'i lam gsum las blo sbyong tshar nas 'dir dka' thub kyi dbang zhus nas nyams su blang snyam pas gsan 'tshal/ de'ang dbyings rnal 'byor gsum las/ byed pa lam gyi rnal 'byor la yang gsum gyi gnyis pa dka' thub kyi dbang gi skabs yin/ 'di la'ang gzhan las khyad par lngas 'phags pa'i dbang bka' srol 'gran zla dang bral ba lags pas thugs spro ba bskyed nas/ thog mar sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi rjes zlos/ bla ma dam pa rnams la zhes pa nas/ de kho na bzhin du grub par gyur cig /ces pa'i bar lan gsum/ dngos gzhi la dbang bzhi las/ dang po bum pa'i dbang ni/ mig yul gyi gzugs snang dang rang gi phung khams skye mched skra sen sogs thams cad bla ma bde mchog yab yum gyi skur sgom la 'di'i rjes zlos/ thur ma btsugs la ak+ṣaḥbarjod/ rna ba'i yul gyi sgra grags dang*/ rang gi brjod pa thams cad bla ma bde mchog gi gsung du mos la ak+ṣaḥbarjod/ gzhan snang gi dran rtog dang rang gi 'char sgo thams cad bla ma bde mchog gi thugs su mos la ak+ṣaḥsnang grags dran pa'i chos thams cad kyang rang gi sems las byung zhing sems gdod nas stong pa nyid du dag pa las snang grag dran pa thams cad rang bzhin ma 'gags pa'i rang rtsal tsam du shes pa 'di'i ak+ṣaḥbarjod/ brtan byed bdud rtsi'i rdul phra rab re re bzhin bde mchog tu gyur pa spyi bo nas thim pas rtsa khams kyi yi ge'i sgrib pa dag nas yi ge rnams bla ma bde mchog yab yum gyi skur gyur pa'i mos pas/

brod pa'i bdud rtsi spyi bor bzhag cing ak+ṣaḥtshar gcig brjod do// gsang dbang bskur ba ni/ a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca āḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ zhes gnas bzhir srin lag gis bdud rtsi'i thig le bkod (127)pas bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i bde mchog spyi bor dkar po/ mgrin par dmar po/ thugs kar sngon po/ lte bar ser po rnams tshon gang pa re res rgyas btab par gyur/ brtan byed oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bdud rtsi lan gsum blud pas/ yi dam gyi lha thams cad kyi thugs dam dus gcig la skong nas nyams rtogs dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam mo// sher dbang bskur ba ni/ lus chos bdun bca'/ ngag rlung kha sbyar/ rlung sems 'od gsal gyi mdangs la bcings te/ thun 'gor sgrims slod kyi tshul gyis spyan lnga dang sbyar bas dug lnga'i rtog pa phra rags bcad/ thun mjug tu lta stangs lngas re dogs chags sdang che thabs dang lnga po rang sar 'dag tu bcug /mnyam bzhag de las langs nas thun mtshams su spyod lam bzhi ka la lta stangs lnga bsgyur/ lta stangs re la spyan lngas sgrim slod kyi tshul gyis nyams su blang 'tshal/ brtan byed snang grags 'gyu gsum/ sgyu ma/ brag cha/ chu lbur ltar shes par mdzod cig /tshig dbang bskur ba ni/ dam pa rin po che brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i bla ma grub thob rnams kyi yi dam bde mchog lags legs pas snying po 'di'i rjes/ oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ brtan byed bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bde mchog rang la thim par sgoms shig /me tog 'thor zhing grub par gyur cig /ces lan gsum/ de ltar dbang bzhi rdzogs nas mjug gi chos gsum ni/ rten sdom pa gsum dang ldan zhing*/ rnal 'byor gyi rang sa drug ma nyams pa'i sgo nas/ dka' thub kyi bo zags ltems log bzhi'i dri ma bsrung ba la 'bad par mdzod cig

/des dka' thub kyi byin gyis brlabs tshar bas drin phyag gsum 'tshol la/ bka' drin che lags/ zhes brjod/ rjes chog bdun (128)sngar ltar ro// gsum pa thar lam bdag gtod la/ bshams bkod bdud rtsi'i phrad sogs sngar gyi thar lam ltar las/ khyad par yig 'bru'i lha rnams mi dmigs par yal ba las mkha' 'gro sde lngar byin gyis brlab bo// de nas slob ma rnams gral du 'khod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du legs pa'i lam gsum pa thar lam bdag gtod ye shes gzhan 'jug gi dbang zhus nas nyams su blang snyam pas gsan 'tshal/ dbang 'di yang dbang gzhan las khyad par lngas 'phags pas thugs sngo ba bskyed nas thog mar sbyor ba skyabs sems kyi rjes zlos/ bla ma dam pa rnams la sogs lan gsum brjod/ dngos gzhi la dbang bzhi las/ bum dbang ni/ glegs bam gyi yig 'bru la thur ma lugs ldog gis btsugs pa la a 'ba' zhag lnga bcu tshar bzhi brjod/ dang po'i tshe skad cig dang po la lhar 'dzin gyi snang ba dbyings su thim nas/ skad cig gnyis pa la ma 'gags pa'i rang rtsal du snang ba thams cad bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i skur shes par gyis shig /lan gnyis pa'i tshe/ skad cig dang po la grag pa gsum 'dzin dbyings su thim nas/ skad cig gnyis par ma 'gags pa'i rang rtsal sgra thams cad bla ma mkha' 'gro'i gsung du shes par gyis shig /lan gsum pa'i tshe/ skad cig dang po la dran rtog thugs 'dzin dbyings su thim nas/ skad cig gnyis par ma 'gags pa'i rang rtsal du dran rtog thams cad bla ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs su shes par gyis shig /bzhi pa'i tshe/ skad cig dang po la snang grags dran rtog sems las byung zhing sems stong pa nyid kyi dbyings su thim nas/ skad cig gnyis pa la de'i rang rtsal las 'gro don phyogs med du grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ brtan byed (129)bdud rtsi'i char gyi rnam par tshangs bug nas thim pas rtsa khams kyi lha tshogs dbyings su thim nas rtsa khams thams cad mkha' 'gro sde lngar gyur par sgoms mdzod/

ces thod pa'i bdud rtsi spyi bor bzhag cing ak+ṣaḥlnga bcu brjod gsang dbang ni/ bo dhi tsit+ta oṃḥ bo dhi tsit+ta āḥ bo dhi tsit+ta hūm̐/ bo dhi tsit+ta hrī: zhes sngags bzhi po re re nas char gnyis bzlas pa dang bstun/ gnas bzhir bdud rtsi'i thig le gnyis re byas pa'i dang po'i rkyen gyis/ 'khor lo bzhi'i las bzhi po 'od du zhu nas mi dmigs pas lhar 'dzin gyi rtog pa dbyings su thim/ gnyis pas mkha' 'gro spyi bor dkar mo// mgrin par dmar mo// snying gar sngon mo// lte bar ser mo rnams bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan dbyer med pa'i mos pa mdzad 'tshal/ brtan byed oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bdud rtsi lan gsum blud pas/ 'gro don rtsol med lhun grub tu shar bar 'gyur/ sher dbang ni/ glegs bam gyi khar mañji bzhag pa'i 'og tu thod pa'i nang du ak+ṣaḥlnga bcu nas dang bsres pa la rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas byas nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun bkod pa zhig gis kha bcad la bzhag /mañji'i khar las bzhi gang yin gyi 'brang rgyas bkod pa la gzungs thag btags nas/ de la thams cad kyis 'jus te/ bzlas lung dpog cing sgom pa bdag po la gtod pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ zhe bar/ oṃ shān+ting ku ru swā hā/ rgyas par/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ dbang la/ wā shaṃ /drag po la/ rak+ṣas= rjes la/ lan gsum re bzlas/ de bzhi re re'i gsham du/ da phyin chad rang don du mi lta/ lta re shi /lta na'ang nga la sdig /mi sgom= mi spyod/ mi sgrub sogs rig 'gre sbyar/ mjug tu bla mas/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyed rnams kyis gang dang gang gis 'dul ba'i phrin las kyis sems can gyi don gyis shig /ces gdams/ (130)rdo rjes bhan+dha'i yig 'bru la dmod bor nas len du bcug la/ bla mas sngar ltar lung ston/ 'on kyang lam lnga'i bdag gtod thob na 'dir ma byas kyang chog gsung ngo*// tshig dbang na sgom pa bdag gtod kyi snying po yin pas 'di'i lung long zhig

/oṃ āḥhrāḥhi ri ni sa hūm̐/ zhes bzlar bcug /brtan byed bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba de khyed rang la tham pa'i mos pa mdzod/ me tog 'thor zhing grub par gyur cig /ces lan gsum brjod/ de ltar dbang bzhi thob nas mjug gi chos gsum ni/ rten sdom pa gsung dang ldan zhing rang sa drug ma nyams pa'i sgo nas bdag gtod kyi bo zags ltems log bzhi'i dri ma bsrung ba la 'bad par mdzod cig /de bdag gtod kyi byin rlabs tshar bas bla ma la drin phyag gi phyag gsum 'tshol la/ bka' drin che lags zhes brjod/ rjes chog bdun sngar ltar ba'o// dbang po 'bring smin byed lam gsum gzhung ma'i dbang chog tshar ro// oṃ swa sti/ gsum pa dbang rnon la rdzogs pa'i dbang gcig ma'am zab mo ku su lu'i dbang zhes pa lam gsum glegs bam la mi ltos par bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bsgrub pa ting nge 'dzin lam gsum gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ phyag bzhes su glegs bam gshams par mdzad cing*/ de yang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'dir glegs bam gyi khar nas phung par spungs pas dbyibs sgyur mor byas pa'i steng du bhañja dam rdzas gur dang bcas pa bshams shing phyogs bzhir 'brang rgyas kyis bskor ba sogs gzhan 'dra bar mdzod/ cho ga ni bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas tshogs dang dbang rdzas byin rlabs byas la/ slob ma rnams khrus phyag sngon 'gros gral du 'khod pa dang*/ 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dbang rnon smin par byed pa zab mo ku su lu'i dbang ting nge 'dzin lam gsum gyi byin rlabs zhus (131)la nyams su blang snyam pas gsan 'tshal/ des na sprul pa'i sku rje btsun dam pa rgya gar ba'i bka' drin gyis brda la brten nas don gcer mthong du rtogs shing*/ byin rlabs rang byung du babs pa/ nyams ye shes su 'bar ba bla ma rdzong pa'i lugs kyi blo sbyong dka' thub bdag gtong gsum dus gcig tu bskur ba'i bka' srol gyi dbang 'di sgrub par byed pa la/

thog mar sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi rjes zlos/ bla ma dam pa rnams la zhes pa nas/ de kho na bzhin du grub par gyur cig /ces pa'i bar lan gsum/ dngos gzhi la lan gsum gyi/ dang po bla ma chos skur sgrub pa/ bsnyen pa blo sbyong gi dbang bzhi las/ bum dbang gi lam khyer ni/ slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis ka yi dam bde mchog gi skur gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan/ spyi mgrin snying lte'i gnas bzhir 'khor lo bzhi re re la'ang rtsa 'dab lnga bcur gnas pa'i 'dab ma la ā li kā li'i yig 'bru rnams spyi bor dkar po/ mgrin par dmar po/ snying gar sngon po/ lte bar ser po rnams gsal bar gyur/ de nas ak+ṣaḥlan bzhi rjes zlos byas pa'i lan dang pos/ bla ma rnam pa yi dam la ngo bo chos sku'i bdag nyid can du bzhugs pa'i spyi bo'i yig 'bru las 'od zer dkar po 'phros smin mtshams nas thon/ rang rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs te spyi bo'i yig 'bru rnams la thim pas/ yig 'bru rnams las 'od dkar po gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de lus kyi nang thams cad gang*// lus kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ lus shel sgong ltar gyur/ gzugs snang thams cad bla ma'i skur shar ba'i mos pa sgom du gzhug /lan gnyis pas/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i yig 'bru las 'od dmar po 'phros ljags steng nas thon// (132)rang rang gi mgrin par thim pas yig 'bru las byung ba'i 'od dmar pos lus gang*/ ngag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ lus mchong ltar dmar ltem gyis song*/ sgra grags thams cad bla ma'i gsung du shar bar mos/ yang lan gsum pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i yig 'bru las 'od sngon po 'phros/ rang rang gi snying gar thim pas yig 'bru las byung ba'i 'od sngon pos lus nang gang*/ sems kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rang lus 'ja' tshon ltar dngas par gyur/ dran rtog thams cad bla ma'i thugs su shar bar mos/

yang lan bzhi bas bla ma'i lte ba'i yig 'bru las 'od zer ser po thon/ rang rang gi lte bar thim pas yig 'bru las byung ba'i 'od ser pos lus nang gang*/ sgo gsum phra ba bag chags kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ rang lus nam mkha' gser gyi kha dog lta bur dwangs/ snang grags dran pa'i chos thams cad stong nyid kyi rtsal tsam las yang dag par bden par ma grub pa'i gshis rnam par dag pa da bla ma'i dgongs pa chu la chu bzhag pa ltar dbyer med du mos la mnyam par bzhag go /gsang dbang gi lam khyer ni/ a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca āḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ zhes srin lag gis bdud rtsi'i thig le gnas bzhir bkod pas/ spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar āḥdamar po// snying gar rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar rin chen ser po zur brgyad pa'i lte bar hrīḥser po rnams/ bla ma'i sku rdo rje/ gsung rdo rje/ thugs rdo rje/ yon tan phrin las 'dus pa'i rdo rje'i ngo bor mos pa mdzod/ sher dbang gi lam khyer ni/ lus gnad chos bdun bca'/ rlung steng 'og kha sbyar la dbu mar bcug /yid bral ba gsum ngang du dal bas pa'o// sems ma bcos (133)par rtsen gyis zhog la sgrim slod kyis nyams su blangs pas nyams rtogs je bzang la 'gro ba yin no// tshig dbang lam khyer ni/ spyi bor bla ma chos kyi sku nam mkha'i gos can gyi rnam par gsal thob la blo sbyong ba'i snying po 'di'i lung longs shig /oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru sid+dhi hūm̐/ lan gsum/ spyi bo'i bla ma rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ me tog 'thor cing grub par gyur cig /ces brjod/ gnyis pa bla ma yi dam gyi lhar sgrub par byed pa sgrub pa dka' thub kyi dbang la bzhi las/ bum dbang gi lam khyer ni/

ak+ṣaḥ'i rjes zlos lan bzhi byas pa'i dang pos/ bla ma bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal ba'i smin mtshams nas yi ge'i 'od zer dkar po thon/ rang gi spyi bor thim pas/ rang lus dang phyi'i yul snang thams cad bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sku snang stong du gyur par mos/ lan gnyis pas/ zhal nas yig 'bru'i 'od dmar po thon/ rang gi mgrin par thim pas rang gi ngag nas ci brjod dang phyi rol gyi sgra thams cad lhan skyes kyi grags stong gzhom med du mos/ lan gsum pas/ thugs ka nas yig 'bru'i 'od zer mthing ga thon/ rang gi snying gar thim pas/ rang gi rtog pa ci 'gyus dang gzhan rgyud kyi dran rtog thams cad kyang lhan skyes su yod pas de dag thams cad kyang de las ma 'das par thag bcad do// lan bzhi pa/ lte ba nas yig 'bru'i 'od zer ser po thon/ rang gi lte bar thim pas bla ma bde mchog tu gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan dang bcas rang la brgyan par mos la mnyam par bzhag go /gsang dbang lam khyer ni/ 'khor lo bzhi'i lte ba'i yi ge oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥrnams 'od du zhu ba las/ spyi bor sku'i bde mchog dkar po/ mgrin par gsung (134)gi bde mchog dmar po/ snying gar thugs kyi bde mchog sngon po/ lte bar yon tan gyi bde mchog ser po rnams kyis rgyas btab par gyur/ sher dbang lam khyer ni/ lus gnad chos bdun bca'/ rlung gnad kha sbyar la 'gyu ba bcad/ yid sgom 'dod kyi rtog pa spangs la/ spyan lnga bsgyur bar bya ste/ de'ang nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa shin tu rags pa la rus sbal lta bu/ tha mal rang ga la zla tshes lta bu/ tha ma rkun bu la mkhal ma lta bu/ shes pa dran med 'thibs po la zla ba nya gang ba lta bu'i spyan gyis nam mkha'i dbyings su lta zhing*/ gsal bdo ba la bshig pas rjes ble bral du 'char ro// thun mtshams su nyal 'dug langs 'gro'i rtsa ba'i spyod lam bzhi la yan lag lnga lngar phye ba'i nyi shu dang*/

lta stangs lnga la spyan lnga bsgyur pas thams cad du yengs pa med par bskyang bar byos shig /tshig dbang lam khyer ni/ rgyu rtsal bzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas yi dam bde mchog gi snying po 'di yi lung long zhig /oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ bla ma bde mchog tu gsal pa rang la thim pa'i mos pa gyis me tog 'thor zhing grub par gyur cig /ces brjod/ gsum pa bla ma mkha' 'gror sgrub pa las sbyor sgom pa bdag gtod kyi dbang la bzhi las/ bum dbang lam khyer ni/ a yig lnga bcu'i rjes zlos lan bzhi'i dang pos/ bla ma rdo rje mkha' 'gror gsal ba'i smin mtshams nas a dkar po thon/ rang gi spyi bor thim pas/ phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad skye med kyi klong du yal/ ma 'gags pa'i rtsal snang du shar ba'i gzugs thams cad rdo rje ḍā ki'i sku snang stong du gyur par mos/ lan gnyis pas/ ljags steng nas a dmar po thon/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ sgrar grags thams cad skye med kyi klong du yal (135)ma 'gags pa'i rtsal du shar ba'i sgra thams cad rdo rje ḍā ka'i gsung grags stong gzhom med du mos/ lan gsum pas/ thugs ka nas a sngon po thon/ rang gi snying gar thim/ dran rtog thams cad skye med kyi klong du yal/ ma 'gags pa'i rtsal du shar ba'i dran rtog thams cad rdo rje ḍā ki'i thugs bde stong du mos/ lan bzhi pas/ lte ba nas a ser po thon/ rang gi lte bar thim/ snang grags 'gyu gsum thams cad skye med kyi klong du yal/ ma 'gags pa'i rtsal du shar ba'i snang grags dran rtog thams cad rdo rje ḍā ki'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol par mos la mnyam par bzhag go /gsang dbang lam khyer ni/ 'khor lo bzhi'i lte ba'i bde mchog yab yum la thim/ yum rnams yongs su gyur pa las mkha' 'gro bzhir gyur te/ spyi bor sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo dpral bar 'phyar bas snang ba thams cad zil gyis gnon pa/

mgrin par pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo g.yas pad+ma mgrin par 'dzin pas snang ba thams cad dbang du sdud pa/ snying gar rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pas snang ba dag cing las su rung bar byed pa/ lte bar rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo rin chen lte bar 'dzin pas dgos 'dod thams cad sgrub pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin cing*/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa ro'i gdan la gar stabs kyis me'i dbus su bzhugs pas rgyas btab pa'o// sher dbang lam khyer ni/ da phyin chad sems can gyi don ma gtogs rang don du mi lta/ mi sgom/ mi spyod/ mi sgrub snyam du rang don du rang la 'khril ba'i gnyen po bshig cing*/ blo thag bcad nas gzhan don du ci 'gyur la bslab par byos shig /(136)tshig dbang lam khyer ni/ mkha' 'gro rnams las la bkol ba'i phyir 'khor lo bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams la dmigs pa gtad nas bla ma mkha' 'gror sgrub pa'i lung 'di longs shig /oṃ āḥhrīḥha ri ni sa hūm̐/ lan gsum/ bla ma ḍā kir gsal ba rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par mos/ 'grub par gyur cig /ces me tog dor/ des blo sbyong dka' thub bdag gtod gsum ting nge 'dzin la brten nas stan thog gcig tu bskur ba ku su lu'i nyams len rdzong pa'i dbang gcig mar grags pa de tshar ba lags pas bla ma la drin phyag gsum 'tshol/ bka' drin che lags/ zhes brjod/ de nas rjes kyi cho ga rnams sngar gyi 'gros ltar shes par bya'o// dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi dbang chog bklag pas grub pa las/ bka' babs phyi ma'i rtsa ba glegs bam gyi dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bshad pa'i le tshan no// dar rgyas 'phel/// /oṃ swa sti/ na mo gu ru kā ma la shī lā ya/ 'dir rten 'brel gyi sngon du rten 'brel gyi bdag po gtod bzhes bya ba dam pa rin po che phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bla sgrub kyi dbang bskur ba ni/

stegs bu'i steng du dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi phyir rdo ra me 'od dang bcas pas bskor ba'i lta bar kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du dam pa'i sku bris 'bur gang rigs bzhugs pa'i mdun du hūm̐ yig bri/ mchod gtor ci 'byor pa bshams la/ bdag bskyed ni/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā was chos thams cad rang bzhin med par sbyangs/ de'i ngang las gzung 'dzin dag pa'i sems nyid de/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces pa'i sngags sgras sad pa las/ skad cig gis pad nyi zla ba'i steng du bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdor dril 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi rtse mor nor bu dang ngos la sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon ngos su zla phyed/ (137)mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ rus pa'i 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rgyan drug /thod pa skam po'i dbu rgyan/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo'i do shal/ dpa' bo'i dar dpyang*/ stag sham grol ba/ zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis dus mtshan dang 'jigs byed mnan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgus sgeg pa/ yum phag mo dmar mo g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang*/ g.yon thod khrag bsnams pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gnyis ka'ang gnyug sems lhan skyes bde stong zung 'jug gi snang brnyan mkha' khyab kyi sangs rgyas thams cad dang dbyer med pa'i bdag nyid ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// yab kyi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i 'khor lo sbyangs/ slar 'dus nas rang la thim par mos la/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas mthar/ mchod gtor rnams/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las snod phun sum tshogs par/

ā las mchod pa'i yo byad rang bzhin bde stong*/ rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las zag med kyi bde bas tshim par byed pa/ hūm̐ gis mkha' khyab tu spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ thugs ka nas spros pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rang la mchod par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shab+da'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ rtsa sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes pas gsang mchod phul nas/ dpal ldan bde mchog 'khor lo ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum (138)nyid// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ snod bcud 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi bar rim gyis thim/ de yang gyen rdzogs 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim par gyur/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag /'od gsal gyi ngang las slar yang he ru ka'i skur gyur/ mdun bskyed ni/ swa bhā was mdun gyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bsrung ba'i 'khor los mi phyed par bcings pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa yongs su rgyas pa'i dbus su mi 'jigs pa seng ge'i khri/ ma chags pa pad+ma'i gdan/ thugs rje nyi ma'i gdan/ byang sems kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pa'i steng du rje btsun dam pa rgya gar ba drang srong chen po du ba'i mdog can/ mig dmar skra'i lwa ba can phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon rten 'brel gyi par bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sku stod gcer bur phyung zhing sku smad la bal thul dkar po gsol ba/ rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing*/ 'khor 'das zil gyis gnon pa'i lta stangs mdzad pa/ gang 'dul sku gsum gyi rol pa ma 'gags par ston pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du bzhugs pa/ phyi rol gyi 'dab ma brgyad la mdun nas/ g.yas skor du rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/

yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dkon mchog /chos dkon mchog yum chen mo'i rnam pa can/ dge 'dun dkon mchog sa bcu'i byang sems/ gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro/ zhing skyong*/ dam can srung ma rnams sprin phung gtibs pa ltar bzhugs par gyur/ de ltar gsal ba'i gtso bo'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas dus gsum gyi sangs (139)rgyas byang sems yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par bsdus/ yi ge gsum la thim pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor mos la/ tshogs bsags pa ni/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug mi pham mgon// dam pa sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i rje// bka' babs gsum gyi chos 'khor bskor// rnal 'byor dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro zhing skyong dang*// dam can bcas la gus phyag 'tshal// mchod pa bla na med pas mchod// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// bdag gis dge ba ci bsags pa// sems can kun la bsngo bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum la sogs pa ci nus bya'o// de nas byin rlabs dbab pa'i bzlas pa bya ste/ dam pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po byung*/ rang gi snying gar thim pas rje btsun gyi thugs la mnga' ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang byang chub kyi sems dang*/ nyams dang rtogs pa khyad par can thams cad bdag rgyud la skyes par mos la/ oṃ gu ru ka ma la shī la/ na ma bdag la dz+nyā na ā be sha ya gu ru hrīḥbaṃ swā hā/ zhes ngar dang bcas pas ci nus bzla'o// de rjes slob ma byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir sku gsum gyi bzlas pa'ang cung zad re bya ste/
