mdun gyi bla ma sprul sku'i bdag nyid du bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis reg pas lus kyi dri ma dag nas gang 'dul gyi phrin las 'grub par mos la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru nirma kā ya (140)sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes bzlas/ yang bla ma longs sku'i bdag nyid du bzhugs pa'i sku'i 'od kyis ngag sgrib dag nas snang ba thams cad dag pa rab 'byams su 'char ba mos la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru sam+bho kā ya sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes bzla/ yang bla ma chos sku'i bdag nyid du bzhugs pa'i sku'i 'od kyis yid sgrib dag nas rig pa spros bral du 'char bar mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dharma kā ya sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o// de nas byin rlabs zhu ba ni/ dam pa rin po ches bdag gi lus gzi brjid dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dam pa'i smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros rang gi dpral bar thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib dag nas lus dam pa'i skur gyur/ yang dam pa rin po ches bdag gi dag nus pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dam pa'i mgrin pa nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros rang gi mgrin par thim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib dag nas ngag nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ yang dam pa rin po ches bdag gi sems rtogs pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dam pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros rang gi snying gar thim pas rang rgyud kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes par gyur/ mdun gyi dam pa'i sku 'od du zhu ba rang gi snying gar thim pas/ rang lus kyang 'od du zhu ste a dkar po gcig tu gyur pa la sems bzung*/ de'ang nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim par gyur/ de yi ngang las bdag dang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad sngar bzhin bkra lam gyis gsal bar gyur/

de nas slob ma khrus dang phyag byas gral du 'khod (141)pa la sems bskyed chos bshad ci rigs sngon du btang nas/ 'dir zhi byed bka' babs phyi ma'i nang tshan rten 'brel gyi sngon du rten 'brel gyi bdag po gtod pa zhes bya ba dam pa rin po che sku gsum gyi sgrub pa phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bla sgrub zab mo'i byin rlabs bskur ba la slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams gang du song*/ da slob ma'i bya ba thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir skyabs sems mchod bsngo smon lam dang bcas pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa nas/ de kho na bzhin du grub par gyur cig /ces pa'i bar lan gsum/ de nas dngos gzhi'i slad du thal mo sbyar te bla ma dang dam pa dbyer med pa la gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma rin po ches/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi don du dam pa rin po che phyi nang gsang gsum gyi ngo bo sprul sku longs sku chos skur smin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas slob ma bde mchog lhan skyes kyi skur gsal ba'i spyi bor rje btsun dam pa rgya gar la rtsa brgyud kyi bla mas bskor ba/ mgrin par dkon mchog gsum/ snying gar bde mchog la yi dam thams cad kyis bskor ba/ lte bar sku gsung thugs kyi mkha' 'gro gsum la mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ de thams cad kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad dang*/ khyad par dam pa rin po che sprul pa'i sku smug nag gzi byin can phyag g.yas rdo rje rin chen sogs rigs lnga'i rgya dang g.yon dril bu 'khrol ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs so so rang rang la sib sib thim pas byin rlabs zhugs par mos la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru nirma kā ya sid+dhi hūm̐ dz+nyā na a be sha (142)ya hrīḥbaṃ swā hā/

zhes spos rol bya/ de rjes su sems ma bcos pa'i ngang la dar gcig mnyam par bzhag go /yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sogs dang*/ khyad par dam pa rin po che longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan can rdor dril thugs kar bsnol zhing skyil krung gis bzhugs pa spyan nam mkha' la gzigs pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te thim pas byin rlabs zhugs par mos/ oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru sam+bho kā ya sid+dhi hūm̐ dz+nyā na a be sha ya hrīḥbaṃ swā hāḥ spos rol bya/ de'i ngang mdangs bskyang la mnyam par zhog /yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sogs dang khyad par dam pa rin po che chos kyi sku nam mkha'i chos gos can dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te thim pas byin rlabs zhugs par mos/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hring hring*/ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhrīḥgu ru dharma kā ya sid+dhi hūm̐ dz+nyā na a be sha ya hrīḥbaṃ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ spos rol bya/ sems nyid rtsol bral gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag /de nas rtsa ba gsum gcud la bor te dbang byin pa las/ dang po bla ma gcud la bor te gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes/ kun rdzob tu bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden nam mi bden/ kun rdzob tu bla ma rnams kyi bka' bden na/ bdag dam pa rin po che sprul sku longs sku chos sku sgyu ma lta bur da lta nyid du 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi bla ma rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bla ma thams cad rnam pa dam pa rin po che chos longs sprul sku'i rnam par spyan drangs pa dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi bla ma rnams las kyang de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byon nas rang la sib kyis thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad thob par (143)mos la/

oṃ gu ru kā ma la shī la na mo badz+ra pi ṭh+yaṃ dz+nyā na a be sha ya gu ru hrīḥbaṃ swā hā/ zhes dang spos rol bya/ yang yi dam gcud la bor te gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i/ kun rdzob tu sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin dang yi dam gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden nam mi bden/ kun rdzob tu sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin dang yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden na bdag dam pa rin po che sprul sku longs sku chos sku sgyu ma lta bur da lta nyid du grub par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ khyed rang gi mgrin pa dang snying ga'i lha tshogs rnams dang mdun bskyed kyi yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs dus kyi yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dam pa rin po che sku gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs pa dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rnams las de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byon nas rang la thim pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob par mos la/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bā gī shwa ri mūm̐/ oṃ mañju gho ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ bha ri sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ gu ru ka ma la shī la/ kan mo badz+ra pi ṭh+yaṃ dz+nyā na ā be sha ya gu ru hrīḥswā hā/ zhes dang spos rol bya/ yang mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad bcud la bor te gsol ba btab pa 'di'i/ kun rdzob tu dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma mkha' 'gro zhing skyong rnams kyi bka' bden nam mi bden/ kun rdzob tu dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma mkha' 'gro zhing skyong rnams kyi bka' bden na/ bdag dam pa rin po che sprul sku longs sku chos sku sgyu ma lta bur da lta nyid du grub par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ khyed rang gi lte ba dang mdun bskyed kyi mkha' 'gro zhing skyong dam can rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/

phyogs dus kyi mkha' 'gro zhing skyong bsrung ma thugs dam can thams cad (144)dam pa rin po che sku gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs pa dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi mkha' 'gro zhing skyong dam can rnams las kyang de 'dra dpag tu med pa byon nas rang la thim pas phrin las thogs pa med pa'i mthu dang nus pa thob par bsams la/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa ma ma dz+nyā na ā be sha ya hrīḥbaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī dz+nyā na a be sha ya hrīḥbaṃ swā hā/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī dz+nyā na ā be sha ya hrīḥbaṃ swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī dz+nyā na a be sha ya hrīḥbaṃ swā hā/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī dz+nyā na a be sha ya hrīḥbaṃ swā hā/ zhes dang spos rol bya/ de nas bzlas lung ni/ dpon slob gnyis ka dam pa rin po cher gsal ba'i slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs te snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim par bsams la oṃ gu ru ka ma la shī la na ma bdag la dz+nyā na ā be sha ya gu ru hrīḥbaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum/ yang gnyis ka dam pa sku gsung thugs kyi mngon rtogs so sor skur la/ oṃ āḥhrī gu ru nirma kā ya sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes nirma'i tshab tu sam+bho dang bcug pa re re/ yang lan gsum re bzlas mthar/ dam pa chos longs sprul gsum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad skal ldan slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig /ces me tog gtor/ des dam pa phyi nang gsang gsum gyi byin rlabs grub/ dam tshig bzung ba gtong rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams dang*/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu/ bsngo shis kyis mtha' brgyan no/ ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ na mo gu ru maṇ+ḍal pā da bh+yaḥ zhi byed brgyud pa phyi ma'i yi dam gyi skor la// dang po thugs dam bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la gsum las/

sbyor ba la gnyis kyi/ dang po sa chog ni/ bsnyen pa thems pa'i slob dpon gyis yid dang (145)mthun pa'i gnas su bdag bskyed yongs rdzogs sam gtso bo bskyed 'od gsal du bsdu zhing thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang ba'i bar byas la/ sa bslong ba ni/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis gzhi bdag dang zhing skyong gi mchod gtor/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od dang oṃ badz+ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥs mgron bkug /ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ a kā ros gtor ma byin nas/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bya// dkyil 'khor don du stsal du gsol// zhes mchod gtor gshegs/ gzhi der dri'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu can mchod gtor dang bcas bsham la/ byin gyis brlabs/ sa gnon gyi rgyas sor mo dbus ma gsum sa la reg pas/ sa'i lha mo ser mo bum pa 'dzin pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can lte ba yan chad sa'i steng du thon nas bzhugs par gyur pa las/ oṃ pri thi de wī bh+yaḥ zhes pa'i mthar ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ a kā ro btags pas gtor ma phul nas/ skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// mchod cing rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin// lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur// sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// zhes brjod pas gnang ba byin nas de nyid du thim par bsam/ sa sbyong ba ni/ lag mthil sar bzhag la/ oṃ bhū khaṃ/ sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ lam̐ hūm̐/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ ha ha ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ sa gzhi byin gyis brlab par gyur/ sa bzung ba ni/ sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri'o snyams pa'i blos/ rang nyid skad cig gis khro bo bgegs mthar byed ljang gu rgya gram dang dril bu 'dzin pa cher khros pa'i nyams can sprul pa'i khro tshogs dpag med spro ba'i skur gyur/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha la sogs (146)pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig

/ngas ni gnas dkyil 'khor chen po bri// khyed rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// zhes brjod cing drag sngags spos rol dang bcas sprul pa'i khro tshogs me mtshon gyi char 'bebs pas bdud bgegs thams cad bskrad par gyur/ sa bsrung ba ni/ slar 'dus pa las khro bo'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje srung ba'i ra bas bcings te cis kyang mi shigs par bsam mo// sbyor chog gnyis pa la gsum gyi/ lha sta gon ni// skya thig btab pa la/ lha gnas rnams su dri'i thig le tshom bu dang bcas pa bkod/ mchod pa bshams shing brlabs la/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi dang*/ de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ las bdag med ma nag mo gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i phyed skyil can la/ 'dab ma bzhir maṃ praṃ baṃ tāṃ dang*/ rtsibs brgyad la/ a hūm̐/ dhī hūm̐/ hrī hrī/ gaṃ hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba bkra lam gyis gsal bar gyur/ gnas gsum brlab/ ye shes pa spyan drang pa bstim/ dbang bskur mchod bstod rnams byas la/ spos bzung nas/ lce hūm̐ las rdo rjer gyur// ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// 'dir ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// sangs rgyas la sogs kun 'byon 'tshal// dngos grub 'dir ni yang dag stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis snyan gsan dbab/ bum pa sta gon ni/ bum pa gnyis chas su bcug pa rnam rgyal dbus kyi tshom bu'i steng du mañji la bkod/ las bum byang shar du bzhag (147)la mchod pas bskor nas/ bum pa bskyed bzlas 'od zhu'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba'i bum bskyed ltar bya'o// slob ma sta gon ni/

dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgribs la/ slob ma rnams khrus phyag sngon 'gros gral du 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal gdab cing chos bshad ci rigs sngon du btang nas/ 'dir zhi byed bka' babs phyi ma'i thugs dam bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyis dbang bskur ba'i skabs yin/ de la'ang dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro dgos pa las/ deng sang gi gang zag phal cher smin byed kyi rten du bya ba'i dkyil 'khor ni rdul tshon dang ras bris gnyis las/ rdul tshon ltar na nub gnyis pa dang*/ ras bris ltar na nub dang po sta gon gyi skabs lags/ de las lha dang bum pa'i sta gon grub nas/ da slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas bsam pa 'chos pa ni// sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'di phyi'i lha mi'i bde 'byor dang zhi bde nyan rang gi byang chub don du gnyer ba spangs te/ gzhan don du bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir 'jug par bya snyam du sems bskyed 'tshal/ de nas bur bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis slob ma'i sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te 'od du zhu ba las/ bdag med ma'i skur gyur pa pad+ma'i (149)gdan la 'khod par bsam/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i/ na mo// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// he ru ka dpal dgongs su gsol// byang chub sems las rmad byung ba'i// sdom pa rgya mtsho bdag la stsol// lan gsum gnang ba byin pa ni// bu khyod tshur shog theg chen sngags// khyed ni tshul chen snod dang ldan// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyed la yang dag bstan par bya/ de nas thun mong dang khyad par gyi sdom pa mtha' dag bzung snyam pas 'di'i/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// thar pa 'dod phyir skyabs su mchi// sems can kun don sgrub pa'i phyir// byang chub sems gsum bskyed par bgyi// sems can don phyir ma gtogs pa// bya ba ma yin thams cad spong*// gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig ni// bde gshegs lnga yi sdom pa bzung*// bcu bzhir phye ba'i ltung ba dang*// yan lag nyes pa spong bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum/

de nas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dri chus gnas gsum du reg ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ khyed rang rnams bdag med mar gsal ba'i dpral bar 'khor lo la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ snying gar rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing ga rnams kyis mtshan pas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du gyur/ yang mas nas yar reg ste hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid mchod yul du bzung ba yin pas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/ de nas dngos grub kyi skal pa brtag pa la gnyis las/ dang po so shing dor ba ni/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing dngos grub kyi lhas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam la byin/ des kyang maṇ+ḍal gyi ra bar oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha zhes dor la slob dpon gyis lung ston gnyis pa rmi lam brtag pa'i sbyor ba la gsum las/ rmi lam gsal ba'i phyir khyor chu oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha swā hā/ zhes lan gsum blud la lhag ma (150)rgyab tu dor/ bar chad srung ba'i phyir hūm̐ las rdo rje'i srad bu bar chad bsrung ba'i nus ldan du gyur/ ye shes kyi srad bu dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs spyan drangs la bstim/ de skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas su nyis bskor gyis bcings/ las bum gyi chu gtor nas oṃ āḥbighā nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes rdo rje rgya gram du rgyas btab/ de nas dhī dang ha las byung ba'i ku sha rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam la/ dhīḥbazlas pa'i chung ba sngas kyi don du g.yas dang*/ ha bzlas pa'i che bstan gyi don du g.yon par gtad/ de nas mi ldog pa'i phyir chos bshad pa ni/ khyed cag gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa dang mjal ba 'di 'dra u dum bā ra'i me tog ltar rnyed dka' zhing rnyed pa don chen po dang dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyis bskal mang bsags pa'i sdig sgrib 'dag nus pa dang*/

der zhugs shing dbang thob nas lam la 'bad na tshe 'di kho na la bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par nges pas rnyed pa'i mchog rab tu rnyed par gyur te snyam du dga' ba bsgom par mdzad 'tshal/ de nas dngos gzhi rmi lam brtag pa ni/ do nub ku sha'i sngas stan la seng ge nyal stabs dang dge ba'i sems kyis nyol zhig /rmi lam gyi mtshan ma bzang ngan dag mthong bar 'gyur ro// des sta gon gyi chos grub/ dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur pa de nangs par 'byung ba yin no// zhes brjod la dge ba bsngos la rang gnas su btang*/ oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma hoḥzhes pas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs/ nang mchod la las thams cad pa'i sngags dang chus mtha' bcings la bzhag go /nangs par dris la rmi lam dge na zhen pa med par gzengs gtod/ ngan na sgyu ma lta bur shes pas bzlog par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la bzhi las/ dang po dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ thig skud dang rdul tshon kha dog lnga re bcu sdeb nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su lnga tshom du bkod pa'i mthar mchod pa bshams shing (151)brlab/ bdag nyid lhar gsal bas thig tshon bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥlas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i skur gyur/ ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkhas bstod/ rigs lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du gyur/ tshon la/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes kyang bzla/ de nas thig gdab pa ni/ slob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis shar du phyogs pas skud pa dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes slob ma 'od zer can la sogs rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i nga rgyal can la thig sna gtad de/ 'bru lnga zlos pas gcig tu sgril nas nam mkhar rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor lam gyis grub par mos la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis thig chen brgyad bskor 'dug gis phyogs ma nor ba'i sgo nas mkha' la gdab rjes thig skud kyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/

de nas phyogs thams cad mnyam nyid du shes par byas nas las thig gdab ste/ sgo bzhir rta babs bzhi ma phyir pad ra dur khrod rdo ra me phreng dang bcas pa'i rtsa thig gi nang du zlum bskor gyi myu khyud nang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ de'i nang pad 'dab bzhi ze'u 'bru lte ba dang bcas pa'i thig spyi ltar btab cing*/ be gās btags la nang du zhugs te hi zhes ltas la sgo phye/ de nas tshon dgye ba ni/ slob dpon dbus su phyin nas/ chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can khams rnams rnam par grol// rdo rje sems dpa'i gzhal yas khang*// dkyil 'khor snying po bri bar bya// zhes dbang ldan nas brtsams te rtsig pa phyi nas dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i re khā lnga sgo tshad tsam du bris te thod pas bkab/ de nas slob mas kyang bris te/ lte ba sngon po// ge sar ser/ pad+ma phyogs mdog /'khor lo'i rtsibs shar nas g.yas bskor gyis dkar/ sngo/ dmar/ dkar/ dkar po/ sngo ljang*/ (152)mu khyud sngon po/ de phan chad spyi dang mthun no// lha mtshan ni so so'i sku'am phyag mtshan dang*/ mi nus na lha mdog dang mthun pa'i thig le bri zhing tshon lha'i ye shes pa gshegs so// gnyis pa yo byad dgram pa ni/ lhag gnas byas pa'i bum pa spos kyis sna drangs te dkyil 'khor la g.yas su bskor te rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mañji la bkod/ las bum sgo'i phyi'i byang shar du bzhag /spyi mchod byang shar du/ mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog nas brtsams te chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga g.yas bskor du bshams/ 'grub na spos mar me lha bshos gsum lha grangs dang mnyam pas mtha' bskor/ 'das ma 'das kyi gtor ma dang*/ sman phud/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ rol mo'i khyad par/ spyan gzigs/ dbang rdzas sogs 'dir dgos pa thams cad tshang bar 'du bya'o// gsum pa sgrub mchod ni/ sngon gtor la las bum gyi chu 'thor zhing oṃ āḥbighān+na gyis bsang*/

swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod du āḥlas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi hūm̐ gis mkha' khyab tu 'phel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ snying ga'i 'od dang ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥs mgron bkug /a kā ro bdun nam gsum gyis bsngos la/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ sogs kyis dkar phyogs pa rnams dang*// gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba'i// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gang yin pa// gtor ma'i lhag ma 'di long la// da lta nyid du gzhan du dengs// zhes nag phyogs pa rnams drag sngags dang bcas pas bskrad la gtor ma phyir dor ro// rang nyid skad cig gis bdag med ma'i skur gyur pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las ra dang hūm̐ yig 'og tu chad/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de las 'phros pa'i rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla res bar mtshams med par gtams pa nyi ma las 'bar ba'i mes bzhu lugs su 'brel zhing 'bar ba me'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro bas cis kyang mi shigs par (153)gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum/ gnas yo bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi nang du chud pa'i gnas khang dag pa'i gzhal yas khang du oṃ las snod phun sum tshogs par āḥlas mchod pa'i yo byad rang bzhin bde stong*/ rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las zag med kyi bde bas tshim par/ hūm̐ gis mkha' khyab tu spel bas phyi nang kun tu gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ ne wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas bdag bskyed ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar sad par gyur/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/

shes rab snying rje dang bcas pas// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bgyis nas// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bgyi// lan gsum/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// btang snyoms mchog la gnas par shog /lan gsum/ skyabs yul rnams rang la thim par gyur/ rang gi spyi bor pad nyi zla ba las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhi zhing 'dzum pa g.yas rdo rje thugs ka dang g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig dkar po de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun g.yas pa'i mthe bong las babs pas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs te lus dag pa'i shel sgong ltar gyur par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya bzlas mthar rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ slar yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ (154)bdag med ma la bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor bla ma rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sad par gyur/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// tshe rabs kun gyi skyabs gyur cing*// mi 'dod pa kun rab spangs nas// 'dod pa'i don rnams ster mdzad pa'i// yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag byas ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ na mo// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// mchod pa bla na med pas mchod// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// bdag gis dge ba ci bsags pa// sems can kun la bsngo bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum/

de dag rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs so// de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ zhes mnyam par 'jog ste 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs so// stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi dbus su e las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ yaṃ las rlung dkyil sngon po zla gam/ raṃ las me dkyil dmar po gru gsum/ baṃ las chu dkyil dkar po zlum po/ laṃ las sa dkyil ser po gru bzhi/ suṃ las rin chen sna bzhi las grub pa'i ri rab rnams brtsegs mar gnas pa'i steng du/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa phyogs mdog lte ba mthing nag gru bzhi pa'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ 'dod snam dang*/ pha gu dang*/ drwa ba dang (155)drwa phyed shar bu dang mda' yab la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyi rol du dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba/ nang phyogs kyi mdog can du gyur pa'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa ge sar lte ba dang bcas/ lha gnas so sor gdan gyi rim pa gtso bo dang 'khor lo'i me srin dbang ldan rnams su pad nyi dang gzhan thams cad du pad zla'i gdan re re/ gtso bo'i gdan gyi steng du oṃ yig sngon po/ de las 'khor gyi sa bon spros nas so so'i gnas su 'khod pa ni/ pad 'dab bzhir shar nas rim par māṃ praṃ maṃ tāṃ/ rtsibs brgyad kyis phyogs bzhir a dhī hrīḥkaṃ /mtshams kyi rlung du hrīḥdang gzhan gsum du hūm̐ rnams lha rang rang gi kha dog tu gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros// 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/

slar 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las lha so so'i skur gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du aṃ las rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gri gug mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa'i gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga brten pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba'i myu bu cung zad gtsigs shing khro 'dzum bzhad pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'khyil ba/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang mgo bo skam po'i phreng ba sogs lha mo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ro'i gdan la ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// pad 'dab bzhi'i byang du tāṃ las sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis ut+pal sngon po'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang ba'i phyed skyil can/ shar du maṃ las 'od zer can dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ 'og ma gnyis rin po che'i snye ma dang phreng ba/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs (156)pa/ lhor praṃ las rang byung rgyal mo gser mdog phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis pu sti/ 'og ma gnyis pad phreng*/ zhabs skyil krung can/ nub tu baṃ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo// g.yas phag zhal gyen dang g.yon khro zhal thur du gzigs pa/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i phyed skyil gyi gar stabs kyis ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi shar du āḥlas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po sku mdog sngon po dkar po mnyam gzhag rdo rje'i skyil krung can// lhor dhīḥlas 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge dmar ser g.yas ral gri dang g.yon ut+pa la'i steng du shes rab kyi pusti bsnams pa/ sems skyil gyis seṅge sngon po'i khri la bzhugs pa/

nub tu hrīḥlas spyan ras gzigs dmar po phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar zhing 'og ma gnyis phreng ba dang pad dkar 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ byang du kaṃ las sgrib sel dmar po phyag g.yas pad+ma dang zhags pa/ g.yon phreng ba dang rin po che bsnams pa phyed skyil can/ mer hūm̐ las phyag na rdo rje mthing ga g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar bsgreng ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ srin por hūm̐ las gshin rje gshed nag po g.yas rdo rjes yu ba byas pa'i ral gri dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub ut+pa las mtshan pa/ dur khrod chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gis ma he'i steng dregs pa kha sbubs su brdzis pa/ rlung du hrīḥlas kha sār+pa ṇi dkar po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon shel phreng thugs kar bsnams pa/ g.yas cung zad brkyang ba'i phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ dbang ldan du hūm̐ las mi g.yo ba sngon po g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon zhags pa sdigs mdzub la lan gnyis dkris nas thugs kar gtod pa/ zhabs g.yon gyi pus mo dang g.yas kyi mthil gdan la bzhag (157)pa'i bzhengs stabs/ stag sham 'chang zhing dar dang rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ phag mo dang khro bo gsum ma gtogs pa 'khor thams cad dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis mdzes par spras pa'o// lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bdag med ma la bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ yab kyi thugs ka nas rigs kyi yum lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ nyes bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ lha so so'i thugs kar gtso bo dang khro bo bzhi la nyi ma dang gzhan brgyad po zla ba la gnas pa'i rang rang gi sa bon la bzla bya'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros rgyal ba rnams mchod cing thugs dam bskul/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'khor 'das kyi yon tan thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim pas snang grags 'gyu gsum lha sngags 'od gsal gyi 'khor lor dag par bsam la/ bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ swā hā/ zhes pa gtso mo'i sngags so// oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ sgrol ma'o// oṃ ma ri ts+yai māṃ swā hā/ 'od zer can no// oṃ praṃ ha ri ni hūm̐/ rang byung rgyal mo'o// oṃ badz+ra wā ra hī bai ro tsa nī hūm̐ phaṭa/ (158)phag mo'o// oṃ badz+ra sa twa thaliṃ sa raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sgrib sel lo// oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyag rdor ro// oṃ pra dz+nyā bā gī shwa ri muṃ/ 'jam dpal lo// oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ gshin rje gshed do// oṃ pad+ma tsin+tā ma ṇi dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ spyan ras gzigs so// oṃ hrīḥm ṇi kha sar+pa ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ spyan ras gzigs kha sar+pa ṇi'o// oṃ swā ra tsa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kun bzang gi'o// oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ mi g.yo ba'i sngags so// zhes gtso 'khor phyi 'gros rtsis nas ci nus bzla'o// de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i 'khor lor sbyangs/

de thams cad bdag nyid kyis bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ rten gzhal yas khang 'khor rnams la thim/ 'khor rnams gtso bo la thim nas bdag nyid bdag med ma'i skur gnas par gyur/ de nas bum sgrub ni/ las sngags kyis bsang*/ sa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhums pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel zhing mchu 'phyang ba lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam shing gis kha rgyan can/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi nang du pad 'dab bzhi'i lte bar oṃ las bdag med ma/ 'dab ma bzhir/ māṃ praṃ baṃ tāṃ las yum bzhi/ rtsibs brgyad la/ a hūm̐ dhī hūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥkaṃ hūm̐ rnams las yab brgyad de lha bcu gsum po bkra lam gyis gsal bar gyur/ las bum gyi nang du pad nyi la hūm̐ las khro bo bgegs mthar byed ljang nag rgya gram dang dril bu 'dzin pa khros pa'i nyams can no// lha tshogs de rnams thams cad kyi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med (159)par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dbang lha rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ yum lngas bum pa'i chus a bhi ṣe ka ta zhes sogs kyis dbang bskur/ thams cad rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga rol mor bcas pas mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul la/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings skye 'gags med pa'i mkha' klong las// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon lta bur ma 'dres gsal// rdo rje bdag med bde gshegs bcu gnyis bcas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing*// bgegs rnams ma lus nas/

bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod nas/ gzungs thag la 'jus te/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas bum pa'i lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sku'i cha thams cad nas byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam la/ rnam bum la lha bcu gsum gyi sngags rnams ci 'grub dang*/ a bhi ṣe ka'i sngags kyang nyer gcig tsam bzla/ las bum la/ oṃ āḥbigh+na nra ta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭa ces bzlas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul la/ lha thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu ste bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam mo// rang nyid bdag med ma'ang 'od du zhu ste oṃ la thim/ de'ang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim par gyur/ 'od gsal gyi ngang las slar yang bdag med ma'i skur gyur/ de nas mdun bskyed ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi dbus su e las chos 'byung gru gsum/ zhes pa nas/ gzhan thams cad du pad zla'i gdan re re/ zhes pa'i bar song rjes/ gtso bo'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid gnas par gyur/ bdag nyid oṃ yig sngon po zhes pa nas/ lha thams (160)cad rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin no// de nas mchod pa ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rang nyid bdag med ma'i rnam par logs su phye bas mchod bstod sogs las rim la 'jug par mos la/ mchod yon yan lag brgyad ldan sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul byas te// gang gā'i rgyun bzhin phyogs kun nas// rgyal ba sras bcas mchod par bgyi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ gzhan 'dra ba las rkang pa dang po'i rjes ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pā d+yaṃ sogs bcug ste/ zhabs kyi dril bsil gsang chab sogs/ pā d+yaṃ me tog pad+ma ut+pal sogs/

puṣ+pe/ bdug spos a kar tsan+dan sogs/ dhū pe/ snang gsal sgron ma nyi zla sogs/ ā lo ke /dri chab ga bur gla rtsi sogs/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas 'bras chan ka ra sogs/ ne wi d+ye/ sil snyan rnga dung glu dbyangs sogs/ shab+da ces dang*/ rin chen bdun dang rtags brgyad 'dod yon lnga// dga' bzhi nyams 'gyur bzhi bzhir rnam rol ba'i// yid 'ong rdo rje lha mo bcu drug sogs// mkha' khyab mchod sprin rgyal ba'i 'khor lor 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba ma hā pū dza me gha sa mu sogs te phyi mchod do// nang mchod bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pa la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang myos byed kyis gang ba rnams zhu zhing 'dres pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis gang ba la hūm̐ gis 'khor 'das kyi bdud rtsi thams cad spyan drangs te thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis brlabs la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma dang thugs dam bde gshegs bcu gnyis sogs yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs (161)rnams kyi zhal dus྾ nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ྾ mkha' 'gro sde bzhi zhing skyong kun tu ri ka /a pa rā dzi ta/ klu chen btang gzungs sogs srung ma thugs dam can rnams kyi zhal du྾ /rigs drug gi sems can dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa rnams kyi zhal du྾ zhes nang mchod phul/ snyoms 'jug gi bde ba'i ye shes la dgyes dgur rol par mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes pas gsang mchod/ 'dir ni thog ma dbus tha med// srid med mya ngan 'das pa med// bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste// 'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid// ces pa'i don la mnyam par 'jog pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// de nas bstod pa ni/

hūm̐/ gang gi 'khor ba'i nyes pa rnams// dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing*// bla med byang chub bskyed mdzad pa// bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud// rnam dag dri med dbyings las sku sprul zhing*// sgyu ma'i sku mchog mdzes pa'i cha lugs 'chang*// rab brjid gar gyis rnam par brgyan pa mo// 'gro ba'i yid 'phrog rnam dag sku la bstod// ma rgad mdangs 'dzin rab tu mdzes pa'i sku// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas ut+pal// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur 'jigs pa brgyad// sgrol mdzad sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// gangs ri'i mdog can yid 'phrog lha mo'i sku// mda' gzhu rin chen snye ma phreng ba bsnams// 'gro rnams dbang sdud blo yi mun pa sel// dbang gi lha mo 'od zer can la bstod// gser gyi mdog can bde ba'i gar gyis rol// bden gnyis zung 'jug zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// rin chen glegs bam pad+ma'i phreng ba bsnams// chos kun gdod nas spang blang bral ba'i don// zag med rang byung rgyal mor phyag (162)'tshal bstod// pad rā ga mdog can bde ba'i gar gyis rol// bden gnyis zung 'jug zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// gri gug thod 'chang rab 'jigs khro mo'i sku// rdo rje phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// zla ba'i mdog can rin chen rgyan gyis spras// rdo rje skyil krung mnyam bzhag g.yo ba med// mkha' ltar dri med sprod yul yongs su dag /rje btsun kun tu bzang la phyag 'tshal bstod// gur gum mdog can rin chen rgyan gyis spras// mi 'jigs seṅge'i stan la phyed skyil bzhugs// ral gri ut+pal shes rab pu sti bsnams// ma rig mun sel 'jam dpal dbyangs la bstod// zhal gcig phyag bzhi pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /gnas lugs thugs chud dang po thal mo sbyar// 'og ma gnyis kyis phreng ba pad dkar bsnams// thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs la bstod// byi ru'i mdog can pad+ma zhags pa g.yas// phreng ba rin chen g.yon pa'i phyag na bsnams// 'gro kun las kyi sgrib kun 'joms mdzad pa// byang sems sgrib pa rnam par sel la bstod// chos dbyings mi 'gyur nam mkha'i mdangs 'phrog cing*// phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas sdigs mdzub sgrengs// brkyang bskum stabs kyis bdud tshogs 'thag mdzad pa// gsang bdag rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// gdod nas rnam dag 'gyur med sku mdog nag

/rdo rje'i ral gri sdigs mdzub ut+pal mtshan// mngon spyod las kyis logs 'dren mthar mdzad pa// rab 'jigs gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal bstod// skyon gyis ma gos gangs ri ltar dkar sku// rin chen rgyan spras mchog sbyin phreng ba'i phyag /phyed krung gis rol 'gro rnams sangs rgyas sar// lung ston kha sar+pa ṇi'i sku la bstod// chos dbyings rang bzhin in+d+ra nī la'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs (163)zung brjid pa'i sku// ye shes ral gri rdo rje zhags pa bsnams// khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskul bas 'od zer mkha' khyab tu spros/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsgrubs/ rdo rje gsum gyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas rang dang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la thim par mos la/ gtso 'khor bcu gsum gyi sngags rnams ci nus bzlas mthar yig brgya lan gsum gyis brtan par bya'o// de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la'i snod du oṃ las sha lnga dang bza' bca' btung ba'i bye brag rnams zhu zhing 'dres pa'i gtor rdzas kyis gang ba la hūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste bstim pas gtor ma ye shes kyi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mang du brjod/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang bdag med ma la bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa sad par gyur/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar mos la/ oṃ gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan bdun nam gsum gyis dbul ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen sogs kyis bla ma dang*/

tshe rabs kun gyi skyabs gyur cing*// mi 'dod thams cad spangs nas ni// 'dod pa'i don rnams ster mdzad pa// yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// sogs kyis dkyil 'khor pa la bstod nas/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror bcas// khyed la mchod cing bstod pa yis// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces phrin las gzhol/ (164)mgon po a ghor sogs srung ma rnams kyi gtor chog dang*/ 'jig rten pa la cha gsum gyi cho gas gtor ma byin no// bzhi pa dbang bskur ba la gnyis las/ rang don bdag 'jug ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang rnams cho ga rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang ba'o// gzhan don slob ma la dbang bskur ba la/ sngon 'gro 'jug pa ni/ slob bu rnams las bum gyis khrus byas/ phyag byas te gral du 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs dang chos bshad ji ltar rigs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ 'dir rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas la bka' babs rnam bzhi'i gdams pa mnga' ba las/ 'di ni mchog gi bka' babs bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyi dbang bskur ba'i skabs lags/ de'ang sngon bdag med mas dam pa nyid rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bcug nas dbang bskur ba ltar 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma las dang po pa la dbang bskur ba'i sngon du de mtshon byed mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug dgos pa yin pas thog mar 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba la yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ chos su gzhug pa ni a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ lan gnyis kyis mig dar dgab cing me tog byin/ de nas rje btsun dam pa dang gnyis su med pa'i bla ma bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa la thal mo sbyar te gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes/ na mo dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// he ru ka dpal dgongs su gsol// byang chub sems las rmad byung ba'i// sdom pa rgya mtsho bdag la stsol// lan gsum/

gnang ba byin pa ni/ bu khyod tshur shog theg chen sngags// khyod ni tshul chen snod dang ldan// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas skyabs zhu na ci mdzad na bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pas 'di'i/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge (165)'dun la// thar pa 'dod phyir skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ sngon rgyal ba sras bcas kyis ji ltar thugs bskyed pa ltar bdag gis kyang gzhan don du 'bras bu la smon pa dang*/ de'i rgyu lam la 'jug pa dang*/ don dam par chos thams cad la dgag sgrub med par bzhag pas gang shar rang grol du thal ler snang ba de/ de ltar sems gsum bskyed snyam pa 'di'i/ sems can don kun bsgrub pa'i phyir// byang chub sems gsum bskyed par bgyi// lan gsum/ de nas sngags kyi dam tshig bzung ba la/ spyir rang don du mi dge ba thams cad spang snyam pas 'di'i/ sems can don phyir ma gtogs pa// bya ba rang don thams cad spang*// lan gsum/ khyad par bum dbang gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang gi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bzung snyam pas 'di'i/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig ni// bde gshegs rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*// bcu bzhir phye ba'i ltung ba dang*// yan lag gnyis pa spang bar bgyi// lan gsum/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes khrid de sgo bzhi nas tshad med pa bzhis dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes yol ba'i nang du bcug /khyams la gnas pas phyogs bzhi nas phyag byas pa'i mos pas 'di'i/ na mo sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas dam la bzhag pa ni// na mo chos 'di zab ste mthong bar dka'// kun dang thun mong ma yin pas// tshul brjod pas ni nyams pa skyed// nyams na bdud kyis bzung bar 'gyur// zhes gdams nas pro bor ba 'di'i/

sa ma ya na ra kan/ lan gsum/ de nas nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ni ye shes dbab pa'i slad du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab (166)pa 'di'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlabs shig /bde bar gshegs pa bcu gnyis bdag la dbab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas lus bsrang*/ rlung kha sbyor du bcings la/ khyed rang bcom ldan 'das phag mo dmar mo zhal gnyis ma gri thod 'dzin cing zhabs gar stabs ling ling bsgyur bar sgoms mdzod/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyi rnam par kha char dang bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byung*/ khyed rang la sib sab thim pas lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab cing 'bar bar gyur snyam du mos pa mdzod/ khyad par gyi spos bsreg cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dhā ā be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes bzlas pas dbab/ de brtan phyir rdo rje spyi bor rgya gram du bzhag la tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ rigs brtag phyir 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas me tog dor bar mdzod/ thar pa'i grong mchog gzhal yas 'dir// rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas// sngon nas las kyis 'brel ba'i lha// gang yin de dang 'phrad par shog /oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho// gang gis bzhes pa'i lhas/ me tog de rang gi spyi bor bcings pa'i mos pas/ oṃ pra tī gṛh+ṇa i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la/ zhes spyi bor bkod/ ma rig pa'i ling tog mig dar dang lhan du bsal bar mos la/ sngon gyi mig mkhan mkhas pa yis// 'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar// shes rab thabs dang thur ma yis// khyod kyi mi shes sgrib pa bsal// zhes mig dar bshu/ ye shes kyi mig thob pa la mthong ba bstan te/ he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma la bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur snyam pa dang*/

de'ang sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes ma 'gags pa'i rol rtsal lha'i dkyil 'khor du (167)shar ba'o snyam du nges par gyis shig /des 'jug pa'i chos rnams song*// dbang dngos gzhi la lnga las/ dang po dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su bla ma la bum dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// ji ltar che ba'i che sbyin ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don slad du// nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la stsol// lan gsum/ de'i lan du bla mas/ kye ho rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshogs// 'jig rten 'khrul pa'i lus spangs nas// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yi// dkyil 'khor chen por khyod rol lam// zhes spro ba dris pa la/ de ltar rol par spro lags/ zhes lan btab/ de nas thog mar gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lcags gser du 'gyur ba ltar cho ga'i thabs kyis lus lha'i skur smin par byed pa bum dbang yin pas/ lha so so'i dbang bskur ba'i tshe dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon nas khyed rang gi spyi bo nas sib sab thim pas/ tha mal gyi lus 'di ma spangs par lha de dang de'i skur lam lam du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ lha tsaka rnams kyis dbang rim par bskur la/ skye med dbyings las 'gags med sku// sgyu ma lta bur yongs shar ba// bdag med lha mo'i dbang bskur bas// rang lus lha skur smin par shog /oṃ āḥ.aṃ swā hā a bhi ṣiñca mi/ rkang pa dang po gnyis 'dra ba las/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i dbang bskur bas// phrin las thogs med grub par shog /oṃ tu re tut+tā re tu re swā hā a bhi ṣiñca mi/ 'od zer can mas dbang bskur bas// 'gro kun dbang du 'dus par shog /oṃ mā ri ts+yai maṃ swā hā a bhi ṣiñca mi/ rang byung rgyal mo'i dbang bskur bas// 'dod yon lam du longs par shog /oṃ praṃ ha ri ni sa hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca mi/

rdo rje phag mo'i dbang bskur bas// zag med bde ba (168)rgyas par shog /oṃ badz+ra wā ra hī bai ro tsa nī hūm̐ phaṭa a bhi/ kun tu bzang po'i dbang bskur bas// gnyug ma'i sems nyid rtogs par shog /sa rā dza ya hūm̐ phaṭa a bhi/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi dbang bskur bas// shes rab thogs pa med par shog /oṃ pra dz+nyā wā gī shwa ri muṃ a// spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang bskur bas// tshad med thugs rje skye bar shog /oṃ pad+ma tsin+tā ma ṇi dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa a bhi/ sgrib pa rnam sel dbang bskur bas// rang rgyud sgrib pa dag par shog /oṃ badz+ra sa twa thaliṃ sa raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa a bhi྾ /phyag na rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas// gdug pa 'dul ba'i mthu thob shog /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa mā hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa a bhi྾ /gshin rje gshed kyi dbang bskur bas/ khams gsum sgrol ba'i mthu thob shog /oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa a bhi/ kha sar+pa ṇi'i dbang bskur bas// sangs rgyas zhing du lung ston shog /oṃ hrīḥm ṇ-i kha sar+pa ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa a bhi྾/ mi g.yo mgon po'i dbang bskur bas// rig pa ye shes sgo phyed shog /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa a bhi ṣiñca mi/ zhes dbang bskur bas rang lus kyis mtshon pa'i chos thams cad snang stong lha'i skur smin pa de nyid brtan byad bum pa'i dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang lha rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs te bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du mas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ rnam par dag pa'i bum pa 'dis// bde gshegs sku yi dbang bskur bas// lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur nas// bum pa'i dbang mchog thob par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā a bhi ṣiñca mi/ spyi bor bzhag cing bum chu blud// zhes bum pa'i dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan (169)par gyur/

des gtso bor lus kyi dri ma dag cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku rdo rje snang stong gnyis su med pa thob par byed/ de thob pa'i thabs lha'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi lhor gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i/ kun mkhyen mgon po thugs rje can// yon tan rgya mtsho'i bka' drin gyis// deng nub bka' drin chen po gsol// lan gsum/ de'i lan du bla mas kye ho khyod ni ji lta bu// sems can 'khrul pa'i ngag spangs nas// rtsa rlung bde chen byang sems kyi// dkyil 'khor chen por khyod rol lam// zhes pa'i lan du/ de ltar rol bar spro lags// zhes btab/ ji ltar dug 'gyur gyi sman gyi dug sman du 'gyur ba ltar cho ga'i thabs kyis ngag sngags su smin par byed pa gsang dbang yin pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi mgrin pa nas sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams thon pa khyed rang gi mgrin pa'i gnas su thim pas/ tha mal gyi ngag 'di ma spangs par lha de dang de'i gsang sngags kyi sgra gdangs su lhang lhang du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags byang mgrin par bzhag nas slob dpon gyis so so'i sngags mthar a bhi ṣiñca maṃ zhes btags nas brjod/ zhes dbang bskur bas rang gi ngag gis mtshon pa'i 'khor 'das kyi sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med kyi rang sgrar smin pa de nyid brtan byed bdud rtsi'i thig les gsang dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ oṃ zhes sangs rgyas nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa slob dpon bdag med mar gsal ba'i zhal du bcug /āḥzhes sku'i dbyibs brgyud de byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba/ hūm̐ zhes mkha' gsang nas spros pa thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres par mos la/ rlung 'jug gnas ldang gsum dang sbyar ba'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bzlas pa lan gsum (170)gyis bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs nas/

āḥdri med bdud rtsi'i thig le 'dis// bde gshegs gsung gi dbang bskur bas// ngag gi sgrib pa dag gyur nas// gsang ba'i dbang mchog thob par shog /bdud rtsi srin lag gis blangs nas// a bhi ṣiñca oṃ zhes dpral bar thig le bzhag pas/ bde chen 'khor lo'i gnas su oṃ yig dkar po/ a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes mgrin par bzhag pas/ longs spyod 'khor lo'i gnas su āḥyig dmar po/ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ zhes snying gar bzhag pas/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i gnas su hūm̐ yig sngon po/ a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ zhes lte bar bzhag pas sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su hrīḥser po rnams lam gyis grub par gyur/ de ni gtum mo 'bar bas rtsa mdud grol nas ro rkyang gi rlung dbu mar 'gags pa 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas su 'ching nus pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa ste/ sems gsal stong brjod bral phyi ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam mo// des gtso bo rang gi dri ma dag cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rdo rje gsal stong gnyis su med pa thob par byed/ de thob pa'i thabs rdzogs rim rlung sgom pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// gsum pa dal gyi nub tu sher dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal ba'i bdag /do nub bka' drin chen po 'di// bde ba de nyid brtan du gsol// lan gsum/ de'i lan du bla mas/ kye ho skal ldan thugs rje can// 'khrul pa'i zag rgyu gtan spangs nas// zag med bde chen byang sems kyi// dkyil 'khor chen po cang rol lam// zhes pa'i lan du/ de ltar rol bar spro lags/ zhes btab/ ji ltar nor bu chu dwangs de chu rnyogs ma can gyi nang du bcug pas/ rnyogs ma rang dwangs la 'gro ba ltar cho ga'i thabs kyis yid bde stong gi ye shes smin par byed pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang yin pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha (171)rnams kyi thugs ye shes mtshon byed phyag mtshan rnams khyed rang la gtad pas tha mal gyi yid ma spangs par thugs rnam par grol ba'i ye shes su lhag lhag 'char ba'i mos pa mdzod/

phyag mtshan rnams so so'i sngags la a bhi ṣiñca maṃ zhes btags pas lag tu gtad do// de ltar dbang bskur bas 'khor 'das kyi rtog tshogs thams cad rig stong spros bral bde ba chen por smin par byas/ de nyid brtan byed bdud rtsi blud pas sher dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ slob dpon skad cig gis he ru kar gnas bsgyur nas bdag med ma dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'dres pa'i dwangs ma bdud rtsi dang gnyis med du gyur par mos la/ hūm̐ byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi 'dis// bde gshegs thugs kyi dbang bskur bas// yid kyi sgrib pa dag gyur nas// gsum pa'i dbang mchog thob par shog /'di rtsa khams kyi bde gshegs dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa'i rdzas yin pas 'thung zhig oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bdud rtsi hub gsum blud pas/ rtsa rlung thig le gsum byin gyis rlabs pa'i rkyen gyis lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar bas spyi bo'i haṃ zhu ba'i dga' bzhi'i ye shes bde ba chen pos rgyud yongs su gang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ des gtso bor yid kyi dri ma dag cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rdo rje bde stong gnyis su med pa thob par byed/ de thob pa'i thabs rdzogs rim pho nya'i lam zhu bde sgom pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// bzhi pa dkyil 'khor gyi byang du tshig dbang rin po che zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gtso// rnam pa kun tu mchog gyur pa// rang gi de nyid bstan du gsol// lan gsum/ de'i lan gu rus/ kye ho rig pa'i skyes bu rnams// mtshan ma'i rtog pa rab spangs nas// spros med bde chen byang sems kyi// dkyil 'khor chen po khyod rol lam// zhes (172)dris pa'i lan du/ de ltar rol bar spro lags/ zhes btab/ ji ltar bar snang gi sprin nam mkha'i klong du dwangs pa ltar thabs zab mo'i gnad kyis phra ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi chags rtog thams cad dbyings su grol bas rgyud yongs su dag pa rdo rje bzhi yi bdag nyid sku dang ye shes zung 'jug bsam mi khyab kyi lhan skyes de kho na nyid spros bral bde stong du rang shar ba ni dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes te/

de ltar nyams su myong bar mos la cung zad mnyam par gzhog mdzod/ mchog gi brda dang bde gshegs kyi sgrub thabs glegs bam spyi bor 'jog cing*/ hrīḥlus 'di dag pa rgyal ba'i sku// ngag ni grags stong sngags kyi sgra// yid ni bde stong spros dang bral// bzhi pa'i dbang mchog thob par shog /oṃ ma hā mu dra a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ des gnyen po'i dri ma dag cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje dbyer med pa'i bde chen thob par byed/ de thob pa'i thabs kyis bsam mi khyab pa'i rim pas phyag rgya chen po sgom pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// lnga pa bzlas lung byin pa ni/ dpon slob gnyis kas bzlas lung gang byed kyi lha gang yin de'i sku'i rnam pa gsal btab pa'i thugs kar gtso mo dang khro bo bzhi la nyi ma dang gzhan brgyad por zla ba'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las sngags phreng byung ba zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi mthar par btab pa ltar 'khor bar mos la 'di'i rjes/ bdag med ma dang bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyi sngags rnams gsum re brjod/ de nas slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// ces lan gsum/ me tog de nyid slar yang khyed rang gi spyi bor gtor bas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa (173)mdzod/ ces slob dpon gyis me tog de bzung la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// ces lan gsum brjod cing rten 'brel snying po bzlas nas spyi bor gtor te/ bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyi gsung rig sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa rdo rje slob ma 'di'i rgyud la yongs su 'jug par gyur cig

/ces brjod/ slob mas kyang bzlas lung thob pas phrin las thogs pa med pa dang*/ 'gro kun dbang du 'du ba sogs sngar lha dbang du bshad pa ltar gyi so so'i yon tan rnams thob par gyur to snyam pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin du bcug /de nas slob ma rnams bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyi ngo bor gyur pa la mchod pas mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces phul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas ni wi d+ye'i bar nyer spyod lngas mchod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyis dam tshig khas blangs bka' drin gtong rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs kyis lus 'bul/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams bya'o// tshogs mchod bya bar spro na/ bdag 'jug gi snga phyi gnyis gang rigs su bya ba shas che na'ang*/ dbang chog rtsa bar skabs 'dir bshad pa ltar de gsum gang du byas kyang rung ngo*// cho ga ni// byin rlabs sngar bshad kyi gtor ma ltar las gtor rdzas dang gtor ma zhes pa tshogs rdzas dang tshogs kyi longs spyod ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zhes bsgyur ba las gzhan 'dra/ mgron drang ba nas lhag gtor gyi bar lam lnga'i dbang chog tu bshad pa ltar te/ khyad par bdag 'jug gi snga phyi gang rigs su byed pa ltar na rol pa man chad skabs 'dir bya ba lag len la bde'o// de nas rjes chog ni/ mchod pa kha gsos te byin rlabs bya/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ bum bskyed ltar chos dbyings skye 'gag med pa'i sogs sh+tso ka gcig pos bstod/ yig brgya (174)bzla zhing ma rnyed yongs su sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rdul tshon gyi nub tha ma la yin na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyis gshegs gsol dang*/ a kā ros dbyib chu bor skyel ba rnams bya/ nyin dang po rnams dang ras bris la rnam pa kun tu 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa 'od gsal du bsdu zhing langs la bsngo shis kyis mtha' brgyan no// dar rgyas 'phel/// /oṃ swa sti/

na maḥshrī he ru kā ya/ bde mchog thun mong ba'i dbang lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor du bskur ba'i rim pa ni/ sta gon dang rdul tshon gyi bya ba sogs spro na bde gshegs bcu gnyis ltar las sgos chos rnams bsgyur te byas pas chog mod/ 'on kyang yig rnying las ma bshad cing ras bris la brten pa'i phyogs la ma grub kyang 'gal ba med/ de la thog mar bshams bkod ni/ stegs bu'i steng du dur khrod me'i phyi rol du byas pa'i dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi rta babs snam bzhi ma spyi ltar las/ rtsa thig gi nang du zlum por bskor ba'i dbus su 'dab brgyad lte bar chos 'byung sngo dmar brtsegs ma/ lha mtshan lte bar rdo rje/ 'dab ma'i phyogs bzhi dang gru bzhir sgo bzhi rnams su gri thod/ 'dab ma'i mtshams bzhir bum pa thod pas kha brgyan pa rnams rdul tshon gyis bris pa'am/ yang na ras bris dkram/ de'i dbus su mañji'i steng du rnam rgyal bum pa bcud ldan chas su bcug pa bkod pa'i khar gsang rdzas kyis gang ba'i thod pa dar dmar dang me long la sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor chos 'byung bsnol ma baṃ yig dga' 'khyil dang bcas bris pas kha bcad/ las bum byang shar ram slob dpon gyi mdun du bshams/ mchod gtor tshogs kyi yo byad sogs ci 'byor bas bskor/ ḍā dril lag mchod sogs yo byed thams cad tshang bar 'du byas nas/ sgrub (175)mchod ni/ sngon gtor sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥs byin gyis brlabs/ 'bar ba'i rgya bcas la pheṃ badz+ra ā ra l+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥs mgron bkug oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ ub+dā dā/ a pa smā rā/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gṛh+ṇān+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣān+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ye the baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭhaṃ/ bhuñja thā/ pi wa thā/ dzī gh+ra thā/

ma ti kra ma thā/ ma ma sarba kartā ya/ sad su khaṃ/ bi shud+dha ye sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma dang*/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs= /yi dwangs tshogs= /sha za'i tshogs= /smyo byed tshogs= /brjed byed= /mkha' 'gro'i= /ma mo'i tshogs= /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las bcol/ nag phyogs pa rnams la/ gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gang yin pas// gtor ma'i lhag ma 'di longs la// da lta nyid du gzhan du dengs// ces drag sngags dang bcas pas bskrad la gtor ma phyir dor ro// oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis mtshams bcad/ de nas gnas yo byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las gzhal med khang du āḥlas snod ka pā lar (176)bcud hūm̐ las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad 'dod yon gyi rnam 'phrul du mar 'char ba/ rang bzhin bde stong rnam pa mchod rdzas byed las zag med kyi bde bas tshim par byed pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā brta ya ā brta ya oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas bdag bskyed ni/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od kyis skyabs yul rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar sa dbang bsam la/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// khro bo mkha' 'gror bcas pa la// bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/

kye ma sems can sdug bsngal zhing*// kun rtog la ni mngon par zhen// de yi rtog pa gzhom phyir bdag /he ru ka dpal bsgom par bya// lan gsum/ skyabs yul rnams ngang la thim par gyur/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng du rdor sems he ru ka dkar po rdor dril 'dzin pas snyem ma gri thod can la 'khril ba rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ yab kyi thugs zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te hūm̐ la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs sdig sgrib thams cad sbyang bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka te no pa/ zhes pa nas/ badz+ra he ru ka ma me muñca he ru ko3 bha ba/ zhes bsgyur ba'i yig brgya bzlas mthar/ mgon po bdag ni zhes sogs/ rdor sems 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ rang nyid skad cig gis bde mchog lhan skyes kyi skur gsal ba'i snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dpal he ru ka lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang (177)bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sad par bsam la/ 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab nang gnas pa// thugs rje'i phyag gis drang nas ni// ye shes bdud rtsis tshims mdzad pa// bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud// dpal ldan bde mchog 'khor lo ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag 'tshal/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ bdag gis thog ma med pa'i dus mtha' nas// byas dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i// sdig pa ma lus skyon kun 'jig mdzad pa'i// spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slad mar yang*// mi bgyid sdom pa brtan por bzung bar bgyi// nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang*// rgyal ba'i sras pos sgrub pa'i dge ba sogs// de dag kun la rjes su yi rang ngo*// byang chub tu ni bdag gis dge ba bsngo// rgyal ba dkon mchog gsum po la sogs la// dngos sam yid kyis bdag ni skyabs su mchi// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de bzhin du// bla na med pa'i lam la bsten par bgyi// zhes lan gsum dang*/

tshad med bzhi spyi ltar lan gsum bya ste bsod nams kyi tshogs so// de nas oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ oṃ shū n+ya ta'i sngags kyis gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ zhes mnyam par 'jog ste ye shes kyi tshogs so// stong pa'i ngang las rang gi bar do'i rnam shes kyi ngo bo nā da dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can rtsa sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ de'i 'od zer las byung ba'i yi ge rim par 'chad pa las/ yaṃ las rlung dkyil sngon po zla gam/ raṃ las me dkyil dmar po gru gsum/ baṃ las chu dkyil dkar po zlum po/ laṃ las sa dkyil (178)ser po gru bzhi/ suṃ las rin chen sna bzhi las grub pa'i ri rab rnams brtsegs mar gnas pa'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje rwa phyogs mdog lte ba sngon po la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bi d+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces phyogs g.yon dang mtshams g.yas bskor te lan gnyis brjod cing g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur bstan nas se gol brdabs pas/ hūm̐ las khro bo gnod mdzes 'phros pas bgegs thams cad bskrad cing brlag par byas/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje dpag med spros pa las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+rī bha ba bhan+dha hūm̐/ phyogs mtshams su 'phros pas logs thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ steng du 'phros pas rdo rje'i gur dang drwa ba/ oṃ badz+ra sañja ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i bla re/ oṃ badz+ra be ta na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ de'i phyi rol tu mde'u bsnol ba phyir bstan gyi mda'i drwa ba/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dza la traṃ saṃ traṃ/

de thams cad kyi phyi rol tu ye shes kyi me 'bar bas bcings par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la rka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod do// spro na gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba gru bzhi ba'i steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa nang nas nag ljang dmar ser dkar ba'i rtsigs pa rim pa lnga pa/ sgo bzhir rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ 'dod snam dang*/ pha gu dang*/ dra ba drwa phyed/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyi rol tu dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba/ nang phyogs kyi mdog can gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ge sar gyi ze'u 'bru'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa/ pad 'dab kyi phyogs kyi phyogs bzhi dang*/ (179)grwa bzhi dang sgor bzhi nyi ma dang ro/ pad+ma'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir zla ba'i gdan re re gsal bar gyur/ dbus kyi gdan steng mtshan bzang gi ngo bo/ a a/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ phrag gnyis g.yon bskor du gnas pa zhu ba las zla ba'i dal me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du g.yas skor gyis dpe byad kyi ngo bo// ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la ḍa ḍha ṇa/ phrag gnyis las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam nyid ye shes/ nyi zla'i bar du bar do'i nā da zhugs pa hūm̐ dang baṃ las rdo rje dang gri gug hūm̐ dang baṃ gyis mtshan pa so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas// tshur 'dus thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa bya grub ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bor bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag khro chags kyi nyams can/

zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa zhal sngo nag /g.yas ser/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab zhal ser po/ zhal thams cad rnam par 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer dang spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra s+t+wa/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bzhi pa na thod khrag /lnga pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan dmar mo'i nu ma dang lte ba g.yon bskum pas 'jig byed nag po kha sbub kyi sog dbrag tu mgo bo bltab pa'i gdong mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu ngos (180)la sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon ngos su zla phyed/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus pa'i phyag rgya drug /dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs/ stag sham grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgus sgeg pa/ de'i pang na yum phag mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing stobs pa/ dbu skra grol zhing thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo// byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo// lhor gzugs can ma ser mo// mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du byang sems kyis gang ba'i thod pa gnas pa/ shar sgo khwa gdong ma sngo skya/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang skya/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar skya/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser skya/ grwa bzhi'i shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas dkar g.yon ser/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar/

nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang*/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon dkar te phyed gzugs/ bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ skra grol zhing thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag /'og ma gnyis cang te'u dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis ro gdan la bzhugs pa'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sku rdo rje/ mgrin par āḥdamar po gsung rdo rje/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po thugs rdo rje/ gtso bo'i snying gar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'tshogs mar na ma hi rnam snang*/ spyi gtsug (181)tu swā hā hūm̐ dmar po pad+ma gar dbang*/ phrag pa gnyis su bo ṣaṭa he nag po he ru ka /mig gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa ha ljang gu rta mchog gi ngo bo// phag mo dang lha mo gnyis kyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje/ snying gar haṃ yaṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hrīṃ maṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ mgo bor hrīṃ hrīṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bor gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par pheṃ zhes 'bar ba'i rgyas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros dbang gi lha thams cad pheṃ zhes spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/

gtso mo la rnam snang*/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi la rin 'byung*/ sgo ma bzhi la snang mtha'/ mtshams ma bzhi la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros gzugs sogs 'dod yon gyi snang ba thams cad bsdus/ yab kyi zhal du bcug /snying gar zhu ba/ yum gyi pad+mar babs/ sbyor mtshams nas gzugs rdo rje ma sogs mchod pa'i lha mo'i rnam par spros pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mchod nas gtso bo yab yum la thim pas/ yab yum gnyis kha sbyor nang gi 'dod yon gyi bde ba chen po'i dgyes pas 'od du zhu nas/ thig le'i rang bzhin 'od kyi phung po dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can du gyur pa la/ 'khor rnams kyis/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs (182)su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs ni mchog mnyes te// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba brgyan mdzad de// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i sprul pas don kun sgrub mdzad pa// mgon po dpal ldan bde mchog dgyes par bzhengs// zhes bskul bas/ thig le de nyid hūm̐ dang bam̐ las rdo rje dang gri gug hūm̐ dang bam̐ gyis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog /ces pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar gyis rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yum bcas ji lta ba bzhin du 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs par bsam mo// de nas rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni/ rtag tu snying la gnas pa yi// thig le gcig las 'gyur ba med// de sgom byed pa'i skye bo la// nges par ye shes skye bar 'gyur// zhes pa'i don rang gi snying gar zla dkyil sran ma tsam gyi steng byang chub sems kyi thig le yungs 'bru tsam pa kha dog dkar po/ ngo bo bde stong*/ gsal la dwangs pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar bsgoms nas/

de la sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog go /des skyon bzlas pa la 'jug ste/ shub bu dang brjod pa dang 'gog pa dang spro bsdu dang do li dang khro bo'i bzlas pa rnams gang 'grub bya zhes 'byung bas/ 'dir spro bsdu'i dbang du byas na thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i 'khor lo sbyangs/ slar 'dus nas rang la thim par mos la/ dung chen gyi phreng ba g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis 'dren zhing*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dz+wa la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ yab kyi snying po'o// oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye snying ngo*// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi snying po'o// oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki ni ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye snying ngo*// 'khor (183)sngags ni/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kā kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ u lu kā s+yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shwa na s+yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sū kā ra s+yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dā dhi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dū ti ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṣ+ṭi ṇā ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas so// de nas rang gi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur stan gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka dpal 'khor lor bstod// ces bstod do// de nas bum sgrub ni/ sum+bha nis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i phyir gru bzhi pa'i gzhal yas khang gi lte bar hūm̐ bam̐ las bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/

zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pas dus mtshan dang 'jigs byed mnan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ mtshams kyi 'dab mar bum thod/ sgo dang gru bzhi la sgo mtshams ma brgyad de/ gtso 'khor thams cad rgyan dang cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ las bum gyi nang du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa rnams skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ(184)snying gar hūm̐/ yab kyi snying gar ham̐ yaṃ/ khar hrīḥmaṃ/ mgo bor hrīṃḥhrīṃḥ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa phaṭa/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo pheṃ/ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ 'od kyis dbang lha thams cad pheṃ/ oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas so so'i rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mor bcas pas mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan bde mchog 'khor lo ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// rang gi snying ga nas sngags phreng dmar po gzungs thag la 'dril te song bas lha thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sku las byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ gzungs thag la 'jus te// rnam bum lha gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dang 'khor gyi lha mo rnams kyi sngags bdun las mi nyung ba dang*/ a bhi ṣe ka nyer gcig tsam re bzlas/ las bum la sum+bha mang du bzlas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul bas/

lha rnams rjes chags chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur/ de nas mdun bskyed ni/ rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng*/ (185)rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba drwa ba gur bla re/ mda'i drwa ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa nang nas nag ljang dmar ser dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga pa zhes pa nas zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis ro gdan la bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar rten dang brten pa thams cad bdag bskyed ltar skad cig gis gsal btab/ de nas bdag mdun bsre ba ni/ bdag gis sgom pa'i 'byung bzhi ri rab srung 'khor gzhal yas khang lha'i gdan phyi rol dur khrod dang bcas pa'i rten dang brten pa lha bcu gsum thod pa bzhi dang bcas pa thams cad gcig tu 'dres te gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ sum+bha lan gsum bzla/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sku rdo rje zhes pa nas/ mtshams ma bzhi la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes pa'i bdag bskyed ltar bya'o// de nas mchod pa la spyi dang khyad par ba gnyis kyi/ dang po spyi la lnga las/ phyi mchod ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la// rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mor bcas// mchod rdzas ji snyed yod pa rnams// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍal ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ a lo ke /gan+dhe/ ne wi d+ye/ shab+da zhes bcug pas mchod/ nang mchod ni/

bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me rlung gi dbus su ka pā la (186)yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bdud rtsi lnga bkod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bzlas pas zhu zhing 'dres/ oṃ las 'od 'phros pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug nas thim par gyur pa las/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs nas// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum/ bde chen gyi lha mo bzhi/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad sogs yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du= nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal= mkha' 'gro zhing skyong phyogs skyong gnas yul gyi bdag po srid gsum 'byung po'i tshogs dang*/ rigs drug gi sems can dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i ngo bor dag pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ngag tu myong bas lus kyi lha thams cad kyang dgyes par gyur/ gsang mchod ni/ 'dir ni thog ma dbus mtha' med// srid med mya ngan 'das pa med// bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste// 'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid// ces pa'i don bsgom/ bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo chen po ni// bskal pa'i me chen lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs shin tu 'jigs pa'i zhal// sku la spyan stong gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra s+t+wa zhags pa kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung bsnams shing*// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa gos su gyon// sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo ni// 'jig rten gsum gyis rgol bas mi tshugs shing*// 'byung po ma lus gri gug chen pos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs dbang thod pa 'dzin// khro mo'i gzugs can shin tu drag snyems ma// rmugs byed rengs byed rmongs pas rab brgyal zhing*// bdud (187)kyi 'jigs pa snyams zhing zhi bar mdzad// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// mdzes pa'i zhal mdog rigs bzhi'i khro mor sprul// mtshams kyi 'dab bzhir dngos grub bum pas mtshan// mi 'gyur bde mchog ster bar mdzad pa yi// ye shes mkha' 'gro bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// de yi phyi rol phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi ru// khwa ta 'ug pa khyi dang phag pa'i gdong*// gshin rje brtan ma pho nya mche ba ma// 'joms ma mkha' 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis pa khyad par gyi mchod pa la bzhi las/

bzlas pa'i mchod pa ni/ rang gtso bo las he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rnam par dbye ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskul bas 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ rdo rje gsum gyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas rang dang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la thim par mos la gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ 'khor lha mo bcu gnyis po la bdun gyis nyung mtha' byas pa dang*/ dbyangs gsal dang he ru ka'i yig brgya'ang cung zad bzlas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la me tog dor/ bya ba'i mchod pa ni/ spro zhing nus na rjes chags dang cho ga'i gar dang*/ rdo rje'i glu dang rol mo sogs kyis kyang mchod pa'o// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa ni// tshogs rdzas rnams byin rlabs bde gshegs bcu gnyis ltar dang*/ mgron drangs mchod rol pa lhag gtor rnams lam lnga'i dbang chog tu bshad pa bzhin las/ rol ba man chad dbang gi mthar mdzad pa phyag len no// gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ bsang sbyangs/ (188)stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la'i nang du 'bru gsum zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha bcu gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang sems mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyang he ru ka'i rnam par sad pa pheṃ zhes spyan drangs/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a rā l+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya ho/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum gyis lha la 'bul/ de nas gtor chog ltar mgon po lcam dral sogs srung ma rnams la phul/
