de nas oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sogs sngon gtor lan gsum gyis dur khrod na gnas pa dang 'byung po'i tshogs la 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan bde mchog 'khor lo ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod// bcom ldan bde mchog 'khor dang bcas// khyed rnams mchod cing bstod pa yis// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las gzhol/ de nas dbang bskur ba la gnyis las// slob dpon bdag 'jug ni/ rang nyid slob ma 'jug pa ltar dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las dbang rnams cho ga rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas rdzogs par blang ngo*// de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ slob bu rnams las bum gyis khrus byas/ phyag byas te gral du 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs dang chos bshad ji ltar rigs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ 'dir bde mchog thun mong pa mai tri pas rje (189)btsun mi pham mgon po la gnang ba lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bskur ba la bsnyen sgrub las gsum du gsungs pa las/ dang po bsnyen pa bzhis sta gon bya ba ste/ de la bla ma nye bar bsnyen pa'i phyir/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas gsol ba gdab dgos pa 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas bdag cag bla ma'i zhabs spyi bor len na bde chen thar pa'i grong du gzhug tu gsol snyam pas 'di'i/ kyai ho bdag cag skal bar ldan// khyod zhabs pad+mo spyi bor len// tshe 'di nyid la bde blag tu// thar pa'i grong mchog bstan du gsol// lan gsum/ slob ma nye bar bsnyen pa ni/ kho bos bar chad dri ba yin pas lan drang por thob cig

/bsod nams kyi bar chad spong ba yo byad gtong ba'i blo dang ldan nam/ bus ldan lags/ rten gyi bar chad spong ba dbang po yan lag tshang ngam/ tshang lags/ snod kyi bar chad spong ba rgyud sdom pa gsum dang ldan par byed dam/ byed lags/ zhes khas len du gzhug go /dngos grub blang ba'i rdzas rig ma nye bar bsten pa ni/ mtshan ldan gyi gzungs ma de rab chos bshad cing dbang bskur/ 'bring thabs mkhas/ tha ma rin gyis bslus la dbang bya ba ste/ da lta'i dus su dngos rig la brten nas dbang bskur ba phyag len la mi mdzad pas 'dir btang snyoms su byas/ yi dam gyi lha nye bar bsnyen pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod kyi mchod pas mnyes par byed pa ste/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel bar sngon du grub/ gnyis pa chas 'jug rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas sgrub pa nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de la slob ma chas su gzhug pa ni/ rgyud sdom pa gsum ldan du sgrub pa ste/ skyabs su 'gro bas so thar/ kun rdzob smon 'jug dang don dam byang sems bzung bas byang sdom/ rig 'dzin (190)sngags kyi sdom pa la spyir rtsa ltung bcu bzhi/ yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad/ bye brag bde gshegs rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang sdom pa ste/ de thams cad tshul bzhin du bzung snyam pas 'di'i/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// thar ba 'dod phyir skyabs su mchi// ngan 'gro'i srid pa dgag pa'i phyir// bya ba dman pa thams cad spang*// sems can don kun sgrub pa'i phyir// byang chub sems gsum bskyed par bgyi// bcu bzhir phye ba'i rtsa ba dang*// sdom pa thams cad bdag gis bzung*// zhes lan gsum/ de nas hūm̐ dzaḥzhes las rdor gyis dkyil 'khor gyi nang du khrid de shar phyogs su he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas 'khod par gyur/ de nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ na mo chos 'di zab ste mthong bar dka'// kun dang thun mong ma yin pas// tshul brjod pas ni nyams par byed// nyams na bdud kyis bzung bar 'gyur// zhes gdams nas bro bor ba 'di'i/

sa ma ya na ra kan/ ces lan gsum/ yi dam gyi lha chas su gzhug pa ni// dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams sgrub cing mchod pa ste kho bos sngon du chad lhag med par grub pa lags/ gsum pa las la sbyar ba ni/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ste/ de la dbang rim pa bzhi las/ dang po bum dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas gsol ba 'debs 'di'i/ na mo byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// ji ltar che ba'i che sbyin ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don slad du// nam mkha'i rdo rjes bdag la stsol// lan gsum/ bum dbang gi dam tshig bzung ba yin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo bcu bzhir phye ba'i dam tshig dang*// yan lag nyes pa spang bar bgyi// sems can 'dul don ma gtogs pa'i// bya ba dman pa thams cad spong*// zhes lan gsum/ de la bum pa'i dbang bdun po 'dir brtan byed bum pa dngos (191)kyi dbang du bsdus nas bskur bar bya ba yin pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang lha rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs te ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan du mas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ byang chub sems chus rab bkang ba'i// rnam par dag pa'i bum pa 'dis// skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas// sku yi rdo rje 'grub par shog /a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca āḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ a bhi ṣiñca swā/ a bhi ṣiñca hā/ na mo gu ru hūm̐/ zhes bum pa mgo bo'i gnas lnga dang snying gar gtug cing*/ bum chu blud/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang nyon mongs pa'i dri ma dag /bde ba chen po myong*/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ nam mkha'i dbang lha thams cad kyis bkra shis kyi me tog 'thor bzhin du/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes brjod pas chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol bar bya'o// de ltar na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/

bum dbang thob/ bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ sprul sku rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas pa yin no// gnyis pa gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i// bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// yon tan rgya mtsho'i bka' drin gyis// do nub bla med shes rab 'tshal// do nub bdag la bka' drin mdzod// lan gsum/ gsang dbang gi dam tshig bzung ba 'di'i rjes/ gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig ni/ bshang gci khu ba rak+ta dang*// snabs dang mchil ma mi 'dor zhing*// 'dod yon lnga la ya nga spangs// lan gsum/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum rjes chags kyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ 'dod chags chen pos byang sems kyi ngo bor zhu ba rang la thim/ dga' (192)bzhi'i rim pas lhan skyes kyi ye shes nyams su myong nas/ bde ba'i rten kun da dang rdul gyi dwangs ma sbyor mtshams nas spros pa thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pa lce thog tu sbyin par mos la/ hūm̐/ thabs dang shes rab las byung ba'i// ye shes bdud rtsi dri med 'dis// skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas// gsung gi rdo rje 'grub par shog /oṃ badz+ra bo dhi tsit+ta a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes myong bas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gags/ sems gsal stong nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par gyur/ de nas bla ma'i yum des phyi'i thig le nyi shu rtsa bzhi dgod pa ni/ gnas so sor bdud rtsi'i thig le bya zhing yul nyer bzhi'i ming yig dang po brjod de/ 'tshogs mar pu/ spyi gtsug tu dza/ rna ba g.yas o/ ltag par a/ rna g.yon gau /smin phrag rā/ mig gnyis su de/ dpung pa gnyis ma/ zhes mkha' spyod kyi gnas brgyad/ mchan khung gnyis su kā/ nu ma gnyis su o/ lte bar tri/ sna rtser ko /lkog mar ka /mgrin par la/ snying gar ka / mtshan mar hi/ zhes pas sa spyod kyi gnas brgyad/

gsang gnas su tre/ gshang lam du gṛ/ brlar sau/ byin par su/ sor mor nā/ bol gong gnyis su si/ mthe bong gnyis su ma/ pus mo gnyis su ku/ zhes pas sa 'og spyod kyi gnas brgyad de/ phyi gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i thig le'o// de nas nang gi thig le bdun ni/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mthar g.yon bskor du oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bkod/ gsang ba'i thig le lnga ni/ snying po'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ māṃ lāṃ tāṃ pāṃ khāṃ rnams sngar ltar bkod/ de nas bla ma'i yum gyis slob ma pang du blangs te/ sman phung blud res kyis bde ba rgyas par byas/ rtsa btsal ba ni rtsa sgo dbye ba zhal sbyar/ sna bug gnyis sprad de/ rlung 'bud rngubs spel mas rlung (193)las rung du byed pas rlung lam bstan/ srubs pa dang bsrubs pa'i sbyor bas byang sems yas babs/ 'og rlung gi sbyor bas steng rlung hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes spyi bor drangs/ phan tshun thig le spro res byed pa ni thig le sro ba dang 'pho ba sbyang ba'o// des bde ba'i ye shes brjod bral rgyud la skye zhing skyes brin brtan par byas pa'o// de ltar na kun rdzob byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ gsang dbang thob steng sgo rnam par grol ba'i lam gtum mo sgom pa la dbang*/ longs sku rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas pa yin no// gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas gsol ba btab pa 'di'i/ na mo// dpal ldan bde mchog mgon po yis// dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje la// bde ba'i de nyid bstan pa ltar// deng nub bdag la bka' drin mdzod// lan gsum/ sher dbang gi dam tshig bzung ba 'di'i rjes/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dam tshig ni// bud med spang bar mi bya zhing*// tshangs par spyod la gnas par bya// sems can 'dul don ma gtogs pa// mi dge bcu la ya nga spangs// lan gsum/ de nas slob mas bla ma yab yum gyi zhabs la phyag bya zhing mos gus drag po byas pas/

bla ma thugs rdo rje he ru ka'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i phyag g.yon pas phyag rgya ma gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa'i phyag g.yas pa nas bzung ste/ hūm̐/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo 'di// sna tshogs gzugs can yid du 'ong*// mtha' yi bde ba sbyin pa mo// rnam pa kun tu phyag rgyar long*// long la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// oṃ ma hā su kha hoḥzhes brjod cing slob ma'i lag pa g.yon par gtad par mos la sin+dhū ra'i maṇ+ḍal gtod/ lha mo des kyang lus gcer bur phyung nas gsang rtsa rgyas pa'i pad+ma mtshon bzhin tu (194)'di skad ces/ nga yi gsang ba'i pad+mo 'di// yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas yin// mkhas pa gang gis 'di brten na// de yi mdun na sangs rgyas bzhugs// oṃ badz+ra añja li ho// zhes brjod nas thabs kyi pang du byon par gyur/ de nas slob ma dang rig ma he ru ka yab yum tu gsal btab la/ yab yum gnyis ka'i sku la byang sems kyi thig le gsum phan tshun 'khod res kyis bkod pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la bu'i gnas rnams su gsang dbang ltar thig le bya/ thabs kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa nor bu'i rtse oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ shes rab kyi pad+ma āḥlas ze'u 'bru'i rtse mo as mtshan pa/ de nas rtsa sgo dbye zhing rlung lam bstan pa sngon du 'gro bas thabs shes snyoms 'jug rjes chags kyi rkyen gyis 'khor lo bzhir yas 'bab mas 'jog gi bde ba brtan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de'ang gang zag gcig car ba la rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur te/ 'khor lo bzhir byang sems rim par babs pas/ mgrin par dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ lte bar khyad dga'/ gsang bar g.yo med brtan pa lhan skyes te yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi dang*/ slar yang hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes gyen du gshegs mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi'i rim pa don dam rang rig lhan skyes kyi ye shes bde stong zung 'jug mngon du byas pa'o// yang rim gyis pa lam dus kyi dbang bskur te/

byang sems dbab bzung ldog dgram ste/ mkhas pa bzhi la ngo sprod pa yin no// thod rgal ba la 'bras bu'i dus kyi dbang bskur te/ 'khor lo bzhi la rim par brtan pas tshad med bzhi la sogs pa 'bras bu'i yon tan skye ba'i rim pa rnams shes par mdzod cig /de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ sher dbang thob/ gzhan lus pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang*/ chos sku rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas pa yin no// bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che zhu (195)ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i/ na mo// mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// dbang bskur gsum pa bdag la gnang*// rnam pa kun tu mchog gyur pa'i// bzhi pa yang ni bdag la stsol// lan gsum/ bzhi pa dam tshig bzung ba 'di'i rjes/ na mo// bsrung du med pa'i dam tshig ni// thams cad ro mnyam chos nyid ngang*// 'khor ba spang bar mi bya zhing*// mya ngan 'das pa mi sgrub bo// lan gsum/ de nas slob ma rnams lus gnad chos bdun bca'/ ngag gnad rlung rang sor bzhag /sems gnad gang shar gyi rang ngo la cer gyis ltos/ de ka'i ngang la ma bcos par rang lugs su mnyam par zhog byas la/ ngo sprad pa ni/ hūm̐/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs// rdul bral mthar phyin bde ba ste// khyod kyi pha yang khyod rang nyid// ces bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i sku dang ye shes zung 'jug tu gdod ma nas rang shar ba ni dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes so// de ltar na don dam byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ ngo bo nyid sku rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas pa yin no// de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyi dam tshig khas blangs/ bka' drin gtong rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs kyis lus dbul dge ba bsngo ba rnams bya'o// de nas rjes chog ni/

tshogs la rol/ lhag ma btang*/ mchod pa kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan bde mchog 'khor lo ni// zhes sogs kyis bstod/ bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag dang slob mar (196)bcas pa la// thugs brtse ba chen pos gzigs te/ bar chad zhi ba dang dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod gsol/ yig brgya bzla zhing*/ ma rnyed yongs su sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rnam pa kun tu mgron rnams dang rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa nub tha ma'i tshe/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun gyis gshegs/ rdul tshon gyi nyin dang po rnams dang ras bris la rnam pa kun tu 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyis ye shes pa brtan bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros khams gsum snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i 'khor lor sbyong*/ de thams cad srung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa la thim/ de 'khor rnams la/ 'khor rnams phyogs g.yon bskor dang mtshams g.yas bskor gyis gtso bo la/ yum yab la/ de hūm̐ la/ de bde gsal gyi dbyings su thim par mos la mnyam par bzhag /oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod pas 'od gsal gyi ngang las rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur pa'i snying gar oṃ ha/ 'tshogs mar na ma hi/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hū/ phrag par bau ṣaṭa he/ mig la hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa haṃ/ sum+bha lan gnyis kyis phyogs bcings/ snang grags dran rig thams cad lha sngags bde chen gyi rang bzhin du dag par mos la/ bsngo smon dang shis pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan no// bla ma gong ma rnams 'di thob pas bde mchog thams cad kyi dbang thob par 'gyur bas thun mong ba'o gsungs/ de la stod lugs pa rnams mai tri pas dam pa la gsungs pa bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bskur bar mdzad/

snang lugs pa rnams nag po lugs ḍom+bi bas dam pa la gsungs pa bde mchog lhan skyes kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas bskur bar mdzad/ 'dir bla ma'i phyag bzhes ltar bcu gsum ma la sbyar ba yin la/ gal te lhan skyes kyi dkyil 'khor du bskur bar 'dod na/ (197)dkyil 'khor rtsa thig gi zlum skor dbus chos 'byung sngo dmar brtsegs ma la lha mtshan 'god/ bcas gzhan rnams 'dra/ sgrub mchod ni/ sngon gtor btang*/ gnas yo brlab/ bdag bskyed skyabs sems nas bzlas pa'i bar dam pa phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bdag bskyed du bkod pa ltar bya/ de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dang bum pa stabs cig tu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal dang bum pa'i nang du pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog zhes pa nas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar dang*/ las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa skad cig gis gsal btab/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes pa phaiṃ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ chos dbyings rnam dag mas bstod/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa dang bum par gzungs thag btags nas yi ge bdun pa ci nus dang*/ las bum la sum+bha bzla zhing bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu/ 'das ma 'das kyi gtor ma dang tshogs mchod sngar ltar bya/ de nas slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing slob ma dkyil 'khor du bcug nas dbang bskur zhing rjes chog spyi dang 'dra ba yin no/// /oṃ swa sti/ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra yo gi n+ye/ rdo rje phag mo phyi sgrub zhal gnyis ma lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la/ thog mar bshams bkod ni/ stegs bu'i steng dkyil 'khor rgyas par sgo rdzogs spyi dang 'dra ba'i dbus sam/ bsdu na me'i 'od phreng dang rdo ra'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi nang du chos 'byung bsnol ma'i lte bar gri thod dam baṃ yig dmar po zur drug la dga' 'khyil g.yon du 'khor ba re/
'dab ma brgyad la cang te'u re bri/ de'i dbus su mañji'i steng bum pa bcud ldan chas (198)su bcug pa'i khar ka pā lar

'di ni de lta phyag len mdzad pa'i dbang chog ltar te/ yig rnying la lar bus pa'i g.yas su thod chang dang*/ g.yon du sin+dhū ra'i maṇ+ḍal 'god par bshad pa'ang snang ngo*/ chang la bdud rtsi sbyar bas bkang ba bkod/ dar dmar dang me long sin+dhū ra'i chos 'byung bsnol ma'i lte bar baṃ yig la rtsa sngags kyis bskor ba bris pas kha bcad/ steng na dar dmar gyis bkab/ mtha' mchod pa dang gtor ma tshogs kyi yo byad sogs kyis bskor// nang mchod ḍā dril sogs yo byad thams cad tshogs par 'du bya'o// de nas sgrub mchod ni/ sngon gtor bsang sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hīs byin gyis brlab/ 'bar ba'i rgya dang bcas gtor mgron dgug /a kā ro bdun nam gsum gyis bsngos la/ gang dag 'dir gnas sogs kyis dkar phyogs pa rnams dang*/ gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba'i// 'byung po'i phyogs rnams gang yin pa// gtor ma'i lhag ma 'di longs la// da lta nyid du gzhan du dengs// drag sngags dang bcas pas gtor ma phyir dor/ de nas skyabs yul gsal btab la/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod sogs kyis skyabs su 'gro/ shes rab snying rje sogs kyis sems bskyed/ rang gi spyi bor pad nyi zla bar rdor sems dkar po zhi 'dzum rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang ba'i phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig dkar po/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun g.yas kyi mthe bong las babs pas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs par bsam la/ yig brgya bzlas mthar rdor sems 'od du zhu nas rang la bstim mo// de nas yan lag byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung la oṃ baṃ dmar po// srin lag la haṃ yoṃ sngon po/ gung mor hrīṃḥmoṃ dkar mo/ mdzub mor hrīṃḥhrīṃḥser mo/ mthe bong la hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu/ lag mthil du phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams grub par gyur/ srin lag g.yon pas nang mchod steng chos 'byung 'bri tshul bya zhing*/

(199)ka pā la'i g.yas zur du reg pas oṃ dkar po/ g.yon zur du reg pas āḥdamar po/ mdun zur du reg pas hūm̐ sngon po/ dbus su reg pas baṃ dmar po/ baṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad spyan drangs/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi babs pa baṃ la thim/ baṃ yig zhu ba bdud rtsi la thim pas nang mchod ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes rang lus la rdo rje'i khrus byas par gyur/ sum+bha'i sngags kyis mchod rdzas la gtor bas bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su hūm̐ yig zhu ba las/ mchod rdzas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi sa dang bar snang thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar brjod/ de nas bsrung ba ni/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis lus kyi gnas drug tu bdud rtsi 'thor zhing rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po/ snying gar haṃ yaṃ sngon mo// mgrin par hrīṃ moṃ dmar mo// dpral bar hrīṃ hrīṃ ser mo/ spyi bor hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams dpa' mo drug gi rang bzhin du gyur/ ces pas bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba'o// bdud rtsi phyogs g.yon dang mtshams g.yas bskor du 'thor zhing*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐/ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān bi d+yā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gnyis dang*/ phyogs kun 'thor zhing*/ a hrīḥgha gha ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas bdud rtsi'i zeg ma dpa' mo drug dang ḍā ki dpag tu med par gyur pas bgegs thams cad bskrad/ tshur 'dus pa las phyogs thams cad ḍā ki ma'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me 'bar bas bcings par gyur/

bdud rtsi 'thor zhing oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod de gnas (200)bsrung ba'o// de nas bdag bskyed las/ sbyor ba tshogs bsags pa ni/ rang gi lte ba'i baṃ las 'od zer 'phros bla ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar sad par gyur/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*// yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// ḍā ki'i tshogs dang bcas pa la// kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo// dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa dang*// ting 'dzin yid kyis sprul pa dang*// phyogs bcu gang ba'i mchod rdzas rnams// blo yis blangs te dbul bar bgyi// skye ba 'di dang gzhan dag tu// bdag gis bgyis dang bgyid stsal ba// rjes su yi rang bgyis pa yi// sdig pa ma lus mthol zhing bshags// bla ma sangs rgyas sras bcas dang*// phan mdzad rnams kyi dge ba gang*// nyan thos rang rgyal tshogs bcas la// dang bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// sems can rnams la phan don du// khyod kyi thugs rje cher dgongs te// dbang po'i rim pa dang sbyar nas// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// sngon nas 'brel ba'i yi dam lha// skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rjes gzugs kyi skur bstan nas// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// gdul bya'i bsam pa rdzogs mdzad pa// khyed la gus pas gsol 'debs na// sgrub pa po la byin gyis rlobs// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// zhes dang sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// btang snyoms mchog la gnas par shog /tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ de dag bsod nams kyi tshogs so// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sud+dhaḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/

zhes dag pa gsum gyi sngags brjod pas lus ngag yid gsum sbyangs shing gzhi lam rnam par dag pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur par (201)bsam pa ye shes kyi tshogs so// dngos gzhi ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang lus gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa/ phyi rol dur khrod brgyad srung 'khor dang bcas pas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs de'i nang du gsang sngags kyi yig 'bru dang sems lha sku'i rnam par gyur pa ni/ paṃ las pad+ma'i lte bar mi ro ser po mgo g.yon tu bstan pa'i snying gar oṃ las nyi ma'i da la/ de'i steng du baṃ dmar po yongs su gyur ba las bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo// rtsa zhal khro chags 'dres pa'i rnam pa can/ g.yas zhal phag gdong khro zhing gyen du phyogs pa/ zhal gnyis ka la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung g.yon du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po gyen du sgreng ba/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ mi rus kyi phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho dar la babs pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis sgeg cing rol ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar baṃ/ baṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ 'bar rgya dpral bar bskor zhing pheṃ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par gyur/ lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo// snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje mo// mgrin par hriṃ mam̐ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hreṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/

spyi bor hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams su gyur/ slar yang baṃ las 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar pheṃ/ bdag (202)la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i snod thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de ltar lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag /des skyon bzlas pa la 'jug ste/ lte ba'i baṃ las sngags kyi 'od zer kha dog dmar po byung ba dhū ti brgyud de zhal nas 'thon/ 'phags pa mchod cing sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus lte ba'i baṃ la thim pas sdig sgrib dag cing dngos grub thob par bsam la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+kha nī ye/ badz+ra be ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swa hā/ zhes dang por ngag bzlas dang phyi nas yid bzlas sam 'gog pa'i bzlas pa ci rigs par bya'o// des skyo na lte ba'i baṃ yig las spros pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis mchod bstod kyi las mdzad par mos la/ oṃ badz+ra wā ra hi sa pa rī wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar bcug pas phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ rdo rje phag mo bde gshegs yum// he ru ka dang yang dag sbyor// thod pa dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin// hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi 'brug sgra can// khro bo'i gzugs kyis khams gsum 'joms// ma lus gdug pa sreg par byed// yid 'ong dngos grub kun ster ba'i// phag mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams lte ba'i baṃ la thim par gyur/ da nas mdun bskyed ni dal bsang sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng dur khrod chen po brgyad dang rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba drwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar bas yongs su bskor ba'i nang du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ mtshan (203)nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang du paṃ las pad+ma la gnas pa'i mi ro ser po mgo g.yon du bstan pa'i snying gar oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du baṃ dmar po yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo rtsa zhal khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams can/ g.yas zhal phag gdong khro zhing gyen du phyogs pa/ zhal gnyis ka la spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung g.yon du kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dkar po gyen du bsgreng ba/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ mi rus kyi phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho dar la babs pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis sgeg cing rol ba/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du khwa gdong ma sngon mo// byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo// lhor me gdong ma ser mo// mer gshin rje brtan ma/ bden bral du pho nya mo// rlung du gshin rje mche ba ma/ dbang ldan du gshin rje 'joms ma rnams phyed gzugs/ brgyad ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis cang te'u dang thod khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ ro'i gdan la phyed skyil gyis rol pa/ rgyan cha lugs gtso mo dang mthun pa'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar baṃ/ baṃ las 'od zer 'phros/

rje btsun rdo rje phag mo lha dbu'i dkyil 'khor la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba pheṃ zhes 'bar rgya dang bcas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ zhes pa nas mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan par gyur gyi bar (204)bdag bskyed ltar byas rjes/ lha sku gsal stong gi ngang la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag /lte ba'i baṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas rje btsun ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus lte ba'i baṃ la thim par bsam la/ oṃ gsum bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ de nas mchod pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su hūm̐ yig zhu ba las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas rnams bzang zhing rgya che ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa// nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mor bcas// mchod rdzas ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags kyis// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra wā ra hī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga rnams/ bruṃ khaṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūm̐ ye shes lnga'i ngo bos mtshan pa'i steng du oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i khar baṃ las kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba'i rlangs pas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad spyan drangs/

snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems babs pa baṃ yig kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang zla ba oṃ bcas la thim pas rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi la thim pas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ(205)zhes mang du brjod pas brlabs la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs nas/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje phag mo lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal du/ nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du= /chos bdag mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ zhing skyong kun du ri ka / bka' srung mkha' 'gro sde bzhi/ yon bdag nor bu bzang po// klu chen btang bzung*/ gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du/ khams gsum gyi sems can rje btsun ma'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'bru gsum brjod pas rang gi gnas gsum du reg cing bdud rtsi myong*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes 'khyung rgya byas/ gsang mchod phul/ bstod pa ni/ lte ba'i dbus na rnal 'byor ma// zhe sdang gcod mdzad sgrub pa mo// me long ye shes ngo bo nyid// rdo rje phag mor phyag 'tshal bstod// me dpung 'bar ba'i lte dbus na// sku gsung thugs dang ye shes lnga// bde ba'i bde chen bde ster ma// sangs rgyas yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// dhū ti 'od kyi rang bzhin la// rtsa ba lta bu nyid la bzhugs// zhu ba rang bzhin bde chen ma// bde ster yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// dngos po gshis kyi don ston ma// sku gsum dbyer med bzhugs pa'i ngang*// bde ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// bde chen sna 'dren mkha' 'gro ma// du ma ro gcig don gcig ston// snang stong dbyer med ngo bo nyid// ye shes mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// bdud bzhi'i dmag las rab rgyal zhing*// bde chen byin gyis rlob mdzad ma// rtsa rlung thig le'i ngo bo nyid// las kyi mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// bdud dang log 'dren zhi mdzad cing*// bar chad (206)'dul ba'i byin rlabs can// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul ngo bo nyid// 'jig rten mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/

de nas gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rol mo dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ bde ba chen po'i gzhal yas nas// bla ma rje btsun spyan 'dren gyi// 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// 'og min chos dbyings zhing khams nas// yi dam lha tshogs spyan 'dren gyi// 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// rdo rje rigs kyi zhing khams nas// rdo rje mkha' 'gro spyan= /'khor dang bcas te gshegs= /rin chen rigs kyi zhing khams nas// rin chen mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren gyi// 'khor dang bcas te= /pad+ma rigs kyi zhing khams nas// pad+ma mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren gyi// 'khor dang bcas te= /las kyi rigs kyi zhing khams nas// las kyi mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren gyi// 'khor dang bcas te= /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// chos skyong srung ma spyan 'dren gyi// 'khor dang bcas te= /sa 'og sa steng sa bla nas// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren gyi// 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// 'bar ba'i rgya dang bcas phaiṃ/ oṃ ā ral+li hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes gtor mgron rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar mos la/ rdor thal phyed pa'i rgya dang bcas/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar puṣ+paṃ ba liṃ ta i daṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan lnga'am gsum gyis bla ma dang yi dam la phul/ oṃ hrīṃ hriṃ haṃ haṃ he he ha ha hi hi phaiṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis chos skyong dang las kyi mkha' 'gror phul/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhū te/ pre ta pi shā tsa/ ub+dā dā/ a pa smā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i maṃ ba laṃ gṛh+ṇān+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba (207)sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the ba/ ya thaiṣ+ṭhaṃ/ bhu ñja thā/ ma ti kra ma thā/ ma ma sarba karta ya/ sad su kha/

bi shud+dha ye/ sa hā yi ka bha ban+ta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams la phul/ gzhi bdag la a kā ros bsngos la/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod nas/ bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang*// lha klu 'jig rten skyong ba dang*// gnod sbyin 'byung po srin po dang*// yi dwags sha za brjed byed dang*// smyo byed mkha' 'gro lus srul kun// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi bla ma dam pa dang*// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las bcol/ de nas bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs nang du/ zhes pa nas/ rgyan dang cha lugs gtso mo dang mthun pa'o// zhes pa'i bar gyis lha dgu mdun bskyed ltar bskyed/ las bum du pad nyi ro'i gdan la hūm̐ las khro bo bgegs mthar byed sngon po rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub can stag sham dang*/ sbrul dang*/ rus pas brgyan pa'i skur gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ zhes pa nas/ mi bskyod pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar star ltar byas rjes/ oṃ badz+ra wā ra hi sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing*// zhes sogs kyis (208)bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags phreng gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas lha'i thugs dam bskul/

sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ gzungs thag la 'jus te/ rnam bum la oṃ gsum ma dang*/ a bhi ṣe ka ta/ las bum du sum+bha bzlas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul la/ lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu nus ldan du gyur/ de nas tshogs rdzas rnams nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ tshogs zhing gi mgron rnams phaiṃ zhes sad par mos la/ phyag byas bla ma dkon mchog gi drung du rnam lnga 'dod pa'i rgyas chad phud dbul zhing*/ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa'i// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// zhes brjod nas/ tshogs phud gtor mar bran zhing nang mchod gtor la/ gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro// reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'bul// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /o gu ru badz+ra bā ra hi ḍā ka ḍā ki nī shrī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra a mṛ ta pū dza ho: ma hā ba liṃ ta pū dza hoḥ ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hoḥ zhes phul nas/ na mo// bla ma dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag 'dir 'dus pa rnams kyis thog drangs rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo thams cad kyi dam tshig nyams chag zhig ral du gyur pa thams cad tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'di la brten nas sor chud pa dang*/ sdig sgrib dag cing tshogs rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas ka pā la'i rang sa phar bstan nas mtheb srin gyis 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐/ dgongs sam rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rdo rje mkha' 'gro skad pa de// phyag rgya chen po ma lags sam// de la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// snang ba thams cad mchod pa 'bul// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa (209)'bul// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// dgongs sam ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// ye shes mkha' 'gro skad pa de// chos kyi phyag rgya ma lags sam// de la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// 'dus byas thams cad mchod pa 'bul// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// dgongs sam las kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro skad pa de// dam tshig phyag rgya ma lags sam// de la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// bdud rtsi lnga yi mchod pa 'bul// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// dgongs sam chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs// chos skyong srung ma skad pa de// bar chad bsrung ba ma lags sam// de la mchod par// mchod bstod rgyas pa'i mchod྾// phyi nang gsang ba'i྾

/de nas rang sa rang la bstan// brgyud pa'i bla ma'i dngos grub stsol// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol// rdo rje mkha' 'gro legs grub pa'i// rig 'dzin tshe yi dngos grub stsol// rin chen mkha' 'gro legs grub pa'i// sa dbang gter gyi dngos grub stsol// pad+ma mkha' 'gro legs grub pa'i// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsol// las kyi ḍā ki legs grub pa'i// las la dbang ba'i dngos grub stsol// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro legs grub pa'i// rdzu 'phrul mthu yi dngos grub stsol// chos skyong srung ma legs grub pa'i// bar chad bsrung ba'i dngos grub stsol// nad med bde ba'i dngos grub stsol// 'chi med tshe yi྾// thun mong mchog gi྾ /myur ba nyid du྾// nam mkha' lta bu'i྾// bdud rtsi lta bu'i྾// nor bu lta bu'i dngos grub stsol// gang bar mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a la la hoḥ zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi myong bas dngos grub thob par bsam mo// de nas dbang bskur ba la gnyis (210)las/ dang po slob dpon bdag nyid slob ma la ji ltar bya ba ltar ngal du zhugs nas dbang rdzogs par blangs pa'o// gnyis pa slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ slob bu rnams las bum gyis khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad/ phyag byas gral du 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs dang chos bshad ji ltar rigs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ 'dir rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i nang tshan mchog tu zab pa ma rgyud rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i chos gtso bor ston pa dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phyi sgrub zhal gnyis ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang dang byin rlabs bsgrub pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du song nas/ da slob ma'i bya ba thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer med pa la gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes/

dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// sdom pa thams cad bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum/ de nas kho bos bar chad dri ba yin pas lan drang por thob cig /khyod gsang sngags kyi chos la mos sam/ bus mos lags/ rten sdom pa gsum ldan du sgrub nus sam/ nus lags/ bla ma la sangs rgyas su lta'am/ blta lags/ zhes khas len du gzhug /de nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ bla mas/ bu khyod tshur shog theg chen gyi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin pas// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'das gang dang*// de bzhin ma byon sangs rgyas dang*// da ltar bzhugs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du// (211)thams cad mkhyen pa'i cho ga rnyed// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis btul// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// khyed kyis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces bstod/ de nas sdom pa len pa'i sngon 'gro bsags sbyangs la slob dgos pas tshogs zhing bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar sad par mos la/ dngos su bshams pa de mchod pa lnga 'bul ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes/ lha rdzas las grub me tog bdug spos dang*// mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mor bcas// bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras bcas la// 'bul lo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog

/de nas bdag pos ma bzung ba'i mchod pa thams cad blos blangs te 'bul snyam pas 'di'i rjes/ dbus kyi ri rgyal gser gyi ri bdun dang*// gling bzhi gling phran gur gum spang ri dang*// tsan dan nags ri dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing*// ma rmos lo tog 'dod 'jo'i ba mo dang*// gter bum rin chen bdun sogs blos blangs te// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems bstan srung thams cad la// gus 'bul mkha' khyab sems can ma lus pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog /de nas yid byung gi mchod pa rang gi snying ga nas 'dod yon lnga spros te 'bul snyam pas 'di'i/ mdzes sdug yid 'ong gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra// tshim byed bsrung dang dri dang zhim pa'i ro// mnyen 'khril 'jam legs ldan pa'i na bza' ste// dbang po tshims byed khyad par 'dod yon lnga// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam= /sogs 'dra/ de nas ting 'dzin gyi mchod pa kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha' gang bar mos pa 'di'i/ kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprin tshogs kyis// phyogs kun nam mkha'i khyon rnams kun (212*)bkang ste// rtsa brgyud bla ma sogs 'dra/ de nas zab pa'i mchod pa rang gi lus ngag yid gsum ltos pa med par 'bul snyam pas 'di'i/ yon gnas dam pa khyed rnams la// bdag gi sgo gsum gtan du 'bul// sems dpa' mchog rnams thugs brtse bas// bdag gi sgo gsum yongs bzhes shig /ces brjod/ de nas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i las thams cad la 'gyod sdom gyi bsam pa drag pos bshags par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes/ bdag dang sems can gyis thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du dug gsum gyis kun nas bslangs te sgo gsum gyis bsags pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba mthol lo bshags so// mi sbed slan chad kyang bsdoms par bgyi'o zhes brjod/

de nas sdom pa len pa dngos la gsum las/ so thar ni/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas skyabs zhu na ci mdzad bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pas 'di'i/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs byang sems thams cad dgongs su gsol/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum/ de nas byang sdom ni/ sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas kyis ji ltar thugs bskyed pa ltar bdag gis kyang bskyed snyam pas 'di'i/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis (213)bskyed par bgyi// lan gsum gyis smon pa dang*// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyis 'jug sems// de gnyis kyi mjug sdud ni/ ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces gsum/ de nas sngags sdom ni/ rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pas 'di'i= /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// skyabs gsum dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kun bzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// dam tshig thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// bcu bzhir phye ba'i dam tshig tu// yan lag nyes pa thams cad spang*// lan gsum/

de rnams kyi mjug sdud 'di'i// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// dam tshig sdom pa thams cad bzung*// zhes brjod/ de ltar dam tshig dang sdom pa de dag ma bsrungs na nyes dmigs dang*/ bsrungs na phan yon chen po yod pas mi 'da' ba'i phyir dam la bzhag pa ni/ bdud rtsi blud de/ 'di (214)ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha hūm̐/ de nas/ oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha ba rā ma nā ya hūm̐/ zhes pas mig dar dang*/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gtad/ tshad med pa bzhi'i 'jug pas dal du zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes yol ba'i nang du bcug /de nas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dbab pa'i slad du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bdag la dbab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas re khā zlum po bris pa'i steng du slob ma rnams mnyam pa'i stabs kyis langs nas thal mo spyi bor sbyor la/ rang lus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa'i skur lam gyis bskyed la tha mal gyi 'dzin blo skyur/ ngag gnad rlung kha sbyor du bcings/ sems dus gsum gyi spros pa dor nas bla ma la mos gus drag tu byas pas bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par bde ba'i gar stabs ling ling kha char dang bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas khyed rang la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos bdug cing rol mo 'khrol bas/ hūm̐/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste// rdo rje sems dpa' yin par grags// rdo rje dam tshig bla med pa// da lta nyid du 'bab par shog

/ā be sha ya hrīṃḥ a a phaiṃ phaiṃ zhes dbab cing*/ de ka'i ngang la sems ma bcos par zhog cig /ces bskyang du gzhug /'o khyod rang lhar sgom pa de mtshon byed rtags kyi rnal 'byor ma bya ba bskyed rim/ spros med 'dzin med du 'jog pa de mtshon bya don gyi rnal 'byor ma bya ba rdzogs rim yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ yang khyod rang gi spyi bor rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gar byed pa la shes pa rtse gcig tu gtod cig /ces dbab/ de spyi bor thim pas snang (215)stong 'dzin med kyi nyams skye bas de'i ngang la zhog cig /yang mgrin par rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gar byed pa la rtse gcig tu gtod cig /de mgrin par thim pas grag stong 'dzin med kyi nyams skye bas de'i ngang la zhog cig /yang snying gar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gar byed pa la rtse gcig tu gtod cig /de snying gar thim pas gsal stong 'dzin med kyi nyams skye bas de'i ngang la zhog cig /yang lte bar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gar byed pa la rtse gcig tu gtod cig /de lte bar thim pas rig stong 'dzin med kyi nyams skye bas de'i ngang la zhog cig /yang gsang bar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gar byed pa la rtse gcig tu gtod cig /de yang gsang bar thim pas bde stong 'dzin med kyi nyams skye bas de'i ngang la zhog cig /ces ngo sprad cing re re bzhin yang sngags rol dang bcas pas dbab bo// de nas mdun bskyed rnal 'byor ma'i sku la me tog phul bar mos la 'di'i/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ slar yang me tog de nyid rang gi spyi bor bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pra ti gh+rih+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ s+t+wa ma hā ba la/ de nas tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa/ ces mig phye/ he badz+ra pā sh+ya hoḥ khyed rnams la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal bstan du yod pas zhal mthong ba re dga' snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gtad cing mgo thog tu bzhag la/

rnal 'byor ma ni sngags kyi gzugs// sngags ni rnal 'byor ma yi gzugs// lha dang sngags la tha dad med// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// zhes brjod/ des sku gsung thugs phebs pa gsum dang*/ sku gsung thugs mthong ba gsum gang rung re thob pas ngo shes par mdzod cig /de yan chad kyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs bya ba de tshar ba lags/ da dbang bzhi bskur ba la/ dang po bum pa'i dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang lha (216)rnams kyis ye shes bdud rtsis gang pa'i bum pa thogs te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ kun gzhi ma bcos rnal ma la// gnas lugs rig pa'i nyi ma shar// rang snang ma 'gags thams cad gsal// byin rlabs zhes ni 'di la bya// rje btsun ma yi byin rlabs kyis// bum pa'i dbang bskur thob par shog /ces bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing bum chu blud/ des lus kyi dri ma dag /'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob/ de ma thob kyi bar du'ang phung khams skye mched lhar sgom zhing sgom pa la dbang*/ nyams yul snang stong du 'char bas zhen bral du bskyang bar mdzod/ de brtan phyir dkyil 'khor lhas bkra shis kyi me tog 'thor zhing*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dbang lha rnams rang la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gnyis pa gsang dbang ni/ bla ma bde mchog yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang sems mkha' gsang nas thon pa ka pā la'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pa de nyid lce thog tu byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ g.yo ba med pa'i chos kyi dal// dngos po med pa'i sems nyid gsal// 'dzin pa'i rtog pa rang sar bros// byin rlabs zhes ni 'di la bya// rje btsun ma yi byin rlabs kyis// gsang ba'i dbang mchog thob par shog /ces bdud rtsi lan gsum blud/ des ngag gi dri ma dag /'bras bu longs sku thob/ de ma thob kyi bar du bza' ba ma yin pa'i rtog pa bcom nas rtsa rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs dang*/

rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan sgom pa la dbang*/ nyams sems gsal stong du 'char bas zhen med du bskyang 'tshal lo// gsum pa sher dbang ni/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor las g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te gnas bzhir thig le byas la bla ma dang*/ yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams bstim pa'i byin rlabs kyis gtum mo 'bar bas khams bzhu ba'i dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ sems kyi me long phyis pa las// rang snang dag pa'i (217)gzugs brnyan shar// bde ba dngos med nyams su myong*// byin rlabs zhes ni 'di la bya// rje btsun ma yi byin rlabs kyis// gsum pa'i dbang mchog thob par shog /ces brjod cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ zhes spyi mgrin snying lter sin+dhū ra'i thig le bya'o// des yid kyi sgrib pa dag /'bras bu chos sku thob/ de ma thob kyi bar du thabs shes ya bral gyi nyes pa bcom nas lam phyag rgya brten pa la dbang*/ nyams bde stong du 'char bas zhen bral du bskyang bar mdzod/ bzhi pa tshig dbang ni/ lus gnad chos bdun bca'/ rlung rang babs su bzhag /sems gang shar gyi rang ngo la gcer gyis ltos la bsal bzhag med par zhog mdzod/ hūm̐/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// bltas pas cir yang grub pa med// grub pa med pa'i sems nyid la// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// dngos por bzung bas bag chags gsog /rang bzhin med na sangs rgyas yin// rje btsun ma yi byin rlabs kyis// bzhi pa'i dbang mchog thob par shog /don rang sems rtsa bral bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su ngo shes par gyis shig /des phra ba'i sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob// de ma thob kyi bar du 'khor 'das tha dad du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa spangs nas phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ nyams sems nyid rtsa bral gyi rtogs pa 'char bas zhen bral du bskyang bar mdzod cig

/des dngos gzhi song nas/ mjug rjes su gnang ba la lnga las/ dang po bla ma brgyud pa gtad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ dbang 'di rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ dza lān+dha ra nag po pa/ ḍom+bhi pa/ rje dam pa rgya gar ba nas da lta'i bar du byin rlabs dbang gi chu rgyun ma chad pa'i bka' babs khyad par can yin pas/ khyod kyis kyang bla ma'i brgyud pa zungs la gzhan don gyis shig /(218)gnyis pa yi dam gtad pa ni/ slob dpon gyis dag pa gsum gyi sngags brjod pas lus ngag yid gsum sbyangs te mi dmigs pa las/ pad+ma mi ro nyi ma'i gdan steng baṃ las khyed rang rnal 'byor ma dmar mo rtsa zhal khro mo// g.yas zhal phag gdong gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ rlon pa'i do shal/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ g.yon brkyang ba'i phyed skyil gyi gar gyis bzhugs par gsal thob/ khyod kyis phyin chad rje btsun ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung la 'di ltar rgyun du sgoms shig /gsum pa dkyil 'khor gtad pa ni/ da phyin chad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs la sgrub mchod tshul bzhin du gyis shig /bzhi pa mchod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ nged kyis sngags kyi rjes zlos dang*/ phyag rgya'i lad ma gyis la slob dpon dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod pa phul cig /phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas shab+da'i bar byed du bcug nas/ deng phyin chad phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid dang gtor ma'i mchod pas lha dang bla ma mnyes par gyis shig /lnga pa gsung sngags kyi rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon dang khyed rang gnyis ka rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal ba las/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ slob dpon gyi lte ba'i bam̐ las sngags phreng dmar po byung ba zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ lte ba'i bam̐ la thim par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/

oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+kha nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ me tog de khyed rang gi spyi bor gtor bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di (219)la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes bu'i spyi bor me tog 'thor/ deng phyin chad sngags kyi bzlas pa la brtson par mdzod cig /de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyis dam tshig khas blangs/ gtong rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs kyis lus dbul/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams spyi ltar ro// de nas rjes chog ni/ las kyi rdo rjes thabs shes kyi rdzas bsnol mar thogs nas/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom byar mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams// rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// a ho ma hā su kha ho// len pa pos pad bskor sngon 'gros rtse gsum gyi rgya ston bzhin du/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// a ho ma hā su kha ho// zhes blangs la/ nang gi sregs blugs kyi sgo nas tshim par rol ba'i mthar lhag ma la oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas kha phru btab cing gtsang gtor dang bsres la dpal 'bar btsugs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ 'byung po lhag ma la dbang ba rnams tshim par gyur cig /kye kye rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// las 'di bdag gis bslab par bgyis// bdag la bde legs bsdu ba dang*// phan dang yid 'ong bde ba dang*// grong dang yul 'khor shis par mdzod// ces brjod nas gtsang sar dbul lo// de nas mchod pa kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs/

ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la thugs brtse bas gzigs te/ bar chad zhi ba dang dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ yig (220)brgya bzla zhing ma rnyed yongs su sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa nub tha ma'i tshe dang rgyun du mgron rnams khyed kyis sems can sogs kyis gshegs/ rdul tshon nyin snga ma rnams dang ras bris rnam pa kun tu 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyis ye shes pa brtan bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa rnams rang gi lte ba'i baṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i 'khor lo sbyangs/ de thams cad 'khor gzhal yas khang la thim/ de rnams gtso bo la thim/ de bam̐ la thim/ de'ang thig le la/ de nā da dang*/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ slar yang rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ oṃ/ baṃ/ haṃ/ yo/ hiṃ/ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ sum+bha lan gnyis kyis phyogs bcings/ snang grags 'gyu gsum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag par mos la bsngo smon dang bkra shis brjod// oṃ swa sti/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nang sgrub zhal gcig ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la/ bshams bkod ni stegs gtsang mar dkyil 'khor rgyas par sgo rdzogs kyi dbus sam/ bsdu na me 'od dang rdo ra'i dbus su chos 'byung rkyang pa'i lte bar gri thod dam baṃ yig dmar po bri/ me long gi sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor yang chos 'byung rkyang pa'i dbus su baṃ yig rtsa sngags kyis bskor ba bri/ bcas gzhan rnams lha dgu dang 'dra'o// de nas sgrub mchod ni/ sngon gtor nas bzung ye shes tshogs gsog gi bar lha dgu ltar ba zhing*/

bdag bskyed dngos gzhi ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang lus dag pa'i gzhal yas khang lte bar chos 'byung gi nang du pad nyi dus mtshan gyi steng na ngag dag pa baṃ yig dmar po// de yongs su gyur pa las/ sems dag pa rje btsun ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ khro (221)chags 'dres pa'i nyams can/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa'i mchan na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga sogs dur khrod kyi chas can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing*/ zhabs g.yas bskum pa'i mthil g.yon pa'i brla la sbyar ba'i gar stabs kyis dus mtshan ma brdzis pa'o// de nas lte bar baṃ yig dmar po gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros nub phyogs o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing khams nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa phaiṃ zhes 'bar rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo// snying gar hoṃ yoṃ sngon mo// mgrin par hriṃ maṃ dkar mo// dpral bar hreṃ hreṃ ser mo/ spyi bor hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams go cha'i dpa' mo drug gi ngo bor gyur/ yang baṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas dbang gi lha phaiṃ zhes spyan drangs/ bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ dbang lha badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ de nas lte ba'i baṃ las mchod pa'i lha mo dpag med byung nas rje btsun ma go cha'i dpa' mo drug dang bcas pa la mchod cing bstod par mos la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/

oṃ shrī badz+ra yo gī ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul la/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji (222)snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod nas lha mo rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i glu len zhing baṃ la thim par gyur/ de nas lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i baṃ yig gi mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyis su ma rim du bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs dam bskul/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rang la thim par mos la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra wa nī yai/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī yai hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ngag bzlas dang yid bzlas ci rigs par bya'o// de nas rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni/ sku de nyid las ma g.yos par gnas bzhir 'khor bzhi'i mkha' 'gro rnams la gsal btab la 'jam rlung 'dzin/ yang de ltar gsal ba'i ngang nas spyi bor bla ma sgom la mos gus drag tu bya/ bsgom blo bsam gtan gyi 'ching ba dang tha mal gyi rnam rtog spangs te rang sems ma bcos par bzhag go /de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dang bum pa stabs gcig tu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa lte ba chos 'byung gi nang dang rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su pad nyi dus mtshan gyi gdan la baṃ yig yongs su gyur ba las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ zhes pa nas/ de snyed rnams phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod pa'i bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las/ las bum sgrub na dus mtshan ma brdzis pa'o// zhes pa'i mjug tu las bum du khro bo bgegs mthar byed gsal bar gyur/

zhes sbrel lo// bstod pa song ba dang*/ mdun bskyed la dmigs nas/ lte ba'i baṃ yig /sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus (223)baṃ yig la thim par mos nas/ oṃ gsum ma ci 'grub bzla/ bum par gzungs thag gtad la/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags phreng gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas thugs dam bskul/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar mos la/ rnam bum la oṃ gsum ma dang*/ las bum sum+bha bzlas la/ 'bru gsum gyis mchod yon phul bas lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu nus ldan du gyur/ de nas gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung raṃ las me/ hūm̐ gsum las thod pa'i sgyed pu la gnas pa'i ā las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gnas pa/ ye shes zhes brjod pas rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu zhing 'phar bas lud pa'i lbu ba kha ṭ+wām̐ gar gyur pa las oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa rnams mchod pas dgyes pa chen pos mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang sems babs pa 'bru gsum kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas pa la thim nas rim par zhu ba bdud rtsi dang gcig tu 'dres pas snang srid thams cad bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum mam bdun brjod/ oṃ ā ral+li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+yā hoḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ he he ha ha hi hi/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes 'bar ba'i rgya dang bcas pas gtor mgron rnams mdun gyi nam mkha' la thibs kyis byon par gyur/ de nas rdor thal phye ba'i rgya dang bcas/ oṃ na mo gu ru shrī badz+ra yo gi nī/ kā la ru pī nī/ dz+wa la mu khi nī hri/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes gsum mam bdun gyis gtso bo la phul/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ rat+na ḍā ki nī/ pad+ma ḍā ki nī/ karma ḍā ki nī/

bi shra ḍā ki nī/ sa ma ya ḍā ki nī/ lo ka sarba ḍā ki nī ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas 'khor rnams la phul*/ (224)oṃ in+d+ra ya/ ag+ni ya/ ya mā ya/ rak+ṣa sa ye/ nīr+d+ya/ nā ga ya/ wā ya we/ ku be rā ya/ ī shwa nā ya/ de ba ni/ sur+ya ni/ tsan+d+ra ni/ lo ka de ba/ sarba i maṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas phyogs skyong dang*/ zhing skyong rnams la phul nas/ bstod pa dang phrin las bcol ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo ni/ 'jig rten gsum sogs rgol bas mi tshugs shing*// 'byung po ma lus gri gug chen pos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs dbang thod pa 'dzin// khro mo'i gzugs brnyan shin tu drag snyems ma// rmugs byed rengs byed rmongs pas rab rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa snyems shing zhi bar mdzad// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug khyod la 'dud// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*// dus gsum bde gshegs yi dam lha// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs bcas la// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di phul bas// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las bcol lo// de nas tshogs mchod dang*/ slob dpon bdag 'jug slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang bskur ba rnams lha dgu ltar las/ dbang bshad skabs phyi sgrub zhal gnyis ma'i zhes pa nang sgrub dmar chung ma'i zhes dang*/ yi dam bstod pa'i skabs pad+ma mi ro nyi ma'i zhes pa pad nyi dus mtshan ma'i zhes dang rtsa zhal khro bo/ g.yas zhal phag gdong zhes pa gnyis su/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma zhes bsgyur ba khyad par ro// mjug chog ni gtong rag mchod bstod/ 'dod gsol/ dkyil 'khor gshegs bsdu rnams kyang lha dgu ltar bya'o// bsngo smon ni/ skye zhing skye bdag ni thams cad du// blo ldan rigs (225)bzang nga rgyal med pa dang*// snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus ldan// rdo rje phag mo'i 'bras bu myur thob shog

/bkra shis ni/ rdo rje ḍā kis legs byin pa'i// thogs pa med pa'i bkra shis shog /rin chen ḍā kis legs byin pa'i// dbang bskur mchog gi bkra shis shog /pad+ma ḍā kis legs= /shes rab mchog gi= /las kyi ḍā kis= /las rnams grub pa'i= /phrin las rmad du byung ba yi// bde chen dag pa'i bkra= /bla ma dam pas legs byin pa'i// thugs rje grub pa'i= /sgrub na dngos grub legs byin pa'i// rnal 'byor ma yi= /gang la sems kyi dbang thob pa'i// 'od gsal rtogs pa'i= /sku gsung thugs ni dag pa yi// phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog /ces shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan no// dmar chung ma 'di ni brgyud pa dang po'i lugs gtso che yang*/ brgyud pa phyi ma'i nang na'ang 'di'i sgrub thabs bzhugs pa ltar de nyid dbang btsan du mdzad nas bla ma rnams kyis bka' phyi ma'i chos sde'i khog tu bsdebs par mdzad do// shu bhaṃ/// /oṃ swa sti/ gsang sgrub khros ma nag mo'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la/ bshams bkod ni/ stegs bu chang dang bdud rtsis chag chag btab la/ dkyil 'khor lte ba zlum po'i nang du chos 'byung sngon po zur mdun bstan gyi dbus su baṃ yig nag po/ de'i phyogs bzhir pad+ma 'dab bzhir phyogs mdog la ha ri ni sa bri/ mtha' rdo ra me ris bskor ba'o// de'i dbus su mañji'i steng du gtor ma nag po rtse zlum stod zur gsum pa dar nag gi gdugs phub pa zhig dang*/ phyogs bzhir gtor chung dkar zlum bzhi/ shar du khros ma'i lha tsaka /lhor bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa/ nub tu me long la sin+dhū ra bkram ste chos 'byung rkyang pa rdo ra me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su baṃ la ha ri (226)ni sas bskor ba bris pa/ byang du sgrub thabs kyi glegs bam rnams bkod/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ gzhan yang nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya'o// de nas sgrub mchod ni/

sngon gtor dkar dmar gnyis bshams pa bsang sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥs byin gyis brlabs/ 'bar ba'i rgya dang bcas phaiṃ zhes mgron dgug /gtor ma dmar po de oṃ ḍā ka ḍā ki k+ṣe tra pā la da sha diklo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra e daṃ ba li+iṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ mkha' 'gro zhing skyong phyogs skyong sogs srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul lo// bdag cag dpon slob 'gal rkyen sol mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod/ ces phul/ dkar gtor de a kā ros lan gsum gyis gzhi bdag rnams la 'bul lo// gnod pa'i bsam sbyor spangs la phan bde'i bsam pas bdag gi stong grogs mdzod cig /ces phyir dor zhing nag phyogs rnams sum+bha'i drag sngags kyis bskrad do// de nas bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar sad par bsam la/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod sogs dang*/ shes rab snying rje sogs kyis skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ yan lag bdun pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod pa bla na med pas mchod// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// bdag gis dge ba ci bsags pa// sems can kun la bsngo bar bgyi// tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ nang mchod la/ srin lag gis chos 'byung 'bri tshul bya zhing*/ dam rdzas 'bar ba'i snod du chos 'byung gi dbus su pad+ma 'dab bzhi la ha ri ni sa gsal bar gyur/ de las 'od zer (227)'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi la thim pas zhu zhing 'dres pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ de las g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod blangs te oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes rang lus la gtor zhing khrus byas pas bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung*/

phyogs g.yon dang mtshams g.yas bskor gyis bdud rtsi 'thor zhing sum+bha lan gnyis brjod pas/ bdud rtsi'i thigs ma ḍā kis sprin du gyur pas bgegs thams cad bskrad/ gzhom med bsrung ba'i 'khor los phyogs thams cad bcings par bsams pa ni gnas bsrung ba'o// de nas mchod rdzas rnams bsang*/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su hūm̐ yig zhu ba las mchod rdzas rnams bzang zhing rgya che ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas dngos gzhi ni/ shū n+ya tā'i sngags kyis bdag dang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyis mtshon pa'i chos thams cad stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang lus srung 'khor dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad+ma 'dab bzhi chos 'byung gi lte bar pad nyi ro'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ rang sems lha'i 'khor lo rdzogs pa ni/ gdan gyi steng baṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog nag mo rtsa zhal kun rdzob rnam par dag pa khro mo'i zhal dang*/ steng zhal don dam rnam par dag pa phag gdong g.yas phyogs nas gyen du phyogs pa las phag skad sngags kyi sgrar sgrogs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag (228)thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i cha byad lngas brgyan cing smyon pa'i cha byad can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis mi ro'i snying ga nas brdzis pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba/ snying gar yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo gri thod kha ṭ+wām̐ ga bsnams pa la yi dam thams cad kyis bskor ba/ pho bar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar phyag rdor sngon po rdor dril 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang ba'i dor stabs can/

rtsibs bzhi'i shar du ma las yul 'khor srung dkar po g.yas pi waṃ/ lhor tsa las 'phags skyes po sngon po g.yas ral gri/ nub tu tri las mig mi bzang dmar po g.yas bu chung gi ro/ byang du yaṃ las rnam sras ljang gu g.yas mchod rten/ bzhi ga g.yon rin po che'i bum pa 'dzin pas sgrub pa po la dgos 'dod ster ba'o// lte bar pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su rang 'dra ba'i rje btsun khros ma nag mo// 'dab bzhi'i shar du ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo g.yas rdo rjes yu ba byas pa'i gri gug /lhor ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo g.yas rin po che'i gri gug /nub tu ni las pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo g.yas pad+ma'i gri gug /byang du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu g.yas rgya gram gyi gri gug /g.yon thams cad thod khrag 'dzin pa'o// de ltar gnyug ma'i sems nyid lha'i 'khor lor rdzogs pa/ de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gdod ma nyid nas rang bzhin dbyer med pa'i bdag nyid chen por rnam par dag par gyur/ de ltar gsal ba'i ngang nas lus gnad bca' zhing skabs skabs su lto ba phul ba dang g.yon du bskor/ rlung steng 'og kha sbyar la yid bzlas bya/ sems bde stong gi nyams la che re blta/ yid chos nyid kyi ngang la ma yengs par 'jog cing (229)dran pa bzhis bskul gdab la bzlas pa bya ste/ spyi bo'i bla ma dran pas/ ha ri ni sa e raṃ zhes bzla/ snying ga'i yi dam dran pas/ ha ri ni sa yan te/ zhes bzla/ lte ba'i mkha' 'gro dran pas/ ha ri ni sa e 'du/ zhes bzla/ pho ba'i chos skyong dran la/ ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla'o// 'dir bdag mdun dbyer med du sgrub cing bzla ba'i lugs yin pas mdun bskyed log sgrub mi dgos so// de ltar ci nus bzlas mthar mchod bstod ni// oṃ badz+ra wā ra hi sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/

'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul nas/ pad+ma nyi ma rtog med gdan la gar mdzad cing*// mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras// khros pa'i phag skad 'gros kyis 'gro rnams dbang du sdud// rdo rje phag mo bde ba'i stobs ldan khyod la bstod// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*// phyag na rdo rje phyogs skyong rgyal chen bzhi// rdo rje phag mo las bzhi sgrub byed pa'i// mkha' 'gro rnams la sgo gsum gus pas bstod// ces bstod/ de nas gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i steng du a las ka pā la sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/ steng du zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bzlas pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas 'bar ba'i rgya dang bcas phaiṃ zhes brjod pas gtor mgron rnams spyan drangs la/ oṃ gu ru badz+ra yo gī ni badz+ra pā ṇi shrī badz+ra wā ra hī ma hā yo gi nī ha ri ni sa ra tsa tri yi i daṃ ba liṃ ta sogs sbyar bas phyogs gtor bzhi po mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang rgyal po sde bzhi la phul/ thun mong du/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis (230)nang mchod 'bul// bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo chen mo ni// 'jig rten gsum dang phyogs gzhan rgol ba 'joms// rmongs byed skrag byed rengs par byed pa mo// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma bde gshegs yi dam lha// ma dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// phyag 'tshal bstod cing gus pas mchod// rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma 'bul// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ tshogs mchod ni phyi sgrub zhal gnyis ma ltar bya'o// de nas dbang bskur ba la gnyis las dang po slob dpon bdag 'jug ni/

'og nas 'byung ba'i slob ma la ji ltar bya ba ltar bdag 'jug dbang bskur ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul du blangs/ gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ slob bu rnams khrus dang phyag byas gral du 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs dang chos bshad ci rigs sngon du 'gro bas/ 'dir bla na med pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud dang rjes su 'brel ba/ de la'ang rgyud lung man ngag gsum las/ man ngag gi rjes su 'brang ba ḍā ki ma snying gi dum bu drug cu rtsa bzhi zhes bka' srung mkha' 'gro sde bzhis rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas la gsungs pa'i khros ma nag mo'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas/ da khyed rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes lan gnyis kyi mig dar dang me tog gtad/ de nas bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes= /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// rnal 'byor ma dpal dgongs su gsol// byang chub sems las rmad byung ba'i// sdom pa rgya mtsho bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum/ de nas bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil (231)'khor gyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar sad par mos la 'di'i/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// mchod pa bla na med pas mchod// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// bdag gis dge ba ci bsags pa// sems can kun la bsngo bar bgyi// lan gsum/ de nas spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa mtha' dag bzung snyam pas 'di'i= /sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis deng nas byang chub bar// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// thar pa 'dod phyir skyabs su mchi// sems can kun don bsgrub pa'i phyir// byang chub sems gsum bskyed par bgyi// bde gshegs rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*// bcu bzhir phye ba'i ltung ba dang*// yan lag nyes pa spang bar bgyi// lan gsum/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas dkyil 'khor du bcug par mos la yol ba bsal/ dam bzhag ni/ bdud rtsi blud la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// a mṛ ta u da ya ka ṭha ṭha hūm̐/ de nas khyed rang mnyam pa'i stabs kyis langs la thal mo spyi bor sbyor/ ngag rlung kha sbyor du 'chings/ sems kyi gnad lugs rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nag mo// rtsa zhal khro mo// g.yas zhal phag gdong gri gug dang thod khrag bsnams pa/ zhabs gar stabs ling ling bsgyur ba zhig tu lam gyis bskyed la bla ma la mos gus drag po byas pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas khyed rang la thim par mos la sems 'dzin med (232)kyi ngang du khres se bskyur la zhog cig /spos rol dang bcas pas ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya a zhes drag tu dbab/ de nas rnal 'byor ma'i sku la me tog phul bar mos la 'di'i rjes= oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes me tog dor/ de nyid spyi bor bcings par mos la/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ sarba ma hā ba la/ de nas dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu maṇ+ḍal dz+nyā na pra be sha ya phaṭa/ ces mig dar bsal/ ha badz+ra pa sh+ya/ rten dang rten par bcas pa'i dal thams cad mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas dbang bskur ba dngos la bzhi las/ dang po bum dbang zhu ba'i slad du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes/ bla ma rin po che/ bdag la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang sgrub kyi bum pa'i dbang stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis shar gyi tsa ka li'i sku mig tu bstan cing lag tu gtad la/ khyed rnams lus tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa phor la/ deng phyin chad mkha' 'gro ma 'di yi dam du bzung la/ 'di ltar sgom pa la snang stong zhen bral du bskyang bar gyis shig

/des bum dbang thob pas lha sku bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no// de nas gsang dbang zhu ba'i slad du 'di'i rjes/ bla ma rin po che/ bdag la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang sgrub gsang ba'i dbang stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ lho'i bdud rtsi thogs te khyed kyi ngag tha mal du 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan bde mchog yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'di la byin gyis brlabs pas/ deng phyin chad ngag rje btsun ma'i sngags su shes par gyis la grag stong zhen med du skyong bar mdzod cig byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bdud rtsi hu ba gsum 'thung du gzhug /des gsang dbang thob pas rlung sngags bzlas sgom la dbang bar byas pa yin no// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i slad du (233)'di'i rjes= /bla ma rin po che/ bdag la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang sgrub kyi shes rab ye shes kyi dbang stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ nub kyi sin+dhū ra'i dal ston cing*/ khyed kyi yid kyi dri ma dag par byed pa la/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi yi ge 'di rnams rnal 'byor ma dngos yin/ de thim pas 'di rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa las bde stong gi nyams khyad par can dang ma bral bar mdzod/ sngags 'di rnal 'byor ma yi gzugs// rnal 'byor ma yang sngags kyi gzugs// dngos grub go 'phang mchog 'dod na// de 'dra tha dad mi blta'o// zhes brjod cing*/ sin+dhū ra g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs la slob ma'i gnas bzhir thig le bya'o// des sher dbang thob pas zhu bde sgom pa la dbang byas pa yin no// de nas dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i slad du 'di'i rjes/ bla ma rin po che/ bdag la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang sgrub kyi dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ byang gi sgrub thabs kyi dpe mgo thog tu bzhag nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad dpe 'di nas bshad pa bzhin nyams su blangs nas 'byung bas tshul bzhin du nyams su long la/

sems nyid rtsa bral gyi don rtog par mdzod cig /de nas dpon slob gnyis ka khros ma nag mo zhal gnyis ma gri thod bsnams pa g.yas brkyang gi gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma snying gar rnal 'byor ma dmar mo la yi dam gyis bskor ba/ lte bar pad+ma 'dab bzhir khros na ga rang 'dra ba la mkha' 'gro sde bzhis bskor ba/ pho bar 'khor lo'i rtsibs bzhi par/ phyag rdor la rgyal chen sde bzhis bskor ba rnams gsal thob/ de nas dran pa bzhi dang ldan pa sngags kyi rjes zlos byas pa'i tshe bla ma'i gnas so so las 'od zer byung ba slob ma'i gnas de dang der thim pas byin gyis brlabs par mos la/ (234)dang po spyi bo'i bla ma dran pas 'di'i rjes= /ha ri ni sa e raṃ/ snying ga'i yi dam dran pas 'di'i rjes= /ha ri ni sa yan te/ lto ba'i mkha' 'gro dran pas 'di'i rjes= /ha ri ni sa e 'du/ pho ba'i chos skyong dran pas rjes/ ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sngags rnams lan gsum re bzla'o// khyed rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'jug par gyur cig /ces me tog 'thor/ des dbang bzhi pa thob de kho na nyid bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no// de nas slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dam tshig khas blangs gtong rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang lus 'bul/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rjes chog gtong rag gi mchod bstod bsngo smon bkra shis kyi bar phyi sgrub ltar bya'o// dar rgyas 'phel/ shu bhaṃ/ oṃ swa sti/ rdo rje gtum mo mkha' 'gro ma bdud rtsi bum pa'i dbang bskur bar 'dod pas/ bshams bkod ni/ stegs bu la khrag dang bdud rtsis chag chag gdab/ dkyil 'khor lta ba zlum po ji ltar rigs pa bskor ba'i nang du chos 'byung dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su hrīḥyig dmar po/ de'i phyir rim par myu khyud thod skam gyi phreng ba/

pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi phyogs kyi 'dab bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang la ha ri ni sa/ mtshams kyi bzhi'i (235)nang du thod skam gyi mu khyud zlum po re bskor ba'i chos 'byung zur nang bstan me nas rim par sngo ser dmar ljang la hrīḥyig re re bris pa/ de rnams kyi mtha' thod skam gyi ra ba/ rdo ra me ri rnams kyis bskor ba bri'o// dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mañji'i steng du bum pa bcud ldan chas su bcug pa'i khar bdud rtsi dang sbyar ba'i thod pa dar dmar gyis kha bcad pa/ de'i steng du me long la sin+dhū ra'i chos 'byung bsnol ma'i dbus su gtso mo'i snying po dang zur drug la g.yung drung g.yas bskor re/ mtha' thod phreng dang 'od phreng gis bskor ba bkod/ bum pa'i mdun du mañji'i steng gtor ma rtsa zlum stod zur gsum pa dmar po dar dmar gyi gdugs dang gtso mo'i tsakli btsugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng du 'khor brgyad gtor ma gtso bo dang 'dra ba la so so'i lha tsaka btsugs pa re bkod/ rgyud kyi pu sti yang ci bder bzhag /steng na dar dmar gyi gur phub/ mtha' mchod pa dang tshogs kyi yo byad kyis bskor/ nang mchod ḍā dril me tog sogs thams cad chang bar 'du bya'o// de nas sgrub mchod ni/ sngon gtor bsang sbyangs/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥs brlab/ phaiṃ gyis mgron dgug /a kā ro bdun nam gsum gyis bsngos la/ gang dag 'dir gnas sogs kyis dkar (236)phyogs pa dang*/ gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gang yin pa// gtor ma'i lhag ma 'di longs la// da lta nyid du gzhan du dengs// drag sngags dang bcas pas nag phyogs bskrad la gtor ma phyir dor/ skyabs yul gsal btab nas/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod sogs kyis skyabs 'gro/ shes rab snying rje sogs kyis sems bskyed/ na mo// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// mchod pa bla na med pas mchod// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// bdag gis dge ba ci bsags pa// sems can kun don bsngo bar bgyi// zhes bdun rnam dag dang*/
