sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnams kyis bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags rjes// chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i stong pa nyid du mos par gyur pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs so// de nas nang mchod bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod pa'i (237)sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la ye shes lnga'i ngo bo dpa' mo 'bru lngas mtshan pa'i steng du oṃ dkar po mgo thur bstan gyi khar zla ba la gnas pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rlung me sbar bas rdzas zhu zhing khol ba'i rlangs pas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad spyan drangs/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems babs/ baṃ yig kha ṭ+wāṃ ga zla ba oṃ bcas la thim pa rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por 'khyil bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥzhes bzlas pas brlabs la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs nas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'thor bas lag mchod 'bul/ de nas srung 'khor ni/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis se gol re re gdab cing*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐/ logs thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba dang drwa ba/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ oṃ a na ya hoḥbha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar bas bcings te cis kyang mi shigs par gyur par bsam mo// dngos gzhi ni/ srung 'khor gyi nang du oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhā sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/

zhes pas rang gi lus rnam par dag pa chos 'byung bsnol ma yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba ཿyo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes pas ngag rnam par dag pa khrag gi rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dkyil na pad nyi ro'i gdan la hrīḥdamar po gnas pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa li'i sgra sgrog par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra sarba dharmā badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes pas hrīḥyongs su gyur pa las yid rnam par dag pa bdag nyid (238)rdo rje gtum mo khros pa'i sku dmar mo zhal gnyis phyag bzhi ma/ don dam tshangs zhal phag gdong gi spyan gyen la gzigs shing*/ kun rdzob khro zhal gyi spyan thur la gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa spyi bor 'dzin pa/ 'og mas pad+ma dmar po mgrin par 'dzin pa/ g.yon dang pos rin po che thugs gar 'dzin pa/ 'og mas sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram lte bar 'dzin pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ shin tu sgeg cing khros pa'i nyams rgyas pa/ zhabs gyad kyi dor stabs kyis dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ zhal nas badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa li'i sgra sgrog cing thod mkhar gyi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi thugs kar hrīḥyig dmar po gnas pa hrīḥdamar gnyis pa chad mdun gyi dal gyi dbus su song ba las skad cig gis chos 'byung bsnol ma khrag gi rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dkyil na pad nyi ro'i steng du rdo rje gtum mo khros ma'i sku rang 'dra ba zhig gsal bar gyur/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i tshangs zhal gyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du sleb cing*/ khro zhal gyi spyan gyis dus gsum gsal ler gzigs pa/ zhal nas badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa li sgra sgrog pas snang srid lha srin sde brgyad thams cad dam la 'dogs shing dbang du sdud par gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs srog las hrīḥbazhi phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhi'i steng du 'phros pa yongs su gyur pa las/

shar du lag na rdor 'chang dkar mo g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon sdigs mdzub zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ lhor gtsug na me khyer phyag gnyis spyi gtsug tu me 'bar ba 'dzin zhing g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa/ nub tu mtha' nas shog bsdud ma dmar mo phyag gnyis brkyang ba'i rgyab na gshog pa dkar po cung zad phab cing zhabs sa ga'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ byang du kha nas khus 'debs ma ljang gu zhi ma khro'i nyams can phyag gnyis kyis (239)dud 'dzin cing 'bud pa zlum po'i stobs kyis bzhugs pa'o// slar yang thugs srog las hrīḥbazhi mtshams bzhir 'phros pa yongs su gyur pa las/ thod mkhar gyi nang chos 'byung khrag gi rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dbus su ro'i gdan re re la/ shar lhor dga' rab dbang phyug gi bu mo seng gdong ma sngon mo g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa bsnams shing*/ dpung steng nas seng phrug 'phyo ba/ lho nub tu laṅka mgrin bcu'i bu mo stag gdong ma ser mo g.yas 'phrul gyi me long bsnams shing dpung steng na stag phrug 'phyo ba/ nub byang du dbang phyug chen mo'i bu mo sprel gdong ma dmar mo g.yas dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo bsnams shing*/ dpung steng na sprel phrug 'phyo ba/ byang shar du gnod sbyin 'brog gnas kyi bu mo spyang gdong ma ljang gu g.yas pa ne'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams shing*/ dpung steng na spyang phrug 'phyo ba/ bzhi ka g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ sangs rgyas stong gi dbu rgyan can/ lto ba na mkha' 'gro'i rdzing bcas shing mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor ba'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pas rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gyur/ khyad par thugs srog gi gor hrīḥdamar gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros rdo rje gtum mo lha dgu'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo phaiṃ zhes 'bar rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar phaiṃ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs pas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa re res dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas lha sku'i gsal snang la ci gnas mnyam par bzhag nas/ (240)des skyo na bzlas pa la 'jug ste/ bdag mdun gyi gtso mo'i thugs srog hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba/ bdag gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer spros pa mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs mchod cing dgyes pa bskyed/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ 'od zer tshur 'dus rang la thim pas sdig sgrib sbyangs shing dngos grub thams cad thob par bsams la/ e ma ding ri ding ri badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes gtso bo'i snying po'o// 'khor rnams kyi bzlas pa ni/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sngags 'od kyis mdun bskyed kyi gtso mo bskul bas de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros 'khor rnams la phog pas/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang mchu chung ma bzhi las rang 'dra'i sprul pa dpag med spros pas stong gsum zil gyis mnan/ srid gsum dbang du sdud/ phrin las bzhi'i dngos grub kyi skal ba thams cad bdag la phul bar bsam zhing*/ e ma ding ri ding ri badz+ra ḍā ki nī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ badz+ra gyi gnas su/ rat+na/ pad+ma/ bi shwa bcug sring ltar sgrub/ mkha' 'gro bzhi'i sngags dang*/ yang sing ha ra ma/ ka ma ka ra ti/ ha na dza na hūm̐/ rā ga rā ti/ bzhi bcug pa bran ltar bkol ba mchu chung ma bzhi'i sngags te mang nyung gtso 'khor gyi 'gros sbyar nas bzla'o// bzlas pas skyon mchod bstod bya ste/ mchod rdza swa bhā sang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las snod ka pā lar bcud mchod rdzas rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha' gang bar bsam zhing 'bru gsum bzlas pas brlab/

de nas rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis mchod cing bstod par mos la/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍā sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje gtum mo lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong zhing skyong (241)gzhi bdag rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad rje btsun ma'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes phul/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ mkha' ltar dag pa chos kyi dbyings// 'ja' ltar sgrib med gzhal yas khang*// nyi ltar 'jam pa'i thugs rje las// zla ltar gsal ba'i phrin las can// hrīḥlas byung ba'i dpa' mo'i sku// yi ge i dang yang dag ldan// gcer bu pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /keng rus mche gtsigs srin mo'i gzugs// rin chen khrag gi rba klong na// e ma ding ri'i sgra sgrog ma// zhal gcig phyag ni bzhi pa ste// zhabs gnyis gyad kyi dor stabs can// kun rdzob khro zhal thur la gzigs// don dam tshangs zhal gyen du gzigs// phyag rgya lnga dang rab ldan cing*// dur khrod dbyings nas 'gying bag can// 'khor du sha za 'bum gyis bskor// 'jig rten gsum po 'chings mdzad ma// he ru ka dang gnyis med 'khril// lha chen btsun mo khyod phyag 'tshal// bdud bzhi las ni rgyal ba mo// snying rje'i khrag 'dzag 'gro ba 'dul// skye med ye shes dag pa'i sku// e yi dbus su lhun gyis grub// rtog med ro yi gdan steng na// dbang gi cha byad sku mdog dmar// mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can// tsaṇ+ḍa hūm̐ gi sgra sgrog cing*// phaṭa phaṭa thog gi sgra 'phen ma// swā hā 'khor ba'i dbugs 'byin ma// bde ba'i dngos grub ster mdzad ma// bde chen phul du gyur pa'i mchog

/don dam pha rol phyin pa mo// kun rdzob khro mo'i gzugs 'dzin cing*// snying rje stong pa'i rang bzhin can// phyag mtshan gri thod rtags mtshan rnams// dag byed tshangs pa'i skud pa ni// cod pan tshul du phyogs bcur 'phyar// zhal gdong dmar la mche ba gtsigs// za byed rngam zhal spyan rtsa dmar// phyogs rnams kun du lta byed cing*// sems can don kun sgrub mdzad ma// rdo rje gtum mo khyod (242)la bstod// 'byung ba bzhi po rnam dag cing*// tshad med bzhi yi ngo bo nyid// dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum// spyan sogs lha mo bzhi la bstod// ye shes rang snang dkyil 'khor nas// bdag med lha mo'i rnam 'phrul las// dbyings nas bzhengs pa'i dpa' mo bzhi// las bzhi'i dngos grub ster la bstod// lung ston zhing skyong srid pa yi// rgyal mo yid bzhin nor bu bzhi// grogs ltar brten na dngos grub ni// stsol mdzad ḍā ki bzhi la bstod// sgrub pa po dang sangs rgyas kyi// bstan pa'i bar chod bsrung mdzad cing*// brtse ba'i grogs dang las mdzad ma// bka' srung mkha' 'gro bzhi la bstod// ces bstod nas/ mkha' 'gro rnams rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim par bsam mo// de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ dal la bkod pa'i gtor ma rnams phud bran zhing bsang sbyangs nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bar rgya dang bcas pas phaiṃ/ oṃ ā ral+li hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+wa/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas gtor mgron rnams mdun mkhar spyan drangs/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ gtso mo dang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang mchu chung ma bzhi rnams kyi sngags mthar ba liṃ ta i daṃ gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pa lan gsum gyis bla ma dang dal gyi lha la 'bul/ a kā ros 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang gzhi bdag la phul la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/

bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang*// lha klu 'jig rten skyong ba dang*// gnod sbyin 'byung po srin po dang*// yi dwags sha za brjed byed dang*// smyo byed mkha' 'gro lus srul kun// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi bla ma dam pa dang*// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun (243)'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las bcol nas/ khyad par mchu chung ma bzhi la phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs// dbyings nas bzhengs pa'i mkha' 'gro ni// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung slad du// 'bar ba'i gdan las skur bzhengs shig /phyogs phyogs dag ni pha gi na// nyi ma nub phyogs mtshams bzhi na// gser gyi ri bdun pha rol na// lcags ri nag po'i tshu rol na// ri bo thams cad rus pa'i ri// rtsi shing thams cad mda' dang mdung*// chu bo thams cad rnags dang khrag /sa gzhi thams cad zhag dang tshil// sku mkhar thod pa'i gzhal yas khang*// sku mkhar so so'i mnga' bdag mo// shar lho'i mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong*// dga' rab dbang phyug bu mo ste// sngon mo rdo rje bum pa bsnams// lho nub mkha' 'gro stag gdong ma// laṅka mgrin bcu'i bu mo ste// ser mo me long bum pa bsnams// nub byang mkha' 'gro sprel gdong ma// dbang phyug chen po'i bu mo ste// dmar mo 'khor lo bum pa bsnams// byang shar mkha' 'gro sbyang gdong ma// 'brog gnas chen po'i bu mo ste// ljang mo ne'u le bum pa bsnams// kun kyang mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// dpung pa'i steng nas sprul pa spro// sangs rgyas stong gi dbu rgyan can// lte bar mkha' 'gro'i rdzong bcas ma// sku ni skad cig glog 'gyu ma// gsung gi nga ro 'brug ldir ma// thugs rje'i byin rlabs char 'bebs ma// don gyi sangs rgyas yin mod kyang*// sgrub pa po la brtse ba'i phyir// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i bka' byung gis// bran mo'i tshul du khas longs la// tshur gshegs bka' yi gtor ma longs// rgyan gyi gtor mas mnyes mdzod la// bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// khyad par rtsod ldan lnga bdo'i dus// sdug bsngal zhi byed bstan pa (244)ni// dar bar lung bstan dgongs mdzod la// bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzod// bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i// gdon bgegs bar chad kun zhi nas// tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan// bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzod// ces bcol lo// de nas rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/

dri'i dung zhal du bgegs mthar byed skad cig gis bskyed la/ sum+bha'i sngags bzlas nas hūm̐ zhes pas bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam zhing*/ des dbang rdzas rnams bsang la/ rang gi thugs ka nas/ 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis sbyangs pas bum pa rin po che las grub pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i dbus su hūm̐ oṃ swā am̐ hā mūm̐ la mām̐ pam̐ tām̐ las de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba can/ snod thod pa yum gyi mkha' klong du bcud rdzas rnams bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum dang*/ me long gi dkyil 'khor rdo rje gtum mo go cha'i lha mo drug dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin du mos la/ ye shes pa phaiṃ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul la/ bum par gzungs thag btags par 'jus te/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te song ba bum nang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ rigs lnga yab yum gyi byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang*/ byang chub sems de'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i thod nang gi he ru ka yab yum sbyor ba'i byang sems babs pa thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ de las kyang 'od zer dkar dmar 'phros pas me long la reg pa tsam gyis lha mo gtso 'khor bdun bde ba chen por 'bar zhing gsal ba las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis rgyud kyi pusti'i yi ge rnams sprul pa'i skur byon nas 'gro ba'i don byed par bsam zhing hūm̐ oṃ sogs rigs lnga'i sa bon bcu/ a bhi ṣe ka bde mchog gi yig bdun/ (245)gtso mo'i sngags rnams sgril nas bzlas mthar bum pa la oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes mchod yon phul/ bum thod me long dang bcas pa'i lha rnams 'od du zhu nas dbang rdzas nus ldan du gyur bar bsam mo// de nas dbang la gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon 'jug cing dbang nod pa ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul du blangs la/

gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ bu rnams khrus dang phyag byas gral du 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs dang chos bshad ci rigs sngon du btang nas/ 'dir ma rgyud bla na med pa gsang mtha'i rgyud dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs zab mo 'di la rgyud lung man ngag gsum las/ rgyud mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang*/ phag mo mngon 'byung gi nang nas bton nas dbyings kyi gtso mo rnams kyi brgyud pa gtad pa'i chos brgyad kyi nang tshan 'di ni rnam rtog ye shes su bslangs nas snang ba dbang du sdud par byed pa mkha' 'gro ma bdud rtsi bum pa'i dbang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor sbrags pa'i chos sde rje btsun dam pa rgya gar bas/ bla ma byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' dang*/ rgya sgom gnyis la gnang ba mchu bzhi sgrub thabs dang bcas khyad par du 'phags pa'i dbang 'di bskur ba la/ slob dpon gyis sngon du bya rgyu'i chos rnams grub nas/ da khyed rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ lan gnyis kyis mig bkab cing me tog gtad la/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas te thal mo sbyor la 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma rin po che/ bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pa'i lan du bla mas/ bu khyod rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i chos la mos sam/ sgrub pa nyams su len nam/ 'bras bu sems can gyi don byed par spro'am/ zhes dris pa'i len du slob mas/ (246)mos lags/ len lags/ spro lags zhes rim par gdab bo// sngon 'gro rten sdom pa gsum ldan du bya ba'i phyir so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa bzung snyam pas 'di'i= /sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor mchog kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis deng nas byang chub bar// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// thar pa 'dod phyir skyabs su mchi// sems can kun don bsgrub pa'i phyir// byang chub sems gsum bskyed par bgyi// bde gshegs rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*// bcu bzhir phye ba'i ltung ba dang*// yan lag nyes pa spang bar bgyi// lan gsum/

dngos gzhi ye shes dbang ba'i slad du bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams mkha' khyab tu sad pa la phyag gsum sngon du 'gro bas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /de nas mkhyen par gsol ba ni me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i= /kye/ bla ma rje btsun ba rnams dang*/ yi dam gyi lha tshogs dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad mkhyen par mdzod cig /bdag gi rgyud smin cing grol ba'i dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ bdag gi rgyud la phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa khyad par can ma skyes pa skye ba dang*/ skyes pa brtan pa dang*/ brtan pa mthar phyin par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams lus drang por bsrang*/ rlung kha sbyor du 'chings/ sems dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu gtod cig byas la/ slob dpon gyis oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥs bdud rtsi byin rlabs dran par byas la mtheb srin gyis blangs te bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lag mchod byas nas bdud rtsi 'thor zhing sum+bha'i sngags tshan bzhir bcad nas brjod pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa gur bla re ye shes kyi me 'bar bas mtshams bcings par bsam/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā ཿswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ (247)oṃ badz+ra shud+dhā+oḥsarba r+harmāḥbadz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes dag pa gsum gyi sngags brjod pas/ khyed rang gi lus dag pa chos 'byung bsnol ma/ ngag dag pa de'i dbus su khrag mtsho'i dkyil na pad nyi ro gdan la gnas pa'i hrīḥdamar po 'od 'phro zhing tsaṇ+ḍa'i sgra sgrog pa yongs su gyur pa las yid dag pa rdo rje gtum mo khros ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gnyis phag gdong gyen dang khro zhal thur la gzigs pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis rdo rje pad+ma/ 'og ma gnyis rin po che dang rgya gram rnams rang gi spyi mgrin snying lte'i gnas bzhir 'dzin pa/

zhabs dor stabs kyis dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa'i do shal/ phyag rgyas lngas brgyan cing zhal nas badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa'i sgra sgrog pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang srog gi gor hrīḥyig dmar po de las 'od zer hrīḥyig gi phreng ba'i rnam pa nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'phros/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la thim pas lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gsal zhing 'bar bar gyur pa'i gtso mo'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang rdo rje gtum mo'i rnam pa kha char dang bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon/ de thams cad kyis stong gsum zil gyis mnan/ khams gsum dbang du bsdud nas khyed rang rnams la sib sib thims pas sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos bdug cing cang te'u sogs rol mo'i sgra dang sbyar te/ e ma ding ri ding ri badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes mang du bzlas shing*/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa a bā+e sha ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dbab pas bde ba bzod med du 'bar bar bsam la de ka'i ngang la ma bcos par zhog cig /ces bskyong du gzhug /de nas mdun bskyed kyi gtso mo'i sku la me tog 'bul ba'i stangs kas 'di'i (248)oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ de nyid oṃ pra tī grih+ṇa i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la/ zhes bu'i spyi bor bcings/ tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa/ ces pas mig phye nas he badz+ra pā sh+ya hoḥ 'di na rje btsun rdo rje gtum mo mchu chung ma bzhi dang bcas pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas dbang bskur ba dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bcug nas/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mchog gi dngos grub thob phyir dang*// zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnams// myur du 'grub par bya ba'i phyir// bla ma mkha' 'gros dbang bskur stsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas// dbang la bzhi las// dang po bum dbang ni/

dal gyi gtso bo las sprul pa'i dbang lha rnams kyis ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs te/ khyed rang rdo rje gtum mor gsal ba'i mgo thog tu bzhag pa las ye shes lnga'i chu rgyun babs pas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rigs lnga yab yum zhu ba'i chus// phung po lnga yi sgrib pa sbyongs// nyon mongs lnga dag dbang bskur bas// lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /ces bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing bum chu blud/ de brtan phyir/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor zhing rol mo 'khrol/ dbang lha rnams kyang bu la thim par bsam mo// des lus kyi dri ma dag /lam lha sku bsgom zhing*/ nyams yul snang stong du 'char ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so// gnyis pa gsang dbang ni/ bde mchog yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang sems 'thor ba'i bdud rtsi blud pas rtsa dpa' mo/ khams dpa' bo// gnyis med byang chub kyi sems bde stong dbyer med rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di de dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams// dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste/ khams lnga ldan pas ro rtog byed// bde (249)ba gang de myang bar gyis/ a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes bdud rtsi blud/ des ngag gi dri ma dag /lam rtsa rlung sgom zhing*/ nyams sems gsal stong du 'char ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so// gsum pa sher dbang ni/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor spyi bor bzhag cing g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs nas gnas bzhir thig ler byas nas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams bstim pa'i byin rlabs kyis gtum mo zhu ba'i dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ kun gzhi me long dag pa la// tshogs drug ma 'gags gzugs brnyan shar// snang stong ma bcos ngo bor gsal// sems kyi dri ma rang sar grol// zhes me long spyi bor bzhag cing oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥzhes spyi mgrin snying lter sin+dhū ra'i thig le re byas par bla ma/

yi dam lhan skyes/ mkha' 'gro gtso mo ḍā ki bzhi bcas mchu chung ma bzhi rnams rim par bstim mo// des yid kyi dri ma dag /pho nya'i lam bsgom zhing nyams bde stong du 'char ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// bzhi pa tshig dbang ni/ khyed rang rnams lus gnad bsrang*/ rlung so mar bzhag go /sems gang shar gyi rang ngo la che re ltos la gsal bzhag med par skyongs shig byas la/ rgyud sgrub thabs dang bcas pa'i dpe lag tu gtad de ma yengs par gson cig /lta ba rnam par dag pa'i rdo rje lung ston gyi mchu bya ba lags pas/ khyod kyi chos 'di sgro 'dogs chod par slob cig /sgom pa nyams su myong ba rdo rje zhing skyong gi mchu bya ba lags pas chos 'di nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin sgrubs shig /spyod pa yul dang bsre ba srid pa'i rgyal mo'i mchu bya ba lags pas/ khyod kyi chos 'di la dka' ba dang du long zhig /'bras bu mngon du gyur pa yid bzhin nor bu'i mchu bya ba lags pas/ khyod kyis chos (250)'di la nus pa thon par mdzod cig /ces brjod cing bkra shis dang rol mo bya/ des phra ba'i sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /lam phyag rgya chen po sgom zhing nyams sems nyid rtsa bral gyi rtog pa 'char ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so// de yan chad lha sgrub pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga ste nub dang po la byas nas/ nub gnyis pa bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum dang*/ gsum par mchu chung bzhi'i bzlas lung 'bogs par bshad kyang da lta'i phyag bzhes su nub gsum pa sbrel nas dus gcig la mdzad pas/ de'i dbang du byas te dang po ma ltar bsten pa'i bzlas lung ni/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mdun bskyed kyi gtso mo rdo rje gtum mo'i thugs kar hrīḥyig dmar po la sngags kyis bskor ba'i rang sgras khams gsum dbang du bsdus/

srid gsum zil gyis mnan/ gnod byed rnams tshar bcad/ rang 'dra'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bus ma ltar byams pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsol zhing*/ khyed rang la thim pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes/ e ma ding ri ding ri badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes 'jam la ring bar bzlar gzhug /gnyis pa sring ltar bsnyen pa'i bzlas lung ni/ gtso mo'i thugs srog gis phyogs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro lag na rdor 'chang*/ gtsug na me khyer/ mtha' nas gshog sdud/ kha na khus 'debs bzhi bskul bas/ de dag las rang 'dra'i sprul pa bgrangs med pa spros pas dngos grub stsol zhing thim par mos pas gzhan sngar ltar las badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa'i tshab tu/ badz+ra ḍā ki ni ye/ rat+na ḍā/ pad+ma ḍā/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī rnams bcug pa bzla/ gsum pa grogs ltar sgrub pa'i lung ni/ mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis sngags mgrin gcig tu dir dir brjod pas/ rdo rje lung ston/ rin chen zhing (251)skyong srid pa'i dbang mo// yid bzhin nor bu rnams dang*/ bzhi snying dril ba la zhing skyong kun tu ri ka rnams sgom zhing sprul pa'i 'phro 'du byed par mos pas/ dz+nyā na sid+dhi/ sa li sid+dhi/ pa shaṃ sid+dhi/ rat+na

dpe gcig la sid+dhi/ dā na sid+dhi snang*/ bzhi snying dril ba ha ri ni sa rnams bcug nas bzla/ bzhi pa bran ltar sgrub pa dngos grub len pa las sbyor gyi lung ni/ gtso mo'i thugs srog gi 'od kyis bskul ba'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis skal ldan gyi slob bu'i zas nor 'gugs/ nad gdon bar chad thams cad bsal/ khyad par sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub thams cad thogs pa med par stsol zhing thob par mos la/ kā ya sid+dhi/ wā ka sid+dhi/ tsit+ta sid+dhi/ gu ṇa sid+dhi/ karma sid+dhi rnams sngar ltar bcug nas bzlar gzhug go /de nas long sgrub mchu chung ma bzhi'i sgrub lung ni/ gtso mo'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul bas mtshams bzhi thod pa'i sku mkhar nas mkha' 'gro phra men ma bzhi rang rang gi 'khor 'bum phrag gis bskor nas je nye je nyer byon nas las ci bgyi zhes gang bcol thogs pa med par sgrub par mos mdzod/ ces sgrub lung rnams bla mas brjod pas brda sprod cing*/ bzlas pa rnams rjes zlos byar bcug la 'di skad do// shar lho mtshams kyi las mkhan ma// lha mo'i lus la seng ge'i gdong*// dga' rab dbang phyug bu mo ste// 'khor du nag mo 'bum dang bcas// je nye je nyer byon par bsam/ e ma ding ri ding ri sidha ra ma hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lho nub mtshams kyi= /lha mo'i lus la stag gdong ma// laṅka mgrin bcu'i bu= /'khor du ser mo= /je nye= /gzhan 'dra ba las kaṃ ka pa ri/ dpe gcig la ra ti snang*// nub byang mtshams kyi= /lha mo'i lus la sprel gdong ma// dbang phyug chen mo'i= /'khor du dmar mo= /je nye= /ha na dza na hūm̐/ byang shar mtshams= lha mo'i lus la spyang ki'i gdong*// 'brog gnas chen po'i bu mo ste// 'khor du (252)sngon mo 'bum dang bcas// je nye je nyer rag ra ti// zhes bzlar gzhug go /de ltar nub dang po lha sgrub pa'i byin rlabs dbang gi chu bo bzhi/

nub gnyis pa bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sgrub lugs/ nub gsum pa la sogs sgrub bran ltar bkod pa'i bye brag mchu chung bzhi'i sgrub lung dang bcas pa rnams 'dir stan thog gcig tu dril nas bskur ba yin pas ji skad gdabs pa ltar bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pa 'di'i/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtong rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lus 'bul/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams spyi ltar dang*/ rjes chog gtong rag mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba bzod gsol rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi khyad par gyi gshegs gsol brtan bzhugs bya ba rnams phyi sgrub zhal gnyis ma ltar byas rjes bdag dang mdun bskyed kyi gtso mo dbyer med du byas la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥ'i 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i 'khor lo sbyangs/ de thams cad rim bzhin thugs srog hrīḥyig gi bar du bsdus/ de'ang 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings su thim par mos// de'i ngang las slar yang rang nyid rdo rje gtum mo'i skur langs la bsngo smon dang shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan no// dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi dbang chog bklags pas grub pa las bka' babs phyi ma dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i bla ma yi dam rnams kyi dbang chog bshad pa'i le tshan no// dar rgyas 'phel/// /oṃ swa sti/ na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ zhi byed brgyud pa phyi ma'i bka' srung chos skyong gi skor la/ dang po gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba mgon po ber nag gi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la/ yo byad bshams pa ni/ shis pa'i gnas su nyer dgu la sogs pa dus khyad par can la/ rgyas par dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs sam/ bsdu na rdo ra me ris zlum por bskor ba'i dbus chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag rtse mo mdun bstan/ zla gam (253)dmar po dur khrod kyi mtshan ma bkod pa'i phyir mu khyud thod phreng dkar po gru gsum gyi dbus su mgon po lcam dral gsum dang gtso bo'i mdun du las bdag pho mo'i mtshan ma 'god/

der mañji'i steng du bum pa chas ldan bcud kyis gtams pa dang*/ mdun du dpal gtor gyi gris ha cang mi rno ba la rtser tsakli dang mda' dar gyis brgyan pa la/ 'khor g.yas g.yon du gru gsum re/ mdun du gru gsum chung ba gnyis dang mtheb kyus bskor ba/ rgyab tu 'bul gtor dang sman raka /gzhan yang mig dar dang me tog sngon po/ mgon po'i sku/ ā li kā li'i sngags byang*/ bing*/ par bu khrag gis gang ba/ thub pa'i sku/ mkhar gsil/ lhung bzed/ snam sbyar/ gding ba/ thod pa/ gri snying sogs las sbyor la dgos pa'i rdzas ci 'byor bsags la ci bder bsgrig /mtha' mchod pas bskor zhing zur bzhir bing*/ gri snying dang dar snas brgyan pa re 'dzug pa'ang bri/ steng na dar nag gi gur phub/ slob dpon gyi mdun du las bum/ ḍā dril sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshang bar 'du bya'o// de nas sgrub mchod la thog mar bdag bskyed ni/ tshogs zhing rnams mkha' khyab tu sad par mos la/ na mo// bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lhar// dad pa'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad la// yid kyis sprul te mchod pa 'bul// bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa// de dag thams cad so sor bshags// sems can don mdzad rgyal sras gang*// de dag kun la rjes yi rang rangs// ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar// mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// mgon po thugs rje che ldan rnams// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// 'gro kun bsags pa'i dge ba gang*// byang chub tu ni bdag gis bsngo// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun (254)la// thar pa 'dod phyir skyabs su mchi// sems can don kun sgrub pa'i phyir// byang chub sems gsum bskyed par bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod la tshogs zhing rnams rang la bstim mo// de nas swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis gzung 'dzin gyi dngos po thams cad 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las pad zla nyi ma'i gdan steng rang sems hūm̐ yig sngon po 'phro 'du zhu ba las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsgrubs/ tshur 'dus 'od du zhu ba las/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas bdag nyid rdo rje gtum po mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje bsdigs pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub rngams pa'i tshul can/ dar gyi cod pan dang sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na g.yon brkyang ba'i dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs la/ a ti pū hoḥ/ pra ti tsa ho zhes pas phyag byas/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas// bcom ldan rdo rje gtum po ni// yon tan thams cad sku la rdzogs// skyon med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig sngon po bzla bya'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba rnams mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rang la thim pas snang grag 'gyu gsum lha sngags 'od gsal gyi 'khor lo dag par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas mthar rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis reg pas (255)snod bcud 'od du zhu nas thugs srog hūm̐ gi bar bsdus/ de'ang gyen rdzogs mi dmigs pa'i dbyings su thim par bsam/ de'i ngang las oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bdag nyid rdo rje gtum po'i skur gyur/ de nas oṃ badz+ra sarba bigh+nan nā sha ya nā sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas rang gi thugs ka nas mtshon cha rnon po'i sprin las 'bar ba'i me 'od tsha zhing rtsub pa spros/

dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad bsdigs bskrad brlag par byas/ tshur 'dus rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me 'bar bas phyogs kun gtams te ni sa kyang mi shigs par gyur/ mchod rdzas brlab pa ni/ bdag gi thugs ka nas raṃ yaṃ khaṃ spros mchod rdzas kyi dngos 'dzin nyes skyon thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che dang pad+ma 'bar ba'i snod du hūm̐ las phyi nang gi nyer spyod thams cad so so'i mtshan nyid rdzogs pa nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar brjod/ a las snod ka pā lar bcud sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a las 'dab brgyad rin po che'i pad phor stong gsum khyab pa'i nang du 'bru gsum zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes pa'i gter du gyur/ oṃ ba liṃ ta ma hā ba ling+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a las dmar gyi dung chen du ra yig zhu ba las byung ba'i chags med rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags rnams bdun nam gsum re brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdun rten swa bhā was bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung zhing skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas su dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i nang gru gsum mthing nag 'bar (256)ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan steng du hūm̐ las tsan+dan gyi beng chen hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yang yongs su gyur pa las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po a gho ra sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas tsan+dan gyi bing chen dang*/ g.yon khrag gis gang ba'i par bu dku la brten pa/ spyan gsum sdang mig tu blta ba/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma 'bar zhing*/ ral pa kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/ sku la dar nag sngo khra'i 'jol ber gsol zhing gser sked bcings pa/ thod sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ sag ti'i l+h+wam yu ring gsol nas g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis mi ro'i steng na 'gying zhing brjid pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ mthing nag las raṃ chad pa de yongs su gyur pa las g.yas su bdud po legs ldan nag po dar nag gi ber can ral pa nag po rgyab tu gtibs pa/ g.yas mdung dar ru mtshon 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dgra snying za ba/ stag ral dang gzig shubs btags shing rta nag rting dkar la chibs pa/ g.yon du bh+yo chad pa las re ma tī sngo skya g.yas khram shing dang g.yon nad rkyal thogs pa/ ma mo'i chas can drel rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ gtso mo'i mdun du trag yig re re chad pa las pho nya las bdag pho mo gnyis ka khrag mdog bswe'i lan phran can sprin dmar gyi g.yang gzhi gyon cing srin po'i snying dron mo za ba/ gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul pho nya las byed dregs pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas mgon po 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ha stas g.yab cing rol mo dang bcas pas (257)hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs ma hā kā la che// dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bdag gi las bcol sgrub par mdzod/ oṃ ma hā kā la rak+ṣa du bing ni dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas spyan drangs shing bstim la/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ ma hā kā la a ti pū hoḥpra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes phyag 'tshal/

hūm̐/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te// dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol// oṃ ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā his bdud rtsi/ ma hā rak+ta khā his khrag skyems bran/ gtor ma oṃ ma hā kā la du bing ni dzaḥs pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul la/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i klong dkyil nas// yang dag gsang ba'i sku gcig byung ba ni// mthing nag mi srun 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i sku// nyid kyi sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa la// dbu skra kham nag ral pa gyen du 'khyil// smin ma dmar ser khro gnyer brjid pa'i zhal// spyan ldog zhal bgrad rno gdug mche ba gtsigs// sdang ba'i dgra bgegs ma lus srog rtsa gcod// phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel// g.yas kyi phyag na tsan+dan bing chen bsnams// gsor zhing dgra bgegs klad pa'i rgyas su brdeg /g.yon gyi phyag na bar bu dku la brten// dam nyams dgra bo kun gyi snying khrag gsol// sku la dar nag sngo khra'i 'jol ber gsol// gser ska rin chen 'bar ba sked la bcings// zhabs la sag ti'i za 'og 'bol can gsol// ma hā kā la'i tshogs ni sprin ltar gtibs// dam nyams dgra (258)bgegs ma lus rtsa ba nas gcod// dpal mgon nag po chen po khyod la bstod// thugs dam brgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// gzhan gyis mi thub legs ldan nag po che// lha mo gshin rje'i lcam gcig bdud kyi yum// las kyi gnod sbyin pho mo srog dbugs bdag /'khor tshogs dregs pa'i dpung dang bcas la bstod// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// ces bstod nas/

mgon po'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ mthing nag bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba la bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te bka' nod cing phrin las sgrub par bsam la/ oṃ ma hā kā la du bing ni dzaḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ru pa hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtso sngags so// oṃ ma hā kā la trak+sha dam ma ru tsi hūm̐/ las mgon/ oṃ ma ma ru ru tsi rak+mo tsa le tsa la bh+yoḥ re ma tī'o// traka rak+ṣa ya/ snying kha la rak+ṣa ya/ badz+ra dun rbad/ du bing dzaḥdzaḥ snying kha la ya rak+ṣa le dzaḥdzaḥ thun ya dzaḥdzaḥ mok+sha dgra bo dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ rak+ṣa tsit+ta sham lod/ snying kha la ma rak+ṣa ya/ a mu ka thum ri li li/ rbad phaṭa sod mā ra ya phaṭa/ dgra bo'i sha la yaṃ yaṃ/ dgra bo'i snying la rgyug /ces pa las bdag pho mo'i srog snying ngo*// de ltar gtso 'khor gyi 'gros sbyar nas ci nus bzla'o// de nas las bum du/ bgegs mthar byed ljang nag rgya gram dang dril bu 'dzin pa skad cig gis gsal bar bsam la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas nas hūm̐ zhes pas bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam zhing*/ des rnam bum bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dbus su pad nyi'i gdan steng hūm̐ las beng chen hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer spro bsdus (259)dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po/ de'i thugs ka nas raṃ dang bh+yo spros pa las g.yas g.yon du legs ldan dang re ma tī mdun du trag yig las pho nya las bdag pho mo rnams skad cig gis gsal ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ma hā kā la du bing ni dza:dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs spyan drangs shing bstim/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ a ti pu hoḥpra tī tsa hoḥs bzhugs su gsol zhing phyag bya/

oṃ ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā his mchod/ hūm̐/ lha min gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul bzlog cing*// stobs ldan lha dbang dkar po 'bum dang bcas// bgegs 'dul dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas la// dad pa'i sems kyis bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags phreng gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas thugs dam bskul/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam la/ gzungs thag la 'jus te/ kā la du bing dang*/ kā la rū pa/ a bhi ṣe ka ta rnams ci rigs bzlas nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul bas lha 'od du zhu bas bum chu nus ldan du bsam mo// de nas dbang la gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon 'jug cing dbang nod cho ga rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas blang bar bya'o// gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma rnams khrus dang phyag byas/ gos nag po gyon nas gral du 'khod pa la/ bgegs bskrad sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ 'dir rang cag rnams kyi rten phun sum tshogs pa'i mi lus rin po che thob pa'i dus 'dir dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa zhig bsgrub dgos so// de sgrub pa la 'gal rkyen bar chad bsal zhing mthun rkyen yid bzhin du sgrub par nus pa'i srung ma mthu ldan zhig la brten pa gal che/ de yang (260)'jig rten pa'i lhas ni gnas skabs su phrin las phra mo 'grub tu srid kyang mthar thug logs pa'i lam la sbyor zhing 'khu ldog phra mo tsam la yang lus srog la bar du gcod pa sogs nyes dmigs che zhing phan yon chung bas blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma khyad par can zhig brten dgos/ de la'ang dpal chen po nyid gang 'dul gyi gnyen por rgyud gsum dregs pa'i rnam par bzhengs pa'i rgyud sgrub thabs phrin las kyi rim pa ji snyed cig mchis pa las/

'dir chu klung chen po'i rgyud las/ lha chen ma hā kā la khyod la gtad/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ dam pa'i chos sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi bka' srung dpal ye shes kyi mgon po a gho ra nyid gsang ba par nag can du sgrub pa'i dbang gi bka' gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba shin tu zab cing gnyen pa 'di sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du song*/ de slob ma'i ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas slob dpon gsang ba'i bdag po dang gnyis su med pa la pus btsugs thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*// dpal chen ye shes mgon po la// gus pa mchog gis skyabs mchi yis// bdag la dbang bskur bka' drin skyongs// ces lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams ye shes kyi mgon por skad cig gi gsal bar mos la chas su gzhug pa ni/ bu la bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ lan gnyis kyis mig dar sngon po bkab cing me tog sngon po gtad/ bu'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ yig rnams kyis mtshan par bsam/ de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir mdun gyi nam mkhar tshogs zhing sad par mos la 'di'i rjes/ na mo bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha// zhes pa nas/ byang chub sems gsum bskyed par bgyi/ (261)zhes pa'i bar lan gsum/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bzung snyam pas 'di'i/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig ni// bde gshegs rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*// bcu bzhir phye ba'i ltung ba dang*// yan lag nyes pa spang bar bgyi// lan gsum/ snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gnas par bsam la 'di'i/ oṃ yo ga tsit+ta ud pā tā ya mi/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje snying gar bzhag la su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+wam/

bo dhi tsit+ta ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes rnal 'byor du sems bskyed/ de nas hūm̐ dzaḥzhes las kyi rdo rjes khrid de dkyil 'khor du bcug nas shar phyogs su 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje snying gar/ mgon po nag po deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs gyur pas// tshul 'di gzhan la smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// mna' chu blud pa ni/ bdud rtsi byin la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya u da ka hūm̐/ de nas nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa'i slad du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas lus kyi gnad tsog pur 'dug la/ rgal tshigs bsrang*/ thal mo spyi bor sbyor/ ngag rlung kha sbyor du 'ching*/ sems kyi gnad khyed rang gi lus mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi ro'i gdan la sems nyid hūm̐ las bing chen hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las mgon po nag po chen po mthing nag bing dang khrag gis gang ba'i lcags par bsnams pa/ dar nag gi ber dang gser sked sak+ti'i l+h+wam gsol zhing thod sprul dang*/ (262)rin po ches brgyan pa/ gtum zhing mi bsrun pa'i nyams can g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs par bsgoms mdzod/ bla ma la gus 'dud drag po byas pas bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpal ye shes kyi mgon po lcam dral gsum las bdag pho mo dang bcas pa'i rnam par kha char dang bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas khyed rang la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sha chen gyi spos bdug cing rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra sbyar te/ oṃ a gho ra ma hā kā la du bing dzaḥ.ā we sha ya a a zhes drag tu brjod pas dbab/

de brtan phyir me tog 'thor la tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brtan par bya/ de nas ye shes kyi mgon po'i dbu la me tog phul bar mos la 'di'i/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes dor/ slar yang me tog de rang gi spyi bor bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes spyi bor bkod/ tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa ces pas mig dar bsal la/ he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ 'di na dpal ye shes kyi mgon po a gho ra par bu nag po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhugs pa la mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur snyam pa mdzod/ des 'jug pa'i chos rnams song*/ dbang dngos la bzhi las/ dang po bum dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i/ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung byed pa'i// dpal chen mgon po chen po yi// drag cing gsang ba'i dbang mchog de// de ring bdag gis thob par mdzod// lan gsum/ de nas bla ma la mos gus dung pa byas pas thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang gi lus la phog /sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang nang chos 'byung mthing nag gi lte bar pad nyi ro'i gdan la hūm̐ las bing chen hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang dpal ye (263)shes kyi mgon po a gho ra mthing nag dar nag gi ber can bing dang lcags par 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi mgon po spyan drangs khyed rang la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ma hā kā la du beng ni dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes rol mo bya/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa ma dzaḥs spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā la sha a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā la a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes bum chu spyi bo nas gtigs shing blud pas dbang bskur/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag /chu zhabs 'khyil ba las spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi gtso ba'i sku las mgon po gnyis pa spros te khyed rang gi dpal bar thim pas mgon po'i sku'i mthu stobs dang nus pa'i byin rlabs thams cad zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ mgon po'i lha tsaka spyi bor bzhag la/ nag po chen po'i phyag rgya 'di// bu yis dus rnams thams cad du// kun tu ma 'bral sgom par gyis// las rnams kun la thogs pa med// oṃ ma hā kā lā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes bskur/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i mgrin pa nas ā li kā li'i yi ge byung khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas gsung gi mthu nus byin rlabs thams cad zhugs par mos la/ dbyangs gsal bris pa'i sngags byang mgrin par bzhag la/ brjod med grags stong sngags 'di yis// mgon po gnas nas spyan 'dren pa// bu yis dus rnams thams (264)cad du// gus pa'i ngag gis bzla bar gyis// oṃ ma hā kā la wā ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ yig sogs 'khor dang bcas pa las sngags phreng thon/ slob ma'i khar zhugs snying gar nyi steng hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa'i mthar g.yas bskor du 'khod pa'i mos pas 'di'i/ oṃ ma hā ka la du beng ni dzaḥ oṃ shrī kā la rū pa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa tsam mo// slob ma khyad par ba la 'khor sngags rnams kyang byin te/ re re nas lan gsum re bzlar gzhug /slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du// bcom ldan bdag gis bzung sogs dang*/

me tog bu yi spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs kyi byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas phyag mtshan beng chen byung ba khyed rang gi snying gar thim pas thugs kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad rgyud la zhugs par mos la/ lag g.yas par be con gtad de/ be con rab tu 'bar ba 'dis// ma rungs pa rnams btul nas kyang*// gnyis med thugs su sbyor byed pa'i// thugs mchog phyag rgyas dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma hā kā la du bing tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ gtso bo'i lte ba nas par bu byung ba khyed rang gi lte bar thim pas yon tan gyi nus mthu thams cad thob par bsam la/ par bu khrag gis gang ba g.yon par gtad de/ bdud kyi khrag gis gang ba'i snod// dngos grub mchog gi 'byung ba'i gnas// de ring bu yis gzung bar gyis// yon tan thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur// oṃ ma hā kā la ka pā la s+ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ de nas phrin las kyi dbang ni/ slob bu 'ding ba'i steng bzhag la snam sbyar bkon/ lag g.yas su mkhar gsil dang*/ g.yon du par bu thod pa/ gri snying rnams gtad/ mgo thog tu thub dbang gi sku bzhag la/ mdun bskyed (265)gtso bo'i gsang gnas nas 'od zer ljang nag gi rtse nas las bdag pho mo grangs med byung khyed rang gi gsang bar thim pas drag po mngon spyod kyi las la thogs pa med pa'i nus pa thob par bsam la/ thub pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// drag po las kyang cher drag pa// las mtha' nag po'i sbyor ba yi// bka' yi gnang ba khyod la byin// oṃ ma hā kā la karma a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur te/ dbang 'di thob phan chad mgon po dang las bdag pho mo'i rgyud sgrub thabs las sbyor gyi man ngag rnams la ci dgar spyod pa'i dbang thob pa yin no// mtha' rten gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ni gtor ma dpal 'bar btsugs pa slob bu'i spyi bor bzhag la/

'o gtor ma 'di mgon po 'khor bcas su gsal ba la mos gus dung pa byas pas khyod rang gi spyi bor byon/ slob dpon gyis bka' bsgos pa'i tshe rigs kyi bu khyod kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad bsrung ba dang*/ mthun rkyen phrin las rnam pa bzhings bsgrub bo zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la spos bsreg cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas stong gi bka' yis ni// srung ma chen por zhal bzhes pa// dpal ldan mgon po chen po yis// bdag gi slob ma 'di srungs shig /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po a gho ra 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ longs sku lha mo bdag med ma/ sprul sku ye shes mgon po/ rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas/ skye med byang sems kun dga'/ mkhas btsun spa tshab sgom pa/ grub thob rgyal ba te ne/ chos rgyal nyi seng sku mched/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams dpal/ rgyal sras kun dga' sku mched/ rgya smon lam shes rab/ kun mkhyen sku mched/ rdo rje gdan pa/ rgya mtsho sbyin pa/ bde chen lhun grub/ nam mkha' bzang po/ dpal (266)'byor lhun grub/ dpal 'byor phun tshogs/ bkra shis bzang ngo*// mkhan chen blo gros brtan pa ste rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rigs kyi bu 'di yi srung ma mdzod la lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs te/ 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing mthun rkyen bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi thogs med du sgrub pa sogs mdor na 'di nyid khyod kyis bsrung ba dang skyob pa dang thugs rjes bzung bar mdzod du gsol/ oṃ ma hā kā la du bing ni dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes bka' bsgos pas gtor ma'i lha 'od du zhu nas slob ma la thim par bsam zhing su pra tiṣ+ṭha brjod cing me tog gi char dbab pa// des bum pa'i dbang thob/

lus sgrib dag /sprul sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// gnyis pa gsang dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs las byung ba yi// bzhi grub bde ba chen po'i sku// gsang ba ye shes bdag la stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā la gu h+ye a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ zhes lan gsum/ ma ye shes kyi mgon po yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang sems thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pa lce thog tu byin par mos la/ dbang bskur chen po rdo rje ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pas// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ oṃ ma hā kā la bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi blud cing*/ des kyang a ho ma hā su kha zhes myong bas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gags nas sems gsal stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes par gyur/ des gsang dbang thob/ ngag sgrib dag /longs sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so// gsum pa sher dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba*/ (267)gdab pa 'di'i rjes= /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs las byung ba yi// gsang chen mchog gi dam tshig ni// bla na med pa bdag la stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā la pra dz+nyā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ lan gsum/ phyag rgya ma gzugs dang lang tshos brgyan pa yum du gsal ba gtad par mos la/ gzungs ma yid 'ong mtshan ldan 'di// brten par sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsungs// 'khor lo'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis// bde ba dag ni myang bar gyis// de nas slob ma mgon po dang rig ma yum re ma tī gsal ba'i mkha' gsang rdo rje pad+mar byin gyis brlabs nas snyoms par zhugs pas yas 'bab mas 'jog gi dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes brtan par mos la lag 'khyud rgya dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes/ a nu rā ga tā swa bhā wa badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ/

des sher dbang thob/ yid sgrib dag /chos sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so// bzhi pa tshig dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i= khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bos dbang bskur rnam gsum byin// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// thugs kyi gter gyis bdag la stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā la ta tā a bhi ṣiñca tu mam̐/ zhes lan gsum/ sems dus gsum gyi rtog pa spangs nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lhan skyes de kho na nyid kyi ngang la rtsen gyis zhog cig /dus gsum rtog pa'i tshogs spangs nas// yid byed bral ba'i ngang la zhog /rnal 'byor sgom pa bla na med// ye shes sku nyid 'grub par 'gyur// zhes ngo sprad/ des dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum phra ba'i dri ma dag /ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so// de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyis dam tshig khas blangs/ bka' drin gtong rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te (268)sogs kyis lus dbul dge ba bsngo ba rnams bya'o// de nas rjes chog ni/ spro na bskang bshags dang tshogs mchod bya ba'am/ ma byas kyang rung ste/ gtor mar dmigs bya 'gug cing bdud rtsir brlabs nas/ rtsa sngags gtor sngags btags pas bsngos la/ hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la ye/ zhes sogs sam/ yang na/ dpal mgon lcam dral 'khor bcas kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar lta bus gtor ma gtsang sar 'bul/ gtong rag gi mchod bstod byas la yig brgya dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ ras bris sam min na'ang ye shes pa sku rten tsakli la bstim nas brtan bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan no// 'di ni gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'i dbang yin pas/

chos rgyud la sel yod pa dang chos sgor ma zhugs pa'i khyim pa sogs la lta ci smos/ thun mong ma yin pa'i slob ma grangs bcad re re gnyis gnyis ma gtogs khyab brdal du mi gnang ba phyag len no// dar rgyas 'phel/ shu bhaṃ/// /oṃ swa sti/ ye shes kyi mgon po a gho ra'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas stegs bu khrag chang gis chag chag btab pa la dkyil 'khor dbus gru gsum mthing nag gi phyir zla gam gsum thod skam gyi phreng ba rdo rwa me ri dang bcas pas zlum por bskor ba'i lte bar lcam dral gsum dang stong brgyad kyi lha mtshan 'god/ de'i dbus su mañji'i khar bshos bu gru gsum gri gras ha cang mi rno ba'i rtser gri snying lha tsaka dar nag gi ba dan 'dzug par bshad kyang*/ phyag len gri snying 'dogs par mi mdzad/ 'khor g.yas g.yon du gru gsum re dang*/ mthar bshos phran (269)brgyad mtheb kyu dang bcas pas bskor ba bkod/ mdun rgyab gang rigs su mchod gtor sman raka /mtha' mchod pas bskor/ nang mchod ḍā dril me tog sogs tshogs par bshams la/ bdag bskyed ni/ phyag bzhes su bde mchog lhan skyes mdzad pa ltar na skyabs sems nas bzlas pa'i bar dam pa phyi nang gsum gyi bdag bskyed du bkod pa ltar bya ba'am/ yang na phyag rdor gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar par nag gi dbang chog tu bshad ma thag pa ltar bya/ mdun bskyed ni/ nyer spyod sman gtor rak+ta rnams bar nag ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ dkyil 'khor gtor ma dang bcas pa/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du ka liṅka'i dur khrod chen po 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i nang du pad zla mi ro'i gdan la hūm̐ las tsan+dan gyi bing hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ a gho ra ma hā kā la du re swā hā hūm̐ hūm̐/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po a gho ra sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas tsan dan gyi bing chen dang*/

g.yon thod khrag sku la brten pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs smar smin ma 'bar zhing*/ ral pa khams nag gyen du brdzes pa dar nag gi 'jol ber gsol zhing gser sked bcings pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal/ sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ zangs kyi l+h+wam yu ring gsol nas g.yon brkyang gis me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ dang bh+yo spros pa las/ oṃ ma hā kā la rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa g.yas su hūm̐ las legs ldan nag po g.yas tsan dan gyi bing 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag gtso bo la stob pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo dang mthun pa/ oṃ ma ma ru ru tse rak+mo tsa le tsa le bh+yo/ g.yon du bh+yo las dpal ldan lha mo sngo skya bong bu gwa dmar la zhon pa/ g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod (270)khrag thugs kar bsnams pa/ ma mo'i chas kyis brgyan pa'o// de'i phyi bskor du shar nas g.yas bskor gyis gtum chen shal rngams pa'i srin po stong*/ srid gsum khrag mtsho 'thung ba'i ma mo stong*/ dus bzhi srang la rgyu ba'i gza' bdud stong*/ las su rgyu zhags 'phen pa'i btsan dmar stong*/ skye 'gro'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i ging chen stong*/ bden rdzun shan stangs 'gyed pa'i rmu rgod stong*/ snang srid g.yab mos 'debs pa'i bdud rigs stong*/ mthun pa gnyis su 'byed pa'i gshin rje stong*/ de dag gi phyi rol du pho nya las byed dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis dgra bgegs bkug /oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ka la rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ rak+mo tsa le bh+yo/ zhes brjod pas de thams cad bsdigs bskrad brlag par byas/ oṃ sum+bha sogs brjod pas rdo rje'i rang bzhin ye shes kyi me 'bar bas phyogs kun gtams te cis kyang mi shigs par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ka liṅka'i dur khrod sogs rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mgon po 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

hasta g.yab cing spos rol dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs dpal ldan mgon po'i tshogs/ 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir gshegs shig /'bar ba'i skur ston mchod pa bzhes// oṃ a gho ra ma hā kā la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes spyan drangs shing bzhugs pa la/ oṃ ma hā kā la a ti pu hoḥ pra tī dzaḥhoḥs phyag bya/ oṃ a gho ra ma hā kā la badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ ma hā pañca a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ mchod gtor la rak+ta sbreng zhing ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyi 'od zer gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar bsam la/ hūm̐/ dbus kyi gnas mchog dam pa nas// khyod dang mthun pa'i (271)dam rdzas ni// 'dab brgyad rin chen pad phor du// dam rdzas gtor ma mi zad pa// mthun dgur sbyar ba'i dam rdzas dang*// dgyes dgur sbyar ba'i zhal zas tshogs// dpal mgon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig /oṃ a gho ra ma hā kā la ma hā māṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes gtor sngags bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa lan gsum la sogs pas gtor ma phul la/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dur khrod chen po ka liṅka yi dbus// 'od phung bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong*// nyi zla pad+ma mi ro'i gdan steng du// hūm̐ las skyes pa'i dpal ldan mgon po ni// shin tu mi bzad ma hā kā la'i sku// zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdog nag 'jigs pa'i tshul// dar nag ber gsol gser ska sked la bcings// dbu skra khams nag srid gsum gyen la brdzes// zhal gyi khro gnyer spyan gsum glog ltar 'khyug /shangs nas hūm̐ 'byin zhal nas phaṭa sgrog cing*// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs// g.yas g.yon phyag na beng dang thod khrag bsnams// sbrul dang thod rlon phreng ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan// dpal ldan mgon po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rgyu skar dpal gyi rol pa'i gnas mchog dang*// ka liṅka li dur khrod chen po sogs// rab 'jigs gnas nas bstan pa skyong mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan nag po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// mgon po'i lcam gcig dpal ldan bong zhon ma// nag po'i gzugs la rngam pa'i cha lugs can// zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri thod khrag 'dzin// dpal ldan lha mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// mgon po'i bka' 'khor 'jig rten dregs pa brgyad// sems can kun gyi srog 'phrog zhe sdang can// drag tu bskul na 'jig rten stongs par byed// stong brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/

(272)zhes bstod nas/ mgon po'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ mthing nag bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba la/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te bka' nod cing phrin las sgrub par bsam/ oṃ a gho ra ma hā kā la du re swā hā hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes gtso bo'o// oṃ ma hā kā la rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ las mgon/ oṃ ma ma ru ru rak+mo ca li tsa le bh+yo/ lha mo'o// de gsum lcam dral gyi bsnyen sngags te de tsam mo// mgon po'i sgrub sngags dang las sngags kyang bzla bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma hā kā la/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ che ge mo mā ra ya dzī bi taṃ/ ha ra ha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces sgrub sngags so// rak+sha rak+sha ma hā rak+sha ka la rak+sha/ tsit+ta rak+sha/ le le/ dha ra dha ra/ ghi la ya/ ghi la ya/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces las sngags so// hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas kyis// dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes shig /bdag la thugs rjes brtser dgongs la// rtag par bsrung zhing skyob par mdzod// ces phrin las bcol lo// de nas rjes gnang dngos ni/ slob ma rnams khrus dang phyag byas gral la 'khod pa na bgegs bskrad/ sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ de yang rang cag rnams kyis rnyed dka'i rten dal 'byor gyi chos phun sum tshogs pa'i mi lus rin po che thob pa'i dus 'dir/ dal 'byor la snying po len pa'i thabs dam pa'i chos la bslab dgos shing*/ chos sgrub pa la 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen sgrub nus pa'i chos skyong mthu ldan re brten pa gal che/ de la chos skyong ba'i srung ma khyad par can 'di ni dri med khro rgyud las/ dge slong shākya seṅge yi// bstan pa 'di dang sangs rgyas stong*// bskal chen gcig tu bstan pa bsrung*// de yi 'og tu rang cag kun// thal ba can gyi zhing khams su// thal ba'i dbang por sangs rgyas smon// zhes 'byung (273)ba ltar spyir sangs rgyas stong dang*/

sgos ston pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa dang*/ yang dgos chu klung chen po las/ lha chen ma hā kā la khyod la gtad/ ces rgyud kyi srung mar bskos pa ltar rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chos sdug bsngal zhi byed bka' babs bka' srung 'gran zla dang bral ba 'di'i byin rlabs rjes gnang gi bka' brgyud pa snga phyi bar gsum chu bo gcig 'dus kyi tshul du sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du song nas/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas slob dpon lhag pa'i lha dang gnyis su med pa la ye shes kyi mgon po a gho ra'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i slad du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// phrin las gcig tu 'dus pa po// gang gi mtshan ni a gho ra// stobs chen khro bo chen po yi// sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur stsol// zhes lan gsum/ de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir tshogs zhing khyad par can gyi spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa rnam dag phul ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i/ na mo dkon mchog yi dam lhar// dang ba'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad la// yid kyis sprul te mchod pa 'bul// bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa// de dag thams cad so sor bshags// sems can don mdzad rgyal sras gang*// de dag kun la rjes yi rangs// ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar// mya ngan mi 'dar gsol ba 'debs// mgon po thugs rje che ldan rnams// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// 'gro kun bsags pa'i dge ba gang*// byang chub tu ni bdag gis bsngo/ zhes lan gsum bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis skyabs gnas re sa bla ma dkon mchog la zhu snyam pa dang*/ gzhan don du smon 'jug don dam pa'i sems gsum deng nas bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// thar pa 'dod phyir skyabs su mchi// (274)sems can kun don sgrub pa'i phyir// byang chub sems gsum bskyed par bgyi// zhes lan gsum/

de nas dkyil 'khor du gzhug cing lha ngo bstan pa'i dod mdun bskyed kyi mgon po 'khor bcas slob ma'i blo yul du gsal 'debs pa yin te/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar ka liṅka'i dur khrod kyi dbus gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba pad zla nyi ma ro'i gdan la dpal ye shes kyi mgon po a gho ra sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis tsan dan gyi bing dang thod khrag bsnams pa/ dar nag gi ber dang gser sked zangs kyi l+h+wam gsol zhing thod sbrul rin po ches brgyan pa g.yon brkyang gis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i g.yas su legs ldan nag po beng 'phyar zhing thod khrag gtso bo la stobs pa rgyan cha lugs gtso bo lta bu/ g.yon du dpal ldan lha mo sngo skya ral gri dang thod khrag bsnams pa ma mo'i chas can bong bu gwa dmar la zhon pa/ de dag gi phyi rol shar nas g.yas bskor du srin po/ ma mo/ gza' bdud/ btsan dmar/ ging chen rmu rgod/ bdud rigs/ gshin rje re re la'ang stong stong sogs dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'o// de nas byin rlabs kyi gzhi bca' ba'i slad du bla ma mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo dang dbyer med du bltas la mos gus dung ba byas pas thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rang la phog /sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla nyi ma ro'i gdan la khyod rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ las tsan+dan gyi bing chen hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po a gho ra zhes pa nas g.yon brkyang gis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar bshad ma thag pa ltar las/ rang dang mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan (275)par gyur/ de nas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dngos ni/

slob dpon gyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ de las ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku dpag tu med pa kha char dang bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas khyed rang gi dpral ba'i oṃ la thim pas sku'i byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ gtor snod rnam dag chos kyi dbyings// gtor ma ye shes bdud rtsi lnga// skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas// sku'i dbang mchog thob par shog /snying po'i mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes rol mo bya/ des ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku'i byin rlabs thob pa yin no// yang slob dpon gyi mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ de las ye shes kyi mgon po'i gsung sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams sngags sgra sgrog bzhin du byon nas khyod rang gi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim pas gsung gi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma mgrin par 'jog cing*/ gtor snod rnam dag= /gtor ma= /skal ldan gsung gi dbang mchog= /snying po'i mthar wā ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ rol mo bya/ des ye shes kyi mgon po'i gsung gi byin rlabs thob pa yin no// yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de las ye shes kyi mgon po'i thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa byung khyed rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma snying gar 'jog cing*/ gtor snod= /gtor ma= /skal= /thugs kyi dbang mchog thob par shog /snying po'i mthar tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ rol mo bya/ des ye shes kyi mgon po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa yin no// de nas sngags gtad pa'i rjes gnang ngam bzlas lung ni/ slob dpon mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo ye shes mgon po dang dbyer med du gyur (276)pa'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng gis bskor ba las sngags kyi phreng ba slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/

khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying gar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ yig gnas pa'i mthar spar btab pa bzhin 'khod pas mgon po'i gsung sngags kyi byin rlabs kyis brgyud rlan bar gyur snyam pas 'di'i/ bsnyen sngags tsam mam/ slob ma khyad par can la bsnyen sgrub las gsum ka'i sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byed du bcug /de nas slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i/ mgon pos bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po a gho ras bdag skye ba 'di dang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen thams cad sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis me tog de bzung la/ mgon pos 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po a gho ras bdag gi slob ma 'di rnams skye ba 'di dang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad bsrung zhing*/ mthun rkyen thams cad sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ces brjod cing slob ma'i spyi bor me tog gtor/ de nas dam tshig khas blangs pa dang*// gtong rag gi maṇ+ḍal lus dbul dge ba bsngo ba rnams dang*/ rjes chog rnams par nag gi dbang ltar sbyar tshul 'gros shes par bya'o// shu bhaṃ/// /oṃ swa sti/ zhing skyes mkha' 'gro kun tu ri ka'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab bzhi la bam̐ ha ri ni sa'i sa bon nam phyag mtshan lta bu lha mtshan dgod/ de'i steng du mañji'i khar dkar gtor rtsa zlum stod gshog pa gsum rtse mo ha cang mi rno ba la rang 'dra'i 'khor bzhis bskor ba la so so'i tsa ka li 'dzugs (277)shing gtso bor dar dkar gyi gdugs phub mtha' mchod pas bskor/ ḍā dril nang mchod me tog sogs tshogs par bshams la/ bdag med ma'am rdo rje gtum mo gtso rkyang lta bu yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/

mchod gtor rnams ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las mchod snod yangs shing rgya che bar āḥlas mchod rdzas rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsi hūm̐ gis mkha' khyab tu spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlab/ mdun bskyed ni/ dkyil 'khor dang gtor ma swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun du gtor rdzas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang ba'i steng gi nam mkhar pad+ma dang zla ba seng ge dkar mo'i steng du bam̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las zhing skyes kun tu ri ka sku mdog dkar mo 'od 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gser gyi rdo rje dang*/ g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dpag bsam ljon pa'i kha rgyan can bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che dang shing los brgyan pa gshog pa dkar po cung zad bab ste brkyang ba pus steng na nyi zla 'char ba'i skur gyur/ de'i phyi rol pad+ma 'dab bzhi la/ shar du lag na rdor 'chang dkar mo rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub zhabs g.yas brkyang*/ lhor gtsug na me khyer ser mo spyi bor me dpung 'dzin pa zhabs g.yon brkyang*/ nub tu mtha' na gshog sdud dmar mo phyag gnyis brkyang ba'i rgyab na gshog pa cung zad phab pa zhabs sa ga'i stabs/ byang du kha nas khus 'debs ljang gu dung 'bud pa zhabs zlum po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// gtso 'khor thams cad kyi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum dang gtso mo'i lte bar bam̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing spos bsreg /(278)rol mo 'khrol zhing*/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig rang rang gnas nas bzhengs// chos bdag mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tshogs// zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las kyi// dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra ba su dha ri ha ri ni sa sā mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/

slar yang dbang gi lha badz+ra sa mā dzaḥde rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las sangs rgyas rigs kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ba su dha ri ha ri ni sa ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ oṃ ba su dha ri ha ri ni sa ba liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyi gtor ma phul/ bstod cing phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ nam mkha' dbyings kyi gzhal yas su// 'ja' dang 'od kyi pho brang na// nyi zla lta bu'i gzi brjid can// kun tu ri ka'i sku la bstod// zhing skyong kun tu ri ka dang*// bka' srung mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i tshogs// sngon gyi thugs dam brtser dgongs la// rtag tu brtse bas spyan gyis gzigs// mdzes pa'i sku zhal myur du ston// lung ston gsung gi rjes gnang mdzod// sgrub mchog bdag la mngon dgongs la// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// 'chi med tshe dang nad med bde// 'dzad med zas nor bu slob 'khor// dpal 'byor snyan grags dngos grub stsol// phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// zhi byed bstan pa phyogs bcur spel// 'khor 'das chos kun dbang du bsdus// dgra bgegs zhing bcu drag pos sgrol// phrin las bsam pa'i don kun sgrubs// de nas rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od kyis thugs rgyud bskul bas ci bcol gyi las sgrub par bsams la/ (279)oṃ badz+ra ba su dha ri ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzla/ de nas rjes gnang ni/ slob ma rnams khrus phyag sngon 'gros 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ 'dir rtsa rlung chen po'i rgyud las// kun gsal klu mos bstan pas nya ra mdzod/ ces gtad cing rgyud der zhing skyes mkha' 'gro las la bkol ba'i thabs zhes sgrub thabs dang bcas pa gsungs shing*/ rje btsun dam pa rin po ches 'di'i gsang sgrub rigs mi 'dra ba brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad pa las/

de rnams kyi nyid khu lta bu ni rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs pa bdud rtsi bum chung*/ lung gi rjes su 'brangs pa le'u bdun pa/ sgrub thabs kyi rjes su 'brangs pa las bcu ma/ man ngag gi rjes su 'brangs pa snying gi dum bu ste bzhi las/ 'di ni bdud rtsi bum chu'i gsang sgrub/ gdong can ma bzhi'i mchu sgrub/ kun tu ri ka'i klu sgrub rnams las 'di phyi ma/ dpal ding ri glang 'khor gyi gzhi bdag klu yi rgyal po stongs bzung zhes pa nor rgyas kyi sring mor gyur pa mkha' 'gro ma kun tu ri ka rlung gshog can zhes grags pa 'di'i rjes gnang sgrub par byed pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du song nas slob ma'i ngo skal du gyur pa la/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ 'dod dgu rab rdzogs rin thang med pa yi// phun tshogs dngos grub myur du thob pa'i phyir// bdag la zhing skyes mkha' 'gro sde lnga yis// rjes su gnang ba ma lus stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum/ de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes sogs gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags tshar gsum byed du bcug /de nas dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar pad+ma dang zla ba seng ge dkar mo'i steng du zhing (280)skyong kun tu ri ka sku mdog dkar mo// zhes pa nas/ zhabs zlum po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar gyis gtso 'khor lnga gsal btab nas/ bla ma la mos gus dung pa bskyed de gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i/ bla ma rin po che/ bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas gtor ma'i steng gi gtso mo sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i sku las byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun dkar nar gyis byung ba spyi bo nas zhugs rkang mthil yan chad kyi nang thams cad skya mer gyis khengs pa'i mos pa mdzod// gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/

oṃ badz+ra ba su dha ri nya ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ rol mo bya zhes bum dbang thob pas rang lus kun tu ri ka'i sku gsal stong 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bla ma rin po ches bdag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas 'khor gyi pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i sku las byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun dmar lhug lhug byung ste lus nang dmar mer gyis gang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ snying po'i mthar a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes gtor ma spyi bor bzhag cing rol mo bya/ des gsang dbang thob pas sems gsal stong nyid ye shes lhag gis shar ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bla ma rin po che/ bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas 'khor gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku las byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun sngo breng gis byung bas bskul te rdo rje lus kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams sbyor ba mdzad pa'i byang sems kyi dwangs mas lus gang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ snying po'i mthar a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ gtor ma spyi bor 'jog cing rol mo bya/ des sher dbang thob pas lus bde stong gi ye shes su lhag lhag shar ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bla ma rin po che/ bdag la dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas 'khor gyi rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sku las byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun kha dog sna tshogs pa byung bas lus sems snang ba'i dngos po thams cad nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar rjen gyis song ba'i mos pa mdzod/ snying (281)po'i mthar a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ zhes gtor ma spyi bor 'jog cing rol mo bya/ des dbang bzhi pa thob pas lhan cig skyes pa de kho na nyid kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas dam tshig khas blang ba/ gtong rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang lus dbul dge ba bsngo ba rnams sngar ltar ro// rjes chog ni/

gtong rag gi mchod bstod dang nongs pa bshags/ ye shes pa sku rten la bstim nas brtan bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan no// shu bhaṃ// oṃ swa sti/ gnod sbyin a pa rā dzi ta'am yon bdag nor bu bzang por grags pa'i rjes gnang ni/ dkyil 'khor tshon ser pos lte ba nas cha mnyam pa gnyis bskor ba so so'i nang du mu khyud re re bskor ba'i dbus su rin po che'i kha rgyan can gyi bum pa dang*/ mu khyud gnyis la nor bu'i phreng ba/ de gnyis kyi bar phyogs bzhir nor bu 'bar ba re bri/ de'i steng du rin po che'i snod du gtor ma zlum po lto ba ldir ba'i phyogs bzhir pad 'dab sbyar ba kha 'bus kyi rnam pa can shing tog dang nor snas brgyan pa'i rtser sku rten dar ser po'i gdugs dang bcas btsugs pa dgod/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ yo byad thams cad tshogs par byas nas phyag rdor gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar ber nag gi dbang chog tu bshad pa ltar dang*/ mchod gtor byin rlabs zhing skyes ltar bya/ mdun bskyed ni/ dkyil 'khor dang gtor ma swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi dbus su rin po che'i khri la aṃ yig ser po las gnod sbyin a pa rā dzi ta sku mdog ser po sbom zhing rab tu bzhad pa/ g.yas rin po che'i bum pa dang*/ g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa'i kha nas nor bu rin po che 'dzag pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ (282)dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ oṃ a pā ra dzi ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ rin chen mdzes pa'i khri stengs na/ 'dod dgu'i mchog stsol dpal dang ldan// gnod sbyin chen po nor bu bzang*// gzhan gyis mi thub khyod la bstod// ces bstod/

rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis ne'u le'i kha nas rin po che 'dzag pa dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar bsams la/ oṃ hrīḥdza a pā rā dzi ta dzaḥs ma du du/ ling ling*/ kram kram/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dza dzaḥ zhes bsnyen sngags ci nus bzlas mthar/ oṃ a pa rā dzi ta zhes mtshan sngags mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las bcol/ de nas rjes gnang dngos ni/ slob ma rnams kyis khrus phyag sngon du 'gro bas gral du 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ 'dir gnod sbyin a pa rā dzi ta 'di ni chu klung chen po'i rgyud las/ gnod sbyin nor bzang khyod la legs par gtad/ ces ston pas rgyud gtad pa ltar rje btsun dam pa rgya gar ba'i bstan pa dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi srung ma khyad par can/ sgrub pa po rnams dpal chen gzhan don gyi dus su mi nor dbang du bsdu ba sogs las sgrub pa la thogs pa med pa'i nor bdag rin po che lta bu 'di'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo sgrub par byed pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du song nas/ da slob ma'i ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes= /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag gsang ba'i bdag /slob dpon khyod ni bdag la dgongs// bdag gi dbul ba bsal ba'i phyir// nor bdag dngos grub bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum/ de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i (283)phyir gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags tshar gsum/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la khyed rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer spro bsdus skad cig gis rdo rje gtum po mthing nag phyag gnyis rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/

dar gyi cod pan dang sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ khro gtum 'jigs pa'i nyams can g.yon brkyang ba'i dor stabs kyis me'i klong na bzhugs par bsgoms/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyi sngags brjod pas mdun gyi gtor ma mi dmigs pa las rin po che'i khri la aṃ yig ser po las gnod sbyin a pa rā dzi ta zhes pa nas/ rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i bar sngar ltar dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas nor bdag chen po a pa rā dzi ta badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ a pa rā dzi ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas gtor ma lhar gsal ba la thim ste dam ye gnyis su med par khyed rang rnams la thugs shin tu mthun pa'i sgo nas bzhugs par gyur snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// de nas bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bskul bas nor bdag gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung ba'i 'od kyis 'gro ba'i dbul ba bsal zhing mi nor longs spyod kyi dngos grub bsdus nas stsal bar mos la 'di'i= oṃ hrīḥdza a pa rā dzi ta dzaḥs mā ya du du/ ling ling*/ kram kram/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dza dzaḥ zhes lan gsum bzlar gzhug /slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i= /bcom ldan (284)bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis me tog de bzung la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes spyi bor me tog 'thor/ de ni gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas khyed rang gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje che btsan 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'o snyam du nga rgyal bskyed cig /gtor ma dpal 'bar btsugs la lag tu gtad de/
