gtor ma 'di gnod sbyin a pa rā dzi tar gsal ba khyed rang la gtad cing bka' bsgos pa'i tshe rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod kyis ci bcol ba'i las bdag gis bgyid do zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po a pa rā dzi ta 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas/ byang sems kun dga'/ sgro chos brtson/ chus pa dar ma brtson 'grus/ rgyal ba te ne/ chos rgyal zhig po sku mched/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rigs kyi bu 'di yi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs te/ nad gdon sogs 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod sogs mthun phyogs thams cad yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ 'gro ba ma lus pa dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ bsam sbyor ngan pa'i gdug pa thams cad tshar bcad pa sogs bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du sgrub pa'i phrin las thogs pa med par sgrub par mdzod cig /ces bka' bsgo ba ni thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas dam tshig khas blang ba/ gtong rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ lus dbul bsngo ba rnams sngar ltar dang*/ rjes chog ni/ gtong rag gi mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ ye shes pa rten yod na brten bzhugs dang*/ (285)med na badz+ra muḥs gshegs gsol/ dam tshig pa bsdu/ bsngo shis kyis mtha' brgyan no// dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi dbang chog bklags pas grub pa las bka' srung chos skyong rnams kyi dbang rjes gnang gi cho ga bshad pa'i le tshan no// oṃ swa sti/ na maḥs man+ta gu ru pā dā ya/ sha ra ṇa gats+tsha mi/ dam pa'i chos sdug bsngal zhi byed rgyud pa phyi ma'i lugs kyi skal ldan gyi slob ma khrid tshul la/ brda rgyud las/ nyan thos rang rgyal dpal chen dus dang sbyor/ zhes pas dpon la ltos pas nyan thos lta bu'i dka' thub/

gcig pur sgrub pas rang rgyal lta bu'i dka' thub/ gzhan don la'ang 'jug pa dpa' chen gyi dka' thub gsum las/ dang po'i skabs su sngar bshad kyi dbang rnams phal cher dus dang bstun nas sbyin la/ gcig pur sgrub pa byed pa yin pas dmar khrid ces bya ste/ de sgrub par byed pa la sngon du rten 'brel gyi khang par 'jug dgos pas de'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni/ khang pa dngos brtsig pa'am ma nus na sa gzhi la rin chen brdar phye dang sman sna dri bzang rnams ba byung dang sbyar bas chag chag gdab/ de la dkyil 'khor rtsa thig nas rtsa thig gi bar 'dom do las mi che zhing 'dom gang las mi chung ba sgo bzhi sgo rkyang rgyan med kyi thig btab/ de'i dbus su pad 'dab drug gi lte bar a dang k+ṣaḥ shar nas g.yas bskor gyis sa tsan si kar rnams 'dab ma la bri/ sgo bzhir shar nas rim pa bzhin e baṃ ma ya bri/ me nas rim bzhin gru chad bzhi la maṃ kha la wo bri/ rtsibs nang gi phyogs bzhir ak+ṣa lnga bcu tshar re'am/ ma grub na tshar gcig bgos te shar dang nub tu 'bru bcu gsum re dang*/ lho dang byang du bcu gnyis re bri ba'am bla re la btags te bkram yang chog /sgo'i phyir rgya bdun mtshon pa'i re khā bdun rim zlum 'khor byed pa'i rnam par bskor/ (286)dkyil 'khor gyi ri mo rnams mi zhig pa'i chu tshon gyis brnan rten 'brel 'phang lo bzhi so so'i khas kyi kha dog dang mthun pa'i srad bu btags la sgo bzhi'i shar du dkar

zlum po/ /lhor ser gru bzhi po/ nub tu dmar zla gam po/ byang du ljang zur gsum gu rnams bzhag /dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rgyal ba yum gyi bla re lha'am a zhal shar bstan gyis dbubs/ sgo bzhir 'jug pa'i lam la ak+ṣa lnga bcu/ tshon dkar pos 'bri*/ ba'am yang na dar ras gang*/ rigs kyi yug dkar po la bris pa bzhi'am/ ma 'byor na gcig rim par spos chog pa byed/ phyi nang gi mchod pa rdzas dang gtor ma tshogs kyi yo byad rnams rgyas par bsags la/ go yul gyis shong na mchod gtor rnams dkyil 'khor nang gi zur gcig tu bshams kyang chog /ma shong na dkyil 'khor phyi'i 'dod snam gyi ri mo'i steng du bskor nas bshams kyang mi 'gal gsung*/ gzhan yang ḍā dril me tog sogs 'dir dgos pa thams cad tshang bar bsag go /de nas slob dpon gyis phyogs skyong bzhi bgegs kyi gtor ma btang ba/ srung 'khor sgom pa/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi dang bdun rnam dag gis bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang*/ swa bhā was ye shes kyi tshogs gsog rnams lam lnga'i dbang chog ltar sngon du 'gro bas/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyis mi phyed par bcings pa'i nang du rten 'brel khang pa nyid sa bcu dang lam lnga'i them skas rnam par thar pa'i sgo la sogs te thar pa chen po'i pho brang ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la slob dpon bdag nyid skad cig dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma/ sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma zhi zhing 'dzum pa dang bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ sked skabs phra zhing nu 'bur rgyas pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs cung zad bcings pa/ dar (287)dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan pa// phyag dang po gnyis skyabs sbyin dang mnyam bzhag/ 'og ma gnyis pu sti dang rdo rje bsnams pa zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i a yig dkar po'i mthar/

tad+ya thā/ oṃ gā te gā te/ pa ra gā te/ pa ra saṃ ga te bo dhi swā hā/ zhes pas bskor ba/ a las 'od zer 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho sa gnyis su med par thim/ de nas sku snang stong*/ gsung grags stong*/ thugs rig stong du bltas la/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen pos kun nas blangs te bzlas pas thugs ka'i sngags kyi 'od zer gyis rang dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag par bsam la/ tad+ya thā/ gā te sogs ci nus bzlas mthar ar+ghaṃ nas shab+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ smra bsam brjod med kyis bstod par bya'o// de nas ma lus sems can ma lta bus phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas bzhugs par bsam la/ bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa phul nas/ 'bru dkar po'i me tog rdul med pa la rten 'brel snying po nyer gcig bzlas la bkra shis brjod cing me tog gtor bas khang pa'i rab gnas bya'o// de nas dbang bskur ba ni// phyi rol tu slob ma rnams la sgrub pa'i dam bca' dris te khas blangs pa rnams 'dag chal dang dri'i chus lus ril po'am tha na'ang yan lag lnga legs par bkrus/ khyad par rkang pa la dri bzang po'i spos dang tsan dan gyi chus byugs la dar dkar ram ras dkar gyis dkri/ phyag byas te dkyil 'khor shar phyogs nas nub tu phyogs par 'khod pa la/ bla mas 'di skad ces/ 'o rgyu sems can la 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas dam pa'i chos rin po che nyams su blangs (288)dgos/ de la'ang gang zag gi blo'i rim pa sna tshogs pa gsungs pa las/ 'dir theg pa chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gdams ngag /gsang sngags dang rjes su mthun pa snying po don gyi rgyud sdug bsngal zhi byed las dri med thigs pa phyag bzhes kyi skor zhes bla ma byang chub sems dpa' kun dga'i lugs 'di la/

rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas kyi bka' las brgyud pa mi 'dzin pa'i mi la rten 'brel lag tu mi gtad pa lam gyi srang las ma brgal bar bsgom pa bdag po la mi gtad/ ces gsungs pas lam 'dir zhugs nas brgyud pa 'dzin cing sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag la rten 'brel lag tu gtod pa'i cho ga 'di gal che bas/ lam lnga'i srang nas thon cing sgom pa bdag po la gtod pa'i sgrub pa po des sems can gyi don byed pa la rten 'brel sna tshogs 'char ba'i ched du bla mas khang par gzhug cing cho ga bya dgos pas/ de'i phyir rten 'brel khang par 'jug pa'i byin rlabs zhus nas sgrub pa nyams su len pa rang gis dka' thub mthar phyin par bya ste/ dpa' chen gzhan don gyi dka' thub kyis sems can thams cad kyi don bya'o snyam du byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la yid ches bskyed pa gtam rgyud kyi yan lag las/ thog mar brgyud pa'i lo rgyus ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thub pa chen pos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa don gyi brgyud pa rgyal tshabs byams pa mgon po la gtad/ des 'phags pa thogs med la/ des mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen la/ des bram ze ār+ya de ba la/ des rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas sam/ nye brgyud la byams pa nyid kyis dam pa rin po cher dga' ldan du gsungs par gda'/ dam pas byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' la/ des mkhas btsun spa tshab la/ des rgyal ba te ne la/ des zhig po rin po che sku mched la/ des mtshan ldan ri khrod dbang phyug dang rgya sgom smon (289)mang byon pa'i phyi ma la bal bod gnyis kyi so mtshams la stod dpal gyi ding ri bya ba rje btsun ma kun tu ri ka'i bzhugs gnas mkha' 'gro rang bzhin gyis 'du ba ngo mtshar gyi rdzas bzhis brgyan cing g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal la dung gi rgyan bkram pa 'dra ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i gnas der gdan phab nas lo gsum lon pa'i tshe/

byang sems kun dgas mjal te lo gcig dkar khrid blo sbyong gi nyams len byed du bcug /lo bzhi lon pa'i dus dam pa'i zhal nas/ ding rir rten 'brel gyi khang pa brtsigs pa yin pas rgya sgom las mi rnams kyis 'dza' ra grabs kyis gsungs nas dam pas rang 'dra'i a tsār mang po sprul te rten 'brel gyi khang pa brtsigs shing*/ rgya sgom pa'i bshos kyang las mi thams cad nga rang yin gsungs nas dam pa nyid kyis gsol/ khang pa de'ang rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa byang gi rmad du me shel bcug pas grang nad mi 'ong*/ nub byang du chu shel bcug pas tshad nad mi 'byung*/ lho nub tu a ru ra rnam rgyal yod pas rims nad mi 'byung*/ de'i nang du bla ma byang chub sems dpa' la lam lnga'i khrid gsungs/ khang pa der sgo ba'i rnal 'byor pa bzhi dang rgya sgom sogs slob ma khyad par can 'ga' zung ma gtogs gzhan su'ang mi gtong skad/ de nyid du dam pas lam lnga'i spogs chog gi sgrub pa sogs mdzad par grub thob kyi phreng ba rgyun ma chad par byung ltar/ khyed rang rnams kyang sku gsum gyi zhing khams la spyod pa'i phyir rten 'brel gyi khang par 'jug par 'dod pas bla ma la mos gus drag po bskyed de maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas snyims pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma rin po che/ bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 'di'i= /bla ma dam (290)pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa nas/ de kho na nyid du grub par gyur cig /ces pa'i bar lan gsum/ de nas bla mas/ kye rigs kyi bu sa bcu dang lam lnga'i skas la 'dzegs la/ rnam par thar pa gsum gyi sgo phye nas thar pa'i yang khang du shog cig

/ces lan gsum gyis bos pas/ slob mas/ de'i lan gsol ba 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye bla ma rin po che/ sa bcu dang lam lnga'i skas gang la ji ltar bgrod par bgyi/ rnam par thar pa gsum gyi sgo ji ltar dbye bar bgyi/ zhes zhu/ bla mas gsol ba btab pa'i lan 'di la gsan par zhu 'tshal/ rigs kyi bu tshogs kyi lam du dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi dang*/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la slob cig /sbyor ba'i lam du dbang po lnga dang*/ stobs lnga la slobs shig /mthong ba'i lam du byang chub kyi lam yan lag bdun la slob cig /sgom pa'i lam du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad la slob cig /mthar phyin pa'i lam du/ stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa gsum gyi sgo phye la rnam pa bcu'i skas la 'dzegs nas shog cig /des ni thar pa'i yang khang du zhugs nas sku gsum gyi zhing khams mthong bar 'gyur ro// de'ang shul lam du 'grul pa'i gom pas bgrod pa'i 'gros ltar rim par rim par bgrod pa ni ma yin gyis/ ji ltar gzings kyi ba dan rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin du de kho na nyid kyi ye shes chen po rtogs pa'i sgo nas bgrod du med pa'i tshul gyis chig chod du bgrod la shog cig /de nas khang par gzhug pa dngos ni/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi nang du nub nas zhal shar phyogs su bltas te/ shar gyi 'phang lo phyag tu bzung ba'i srad bu sgo'i phyir drangs pa'i sne slob bu'i lag tu gtad la/ bla mas/ 'o// sems kyi de kho nyid kyi ye shes rtogs pa'i sgo nas thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i tshul gyis sa lam chig chod du bgrod de thar pa'i yang khang (291)du brtol sku gsum gyi zhing khams mthong ba'i mos pas ā li kā li brjod bzhin du shog cig /ces gdams pas slob ma rnams kyis rkang pa dar ras kyis dril ba yig 'bru'i lam gyi steng du rtsen rtsen re mos kyis spo zhing yi ge de dang de dag tu 'don pa'i sgo nas nang du zhugs la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su slob dpon la phyogs par 'dug ste/

'phang lo'i srad bu nas 'dzin bzhin du 'dug pa la lung 'bogs par bya ste/ rtsa brgyud la bskur cing lam lnga gso bar byed pa'i snying po'i lung blang bar bya snyam pas 'di'i/ oṃ āḥhrīḥ tad+ya thā/ oṃ gā te gā te pa ra gā te pa ra saṅgā te bo dhi swā hā/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas rig pa dwangs shing rten 'brel 'char bar byed pa'i sngags 'di yi rjes zlos rten 'brel 'khor lo slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhag /bla ma'i phreng ba la 'chang du bcug la/ oṃ āḥhrī gu ru h+ya ba da da te hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas mkhyen pa'i yon tan phyogs med du 'char bar byed pa'i sngags 'di'i rjes/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum/ bar 'dir lam lnga'i snying po'i lung 'bogs par yig rnying las bshad/ de nas bkra shis shing rten 'brel brtan par bya ba'i sngags 'di'i= /oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he dun+te ṣan+ta thā ga to h+ya ba dat+te ṣañca yo ni ro dhā e waṃ bā di ma hā shra ma ṇa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum bzlas nas phreng ba bsdus te/ 'phang lo slob bu'i mgor bzhag la/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rdo rje'i slob bu 'di la rtogs pa'i ye shes mchog tu gyur pa skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyes pa brtan cing bogs thon par mdzad du gsol/ ces brjod/ spyi bor me tog 'thor ba dang bcas/ sems nyid ngo bo stong nyid chos kyi dbyings// rang bzhin gnyug ma 'du 'bral med pa'i rtsal// mtshan nyid gnyis med rtogs pa'i ngang du grol// ma nor don chen rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa (292)brjod cing rol mo 'khrol lo// de nas slob ma shar sgo nas phyir bton la shar gyi 'phang lo de bzhin du bzhag /slar yang bskor phyogs kyis slob dpon byang nas lhor zhal phyogs te lho'i 'phang lo phyag tu bzung ba'i srad bu'i sne bu'i lag tu gtad la/

a k+ṣaḥbagrang bzhin du nang du drangs te/ lam lnga gso byed/ yon tan 'char byed/ rten 'brel brtan byed kyi sngags kyi lung bzhi dbog cing*/ 'phang lo mgor bzhag nas shis pa brjod pa rnams sngar bzhin bya'o// de bzhin du nub sgo dang byang sgo nas 'jug pa'ang 'gre'o// mthar byang sgo nas 'thon te/ bla ma stan la bzhugs pa'i mdun du slob bu rnams 'dug tu bcug la 'di skad ces/ de ltar rten 'brel khang par zhugs pas rig pa dwangs pa'i me long du rten 'brel gyi gzugs brnyan sna tshogs ma 'gags par shar nas/ mkhyen pa'i yon tan phyogs med du rgyas par 'gyur ba yin pas dga' ba sgoms/ der zhugs nas kyang bo zags ltems log gi dri ma bzhi bsrung zhing rnal 'byor gyi rang sa ma nyams pa'i sgo nas lam lnga'i sgrub pa la tshul bzhin nyams su blangs te rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod cig /des rten 'brel khang 'jug gi dbang bskur zin pas bka' drin gtong rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal dang phyag 'bul du bcug nas dge ba bsngo'o// de nas rjes chog ni/ gtor ma btang ba dang*/ tshogs mchod lam lnga'i dbang chog ltar dang*/ yig brgyas lhag chad kyi nongs bshags rten 'brel khang pa dngos yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ min na gshegs su gsol la rjes mi mngon par bya'o// bsngo smon dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan no// sgrub pa'i dam bca' mi 'bul ba'i rten 'brel khang par mi gzhug ces gsungs pa ltar deng sang yang phyag (293)len la ma 'chug par mdzad do// gam+bhi ra ho gu h+ya/ oṃ swa sti/ de ltar rten 'brel khang par chug nas bar du sgrub pa rang rgyal lta bu'i dka' thub thems pa dang*/ dka' thub gsum pa ni/ dpa' chen gzhan don byed pa la 'jug pa'i dus te bdag gtod kyi dbang khrid tshar nas nag khrid ces pa yi ge rnams kyi bshad lung thams cad rdzogs par byin no// de ltar dbang khrid lung rnams yongs su rdzogs nas gzhan don pher ba na bka' babs kyi brgyud pa gtod pa'i cho ga mdzad srol la/

bla ma'i gsung gis/ deng sang 'di'i bka' mi bzhugs gsungs nas glegs bam gtod pa dang*/ chos skyong gi gtor ma mgor 'jog pa rnams mi mdzad cing*/ dpal ldan bsod nams kyi yi ge'i steng nas mi nyung 'dus la lam lnga so sor dus bcad nas bdag gtod kyi dbang rjes la byed na de dus sam/ lam lnga'i dbang bskur bar ma chad du byas na rten 'brel khang 'jug lta bu'i mjug tu bklag lung ltar 'don pa mdzad de/ bdag cag la mi nyung khyad kyis par nag gi dbang gi rjes 'brel du gnang ngo*// de la rang gi go sar bka' chad gnang ba dam dog gi gsung dkyus shor dang gtor ma 'jog pa phyis lag len rgyas su song ba ma gtogs yig rnying du mi gsal zhing*// glegs bam rnams dbang lung rdzogs pa'i sa der bzhugs pas go bcad nas zor yang tsam du song ba la phyis bka' chad par brtags sam snyam pas/ phyag len bzhin du btang na gzhung bzhin byas kyang mi 'gal lam snyam pa rang gi rnam rtog ste/ chos kyi spyan ldan rnams kyis dpyad par zhu// gang ltar yang bklag chog re mdzad pa'i rgyun ltar de nyid mi nub pa'i phyir/ 'dir yang dpal ldan bsod nams kyi yi ge la bzo bcos med par 'god pa ni 'di lta ste// (294)bka' babs kyi brgyud pa gtod pa'i dbang ni/ dbang lung thams cad yongs su rdzogs par thob nas/ dkon mchog dang khyad par zhi byed kyi pu sti'i mdun du mchod gtor rgyas par bshams/ bla mas sngar lhag pa'i lha'i bskyed rim bzlas pa mchod bstod gtor ma'i bar legs par grub nas/ bla ma rnams bsgom nas gsol ba 'debs shing mchod bstod bya/ de nas slob ma la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mchod bsngo smon lam dang bcas phog nas rten sdom pa gsum ldan du byas te/ slob ma de'i lag tu brgyud phyi'i pu sti rnams gtad nas bka' babs brgyud pa phyi ma'i chos 'di la/ dbang gi chu bo chen po bzhi yod pa'i bum dbang ni/

rdo rje 'chang la bdag med mas gsan/ des dam pa la gnang*/ gsang dbang ni rnam snang la ngo mtshar mkha' spyod kyi bla ma sum cu rtsa drug gis gsan nas/ de rnam snang gis dam pa la gnang*/ shes rab ye shes ni/ sangs rgyas thub pa chen pos dam pa la don brgyud gtad/ de nas thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ ār+ya de ba/ des dam pa la gnang*/ tshig dbang ni/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje la gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gsan nas/ de rnams kyis dam pa rin po che la don brgyud gtad pa de bzhin du/ dam pas kyang bla ma byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' la gtad/ des mkhas btsun sba tshab sgom pa la/ des rgyal ba te ne la/ des zhig po nyi ma seng ge la/ des thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams dpal la/ des rgyal sras kun dga' bzang po la/ des bla ma kun dga' don grub la/ des mtshan ldan ri khrod dbang phyug la/ des mkhan chen tshul khrims phan la/ des drin chen sangs rgyas dbon po la/ des kun mkhyen byang chub (295)bzang po la/ ces pa ltar brgyud pa rim bzhin mtshan nas brjod de/ rtsa ba'i bla mas bdag la chu bo chen po bzhi dgyes bzhin tu bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs te tshig ma lus pa gnang nas don brgyud gtad pa lags so// de bzhin tu khyed la yang gtod pa lags pas bka' babs kyi dbang bzhi po 'di bka' babs sku bzhi nas da lta bdag yan tu dbang gi chu bo 'bab 'phro ma chad/ nyams rtogs kyi na bun 'thul 'phro ma chad/ lam rtags kyi 'ja' tshon 'char 'phro ma chad de/ mdor na grub thob kyi phreng thag ma chad pa'i chos lags/ de'ang don gyi chings bzhi ste/ mdo rgyud phyag len dang bcas pa/ bka' babs snyan brgyud dang bcas pa/ dri med phra thigs dang bcas pa/ dar tshags bshad 'bum dang bcas pa'i dbang byin rlabs tshig don gyi bka' ma lus pa khar sang nas bgyis zin nas/ don gyi brgyud pa gtod pa lags pas khyed kyis kyang chos 'di rnams kyi nang na mar ji skad bshad pa bzhin nyams su len cing*/

gzhan don sems can la phan 'dogs rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ zhes brjod/ lan du slob mas/ bla ma rin po ches ji ltar bka' stsal ba bzhin du sgrub par zhu zhes khas blangs/ de nas chos skyong gi gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag nas/ oṃ a gho ra ma hā ka la du beng ni dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan bdun dang*/ baṃ ha ri ni sa hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyi rjes la/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi mgon po a gho ra dang*/ bka' srung lag na rdor 'chang*/ gtsug na me khyer/ rgyab na gshog thogs/ kha nas khus 'debs/ zhing skyong kun tu rī ka sogs bka' srung rnams kyis/ sngar bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phrin las ji ltar sgrub pa bzhin/ khong ྖྒཻ mo'i (296)yang 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /ces bka' srung gtod/ 'di brgyud pa gtad pa'i dbang ste/ gzhan don mi 'grub pa'i slob ma la brgyud pa mi gtod/ ces gsungs 'di la bka' dog par mdzad do// des brgyud pa gtad pa'i dbang tshar bas maṇ+ḍal dang drin phyag 'tshal du gzhug /bla mas dkyil 'khor gyi rjes chog gzhung bzhin bya'o// dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi dbang chog bklag pas grub pa las rten 'brel khang 'jug dang brgyud pa gtod pa'i cho ga bshad pa'i le tshan no// zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum gyi// dbang chog ming don mthun pa 'di// dge slong r+harma shrīs bkod// nongs na mkhas rnams bzod par mdzod// de ltar 'bad pa'i dge 'dis kyang*// lus bskyed ma yis thog drangs nas// dpag yas sems can ma lus kun// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog /zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum gyi dbang chog rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bklags pas grub pa zhes bya ba dge slong rgan po dharma shrīs shing bya lor zangs ri lhun grub rab brtan du dbu brtsams te/ dus kyi 'gyur ba yang bas rang dbang 'dus pa dka' bar byung yang ji skad du/

srid pa las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur pas// gang dang gang du dam chos 'jig pa der// me tshogs spu gri'i so yang brgal nas ni// phyi mthar thug gi bar du dam chos bzung*/ (297)zhes gsungs pa la nges shes bskyed nas zab chos 'di dag deng sang ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur pa gso thub na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dam bca' brtan pos rkyen dbang du ma btang bar dal khoms 'byor brdogs kyi sug ris su rim par spel ba las/ mi zad pa me khyi'i lo hor zla drug pa'i yar ngo'i tshes drug gi snga dro bu mo'i dus sbyor thog /o rgyan smin grol gling gi chos grwar grub par bgyis pa ste/ nyis bris ma khoms pas mtshams sbyor dang tshig phrad sogs 'gal zlos su gyur na dam pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzod cig /'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /dar rgyas 'phel/ shu bha mastu/ in+d+ra bhu ti nai ka pṛts+tshas/
